ASD makes a controlled tradeoff: it spends a measured local-regret budget to gain more reusable target-scored tokens. This is also a useful framing for pretraining researchers studying the gap between token-level objectives, decoding trajectories, and task-level correctness. The paper is careful about the limitation: ASD bounds accumulated local regret, but it does not guarantee identical outputs, semantic preservation, or task correctness.
summary_en.technical_approach: ASD is a training-free verifier-side modification. It uses the same teacher-forced target pass as standard speculative decoding. Instead of accepting only the longest prefix that exactly matches the target argmax, it selects the longest prefix subject to three constraints: a local target-logit regret threshold for mismatched tokens, a per-block cap on the number of accepted exceptions, and a persistent request-level regret budget. The central mechanism is realized-prefix suffix reuse. Once an early mismatch is accepted, later target rows in the teacher-forced pass are already conditioned on the draft prefix containing that mismatch. If subsequent draft tokens equal the corresponding target argmax under that realized prefix, they can be committed without another target forward pass. This differs from a naive relaxed matcher because deviations are explicitly accounted for over the whole request rather than reset at every block.
summary_en.experiments: The reported gains are throughput-oriented. With Qwen3-14B as the target and DSpark-14B as the draft model, ASD improves fixed-workload throughput over matched strict speculative decoding by up to 15.26%, with a 7.78% average gain across seven tasks. With DeepSeek-V4-Flash at 285B parameters and DSpark, the paper reports roughly 10% to 16% acceptance improvements on GSM8K and MATH-500 under FP4-to-FP8 compatibility. The ablations focus on verifier controls: regret threshold, block exception cap, request-level budget, and the empirical frequency of reusable suffixes. The paper also notes that opportunity rate does not directly determine TPS, since serving performance depends on batching, cache handling, memory bandwidth, and implementation details.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read the Introduction for the precise failure mode of first-mismatch truncation. Then focus on the ASD formulation: local target-logit regret, budget accounting, and realized-prefix suffix reuse. Figure 1 is the key intuition for suffix reuse; Figure 3 is useful for understanding how often low-regret mismatches followed by greedy suffixes appear. In the experiments, prioritize fixed-workload TPS over raw acceptance rate. The main caveat is important: ASD is approximate decoding, not a lossless serving optimization, so task-level error should be checked before use in math, code, or safety-sensitive generation.

recommendation.zh: 训练免费的推测解码实用改进，无需改模型即可提升接受率，部署侧可直接接入验证，只看§3算法和核心ablation即可。
recommendation.en: A practical training-free tweak to speculative decoding that boosts acceptance rate without model changes; skip to §3 for the algorithm and core ablation results for deployment validation.

paper.title: GSTEP: Global Spatio-Temporal Density-Driven Visual Token Pruning for Efficient Video Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Video large language models (VideoLLMs) achieve strong video understanding performance, but their inference remains expensive due to the large number of redundant spatio-temporal visual tokens in long videos. Existing token pruning methods alleviate this cost by reducing redundant tokens, yet most of them rely on segment-level local pruning, where videos are partitioned into isolated segments and tokens are selected independently within each segment. Such designs may under-preserve short but sem

summary.core_problem: 解决现有视频LLM token剪枝方法依赖片段级局部剪枝，导致语义密集短片段被欠采样、全局关键但局部不显著的token被误删的问题
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出即插即用的全局时空密度驱动剪枝框架GSTEP，将视频建模为连续时空信息流，统一处理时空维度的冗余token
summary.technical_approach: 1) 将视频建模为连续时空信息流，而非孤立片段；2) 构造token级时空密度：结合平滑中心化帧级变化信号得到的连续时间密度，与帧内基于视觉特征显著性的空间密度；3) 根据全局时空密度自适应保留高信息密度token，支持任意VideoLLM backbone的即插即用
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体模型配置、数据集与量化提升，核心贡献为方法框架，需查阅正文获取视频理解任务精度、推理速度与显存占用的实验结果
summary.authors_note: 中国科学技术大学、合肥工业大学团队

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses limitations of existing VideoLLM token pruning methods that rely on segment-level local pruning, leading to under-sampling of semantically dense short segments and erroneous deletion of globally critical but locally non-salient tokens
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: proposes GSTEP, a plug-and-play global spatio-temporal density-driven pruning framework, modeling video as a continuous spatio-temporal information flow to unify redundancy reduction across both dimensions
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Models video as continuous spatio-temporal information flow instead of isolated segments; 2) Constructs token-level spatio-temporal density by combining continuous temporal density (from smoothed centered frame change signals) and intra-frame spatial density (based on visual feature saliency); 3) Adaptively retains high-information-density tokens based on global density, plug-and-play for any VideoLLM backbone
summary_en.experiments: Abstract does not disclose specific model configurations, datasets, or quantitative gains; core contribution is methodological framework, refer to full text for video understanding accuracy, inference speed, and memory footprint results
summary_en.authors_note: University of Science and Technology of China, Hefei University of Technology team

recommendation.zh: 视频LLM token剪枝的增量改进，做多模态推理效率的可看§3的时空密度构造方法，纯文本预训练研究员无需深读
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement for VideoLLM token pruning; multimodal inference teams can check §3 spatio-temporal density construction, no need for text-only pretrain researchers to read deeply

institutions: University of Science and Technology of China
University of Science and Technology of ChinaHe Fei

paper.title: SPADE: An Input-Adaptive Sparse Attention Engine for Fast Video Diffusion Models Inference
paper.abstract: Video diffusion transformers (vDiTs) generate high quality but pay quadratic self-attention cost, making inference prohibitive at video-token scales. The challenge is input-adaptive sparsity: selecting critical Q/K/V tokens with negligible overhead and executing them for end-to-end gains. We present SPADE, a training-free sparse-attention engine of three parts: (i) vDiT-SSR, a specification defining 3D blocking candidates and formalizing dynamic masks via Summarizer/Estimator expressions; (ii) r

summary.core_problem: 解决视频 diffusion transformer 在高视频 token 数下自注意力二次复杂度导致推理过慢的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理系统与稀疏注意力工程。它不直接推进 LLM 预训练，但对长序列、多模态生成模型的 attention sparsity 和 kernel 落地有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SPADE，一个免训练的输入自适应稀疏注意力引擎。方法包括 vDiT-SSR 稀疏规则描述、基于 SICS 和 head-wise policy 的运行时方案生成，以及低开销索引搜索、flash block-sparse attention、kernel grouping 组成的执行器。
summary.experiments: 在 Hunyuan-Video 与 Wan 2.1/2.2 上评估文本到视频和图像到视频生成。报告 attention 加速 2.26x-3.40x，端到端推理加速 1.49x-1.80x，同时声称保持生成质量；摘要未给出具体质量指标或显著性细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the quadratic self-attention bottleneck in video diffusion transformers at large video-token scales.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-system and sparse-attention contribution. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to long-sequence multimodal generation and practical sparse attention execution.
summary_en.technical_approach: SPADE is a training-free input-adaptive sparse attention engine. It defines vDiT-SSR for 3D blocking and dynamic mask expressions, generates runtime schemes with SICS and head-wise policies, and executes them through low-overhead index search, flash block-sparse attention, and kernel grouping.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are reported on Hunyuan-Video and Wan 2.1/2.2 for text-to-video and image-to-video generation. The method accelerates attention by 2.26x-3.40x and end-to-end inference by 1.49x-1.80x while claiming preserved quality; the abstract does not expose detailed quality metrics.

recommendation.zh: 知道 vDiT 动态稀疏能拿到端到端收益即可；不做视频生成 serving 的话，不必细读。
recommendation.en: Worth knowing that adaptive sparsity can yield real end-to-end vDiT speedups; skip the details unless you work on video-generation serving.

paper.title: FOCUS: FP4 Optimization via Coupled-Relaxation and Dual-Granularity Scaling
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve remarkable performance but are expensive to deploy due to their enormous size. FP4 quantization, with formats such as MXFP4 and NVFP4, offers an appealing solution with native hardware support on modern accelerators. However, maintaining accuracy under FP4 precision remains difficult. A key bottleneck lies in scale optimization: existing methods tightly couple the quantization and dequantization scales, forcing both to conform to the discrete low-precision fo

summary.core_problem: MXFP4/NVFP4 等硬件原生 FP4 格式能大幅降低推理开销，但 PTQ 到 FP4 时精度损失明显。现有 scale 优化方法把量化 scale 与反量化 scale 绑成同一个离散、低精度、固定块大小的值，导致优化空间被硬件格式不必要地限制住了。论文指出一个被忽视的事实：量化 scale 只在离线量化阶段使用、不会被存储和部署，因此没有理由受硬件格式约束。
summary.importance: 这是一篇偏推理部署的 PTQ 工作，但观察很干净：区分“离线用的量化 scale”和“部署用的反量化 scale”是 FP4 量化里一个以前没有被系统利用的自由度。对做低精度训练/量化的研究人员，CRS 把离散 scale 优化提升到连续空间的思路也可以迁移到量化感知训练或训练时低精度方案上。方法零推理开销、兼容现有 MXFP4/NVFP4 硬件，工程落地性强。
summary.technical_approach: FOCUS 是一个纯 scale 学习的 FP4 PTQ 框架，不做 Hadamard rotation 等会引入在线计算的变换。核心两个组件：其一，Coupled-Relaxation Scaling (CRS) 在量化 scale 与硬件要求的反量化 scale 之间引入一个可学习的全精度系数，把优化从离散 E8M0/E4M3 scale 空间松弛到连续空间，可用梯度端到端优化；其二，Dual-Granularity Scaling (DGS) 让量化 scale 在子块（比硬件 block 更细的粒度）上工作，反量化 scale 仍保持硬件规定的 block size，从而用更细粒度的离线 scale 捕捉局部权值分布差异，同时不改变部署格式。整个过程只优化 scale 参数，权重本身冻结。
summary.experiments: 在多个 LLM 上同时评估 MXFP4 与 NVFP4 的 W4A4 量化。Qwen3-4B 在 NVFP4 下恢复到 FP16 零样本精度的 98.2%，整体优于现有 FP4 PTQ 方法。量化 Qwen3-4B 单卡 H20 只需 19 分钟，且推理阶段无额外算子、无额外开销，直接兼容现有硬件与框架。论文没有报告训练时量化或更大规模（如 70B 级）的结果，这部分还需要后续验证。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看引言 Figure 2 对“量化 scale 自由、反量化 scale 受约束”的区分，以及方法论中 CRS/DGS 的形式化。做 serving/量化方向可以再跟进实现细节；做预训练的研究人员主要借鉴其“分离离线优化变量与部署变量”这个设计思路。预计阅读 15–25 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Hardware-native FP4 formats such as MXFP4 and NVFP4 promise large inference savings, but post-training quantization to FP4 still suffers from non-trivial accuracy degradation. Existing scale-optimization methods tightly couple the quantization scale and dequantization scale into a single discrete, low-precision value at a fixed block size, unnecessarily restricting optimization by hardware format constraints. The paper points out a simple but overlooked fact: the quantization scale is used only during offline calibration and is never stored or deployed, so it need not obey hardware constraints at all.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a serving/PTQ paper, but the core observation is clean and general: separating the offline quantization scale from the deployed dequantization scale unlocks a previously underused degree of freedom in FP4 quantization. The idea of lifting discrete scale optimization into a continuous, learnable space via CRS may also transfer to quantization-aware training or training-time low-precision recipes. The method introduces zero inference overhead and is directly compatible with existing MXFP4/NVFP4 hardware, which makes it practically attractive.
summary_en.technical_approach: FOCUS is a scale-learning-only FP4 PTQ framework, avoiding transformation-based methods such as Hadamard rotation that add online compute. It has two components. Coupled-Relaxation Scaling (CRS) inserts a learnable full-precision coefficient between the quantization scale and the hardware-constrained dequantization scale, relaxing optimization from the discrete scale space imposed by E8M0/E4M3 into a continuous space amenable to gradient-based end-to-end learning. Dual-Granularity Scaling (DGS) lets the quantization scale operate at a sub-block granularity finer than the hardware block size, while the dequantization scale stays at the hardware-mandated block size, so local weight variations are captured offline without changing the deployed format. Model weights remain frozen throughout.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on multiple LLM families under both MXFP4 and NVFP4 W4A4. On Qwen3-4B with NVFP4, FOCUS recovers 98.2% of FP16 zero-shot accuracy and consistently outperforms prior FP4 PTQ baselines. Quantizing Qwen3-4B takes 19 minutes on a single H20 GPU, with no extra inference operators or overhead and seamless compatibility with existing frameworks. Results on very large models (e.g., 70B-scale) and training-time quantization are not provided, so those regimes remain to be verified.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level read. Focus on Figure 2 in the introduction, which cleanly separates the unconstrained quantization scale from the hardware-constrained dequantization scale, and on the formalization of CRS/DGS in the method section. Researchers working on serving/quantization can dig into implementation details; for pretrain researchers, the main takeaway is the design principle of separating offline optimization variables from deployed variables. Estimated reading time: 15–25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: FP4是下一代硬件原生低精度格式，这篇提出解耦量化/反量化scale约束的思路很实用，只看CRS方法设计即可
recommendation.en: FP4 is next-gen hardware-native precision; the insight that quantization scales need not follow hardware discrete format constraints is practically useful, just read the CRS design section.

paper.title: How GPT-5.6 fuses frontier intelligence with frontier efficiency
paper.abstract: GPT-5.6 improves AI efficiency across models, inference, and agentic workflows, helping deliver more useful intelligence per dollar.

summary.core_problem: GPT-5.6如何在提升智能水平的同时，大幅优化模型、推理和Agent工作流的效率？
summary.importance: OpenAI官方技术博客，概述了GPT-5.6的核心升级方向：在追求前沿智能（Frontier Intelligence）的同时，极大地强调了前沿效率（Frontier Efficiency），这代表了顶级大厂在模型迭代上的重要趋势（Intelligence per dollar）。
summary.technical_approach: 文章未详细披露底层架构细节，但强调了在模型层面（可能涉及架构优化或稀疏化）、推理层面（可能涉及KV Cache优化、投机解码等）以及Agent工作流层面（更高效的工具调用和规划）的全面效率提升。
summary.experiments: 强调了提供“每美元更有用的智能（more useful intelligence per dollar）”。
summary.authors_note: OpenAI 官方发布，是了解其最新一代模型设计哲学的关键材料。

summary_en.core_problem: How does GPT-5.6 significantly optimize the efficiency of models, inference, and Agent workflows while improving intelligence?
summary_en.importance: Official OpenAI technical blog outlining the core upgrade direction of GPT-5.6: while pursuing Frontier Intelligence, it heavily emphasizes Frontier Efficiency, representing an important trend in model iteration by top tech giants (Intelligence per dollar).
summary_en.technical_approach: The article does not disclose detailed underlying architecture, but emphasizes comprehensive efficiency improvements at the model level (possibly involving architecture optimization or sparsification), inference level (possibly involving KV Cache optimization, speculative decoding, etc.), and Agent workflow level (more efficient tool use and planning).
summary_en.experiments: Emphasizes delivering 'more useful intelligence per dollar'.
summary_en.authors_note: Official release by OpenAI, a key material for understanding the design philosophy of their latest generation models.

recommendation.zh: OpenAI官方对GPT-5.6的定调：智能与效率并重。预示着后续预训练和系统优化的重点将向'Intelligence per dollar'倾斜，必读其设计理念。
recommendation.en: OpenAI's official positioning of GPT-5.6: equal emphasis on intelligence and efficiency. Indicates that the focus of subsequent pre-training and system optimization will lean towards 'Intelligence per dollar', a must-read for its design philosophy.

paper.title: FORGE: Frame Orthogonality in Relevance Geometry for Long-Form Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have enabled long-form video understanding at a scale that was not previously possible. However, the density of relevant content decreases sharply as video sequence length increases, and exposing the model to more irrelevant content measurably reduces its accuracy. In this paper, we address the problem of maximizing query-relevant information in a frame subset selected at inference time, without training. FORGE (Frame Orthogonality in Relevance Geometry)

summary.core_problem: 长视频理解中序列长度增加时无关帧占比升高，导致多模态大模型准确率下降，且现有方法需额外训练的问题
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出无训练、模型无关的查询感知关键帧选择方法，统一相关性与多样性优化目标
summary.technical_approach: FORGE在预训练多模态嵌入空间上构造查询条件的几何结构，通过帧正交性度量覆盖独立查询相关方向的程度，选择最大信息量的帧子集
summary.experiments: 在Video-MME和LongVideoBench上测试，16/32/64帧预算下均提升关键帧选择效果，无额外训练或微调开销
summary.authors_note: 佐治亚理工学院ECE系团队，无大模型领域知名作者

summary_en.core_problem: Irrelevant frame ratio rises with long video sequence length, degrading MLLM accuracy, while existing frame selection methods require additional training
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposes a training-free, model-agnostic query-aware keyframe selection method that unifies relevance and diversity objectives
summary_en.technical_approach: FORGE induces a query-conditioned geometry on pretrained multimodal embedding space, uses frame orthogonality to measure coverage of independent query-relevant directions, and selects maximum-information frame subsets
summary_en.experiments: Tested on Video-MME and LongVideoBench, improves keyframe selection under 16/32/64 frame budgets with no extra training or fine-tuning cost
summary_en.authors_note: ECE Department, Georgia Institute of Technology; no well-known LLM researchers

recommendation.zh: 多模态长视频推理侧的增量技巧，对LLM基座预训练无直接价值，做MLLM部署的可看§3方法部分
recommendation.en: Incremental trick for multimodal long-video inference, no direct value for LLM pretraining; MLLM deployment teams can check §3 for the method

institutions: Electrical and Computer Engineering, Georgia Institute of Technology, Atlanta

paper.title: X-Stage: An Overlooked Pipeline Stage for Communication-Computation Overlap in DiT Inference
paper.abstract: Fine-grained, device-initiated communication lets persistent GPU kernels in distributed diffusion transformer (DiT) inference issue remote stores and overlap data movement with Tensor Core computation. Existing systems schedule when communication is issued and when received data becomes consumable, but omit post-issue progress before remote-visible completion, making sender backpressure hard to predict.   We identify X-Stage, a software-visible post-issue pipeline stage. Measurements on an eight

summary.core_problem: 在分布式 DiT（Diffusion Transformer）推理中，设备发起的细粒度通信可以与计算重叠。但现有系统在调度时，忽略了通信发出后到远程可见完成之间的状态（即发送端背压），导致无法准确预测和优化通信与计算的重叠效果。
summary.importance: 识别并定义了“X-Stage”——一个软件可见的、通信发出后的流水线阶段。提出了 Burst-Gap 模型来量化和预测发送端背压，为优化细粒度通信与计算的重叠提供了理论基础和调度策略，对提升大规模 DiT 和 MoE 模型的分布式推理效率有重要启发。
summary.technical_approach: 通过微基准测试发现，短时间的远程存储突发（burst）可以在发送端恢复工作时排空，而持续的注入会耗尽未完成容量并导致背压。基于此，提出了 Burst-Gap 模型，使用无背压发出时间、有效排空率和有效未完成容量三个参数来预测背压。在调度层面，针对 MegaMoE，通过交错执行后续波次的 Linear-1 计算和当前波次的 Linear-2 计算，在不改变通信量的情况下重新分配计算，以提供足够的 gap 来排空 burst。
summary.experiments: 在 8 卡 NVIDIA GPU 节点上测试，基于 Burst-Gap 模型的交错调度策略在 84 种配置下，相比 Expert-Wave 基线，实现了 1.18 倍的几何平均加速比和 1.62 倍的最大加速比。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 Introduction 中对 X-Stage 的定义和 Burst-Gap 模型的直观解释（Figure 1），以及方法部分如何将该模型应用于 MegaMoE 的调度优化。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In distributed DiT inference, fine-grained device-initiated communication can overlap with computation. However, existing scheduling systems ignore the state between communication issue and remote-visible completion (i.e., sender backpressure), making it difficult to accurately predict and optimize the overlap.
summary_en.importance: Identifies and defines 'X-Stage', a software-visible post-issue pipeline stage. Proposes the Burst-Gap model to quantify and predict sender backpressure, providing a theoretical foundation and scheduling strategies for optimizing fine-grained communication-computation overlap, which is crucial for improving distributed inference efficiency of large DiT and MoE models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Microbenchmarks reveal that short remote-store bursts drain as the sender resumes work, while sustained injection exhausts outstanding capacity and causes backpressure. Based on this, the Burst-Gap model is proposed, using backpressure-free issue time, effective drain rate, and effective outstanding capacity to predict backpressure. For scheduling in MegaMoE, it interleaves ready Linear-1 work from later waves with Linear-2 work, redistributing computation without changing communication volume to provide sufficient gaps for draining bursts.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on an 8-GPU NVIDIA node, the interleaved scheduling strategy based on the Burst-Gap model achieved a 1.18x geometric-mean speedup and a 1.62x maximum speedup over the Expert-Wave baseline across 84 configurations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Introduction for the definition of X-Stage and the intuitive explanation of the Burst-Gap model (Figure 1), and the method section on how this model is applied to optimize MegaMoE scheduling. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 深入分析了 DiT 推理中 device-initiated communication 的底层机制，对做系统级优化的研究员有启发，只看 §4 的 Burst-Gap 模型即可。
recommendation.en: In-depth analysis of the underlying mechanism of device-initiated communication in DiT inference, inspiring for researchers doing system-level optimization; just read the Burst-Gap model in §4.

paper.title: Leaky Language Models: Stealing Architecture and Inference Optimizations via Per-Token Timing
paper.abstract: This work presents LeakyLMs, a set of attacks that leak proprietary model, architecture, and deployment information from production language models. LeakyLMs is the first to demonstrate that key model and deployment details can be inferred using only token generation timing, even when interacting through remote APIs. LeakyLMs introduces two core attacks. The first attack targets inference optimizations and deployment strategies. For example, our attack detects whether a provider uses speculative

summary.core_problem: LeakyLMs 研究的是一个服务侧信息泄露问题：即使只能通过远程 API 观察流式输出的逐 token 延迟，攻击者也可能推断出模型架构参数和推理优化策略。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对基座研究员的价值主要在 serving 与模型保密边界。它提醒一个现实问题：架构、KV-cache、FlashAttention、投机解码、draft model 上下文长度等部署选择，会在逐 token 延迟中留下可测信号。对于闭源模型评测、API 行为分析、推理系统设计和模型发布策略，这类侧信道不能被当作纯安全细节处理。它也说明 latency trace 不只是系统指标，还可能反推出模型规模与结构信息。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出两类攻击。第一类针对投机解码。投机解码用较小 draft model 先生成若干候选 token，再由主模型验证；若 draft model 在长上下文依赖上失效，接受率会下降，逐 token 延迟模式会变化。LeakyLMs 通过构造需要远距离上下文的信息检索式提示，逐步改变依赖距离，从而判断服务是否使用投机解码，并估计 draft model 的有效上下文窗口。第二类攻击针对架构参数恢复。方法先从 Transformer 计算图出发，分析层数、hidden dimension、attention heads、KV-cache、FlashAttention 等因素对延迟的影响；再用多组配置的实测数据拟合可解释的线性回归时延模型；最后把该模型作为 oracle，在候选架构空间中做 grid search，找出最接近目标逐 token 延迟序列的参数组合。关键技巧是使用相邻 token 的差分延迟，以降低网络抖动和共享系统噪声的影响。
summary.experiments: 论文报告 Gemini Flash 1.5、Flash 2.5、Flash 2.5 Lite 都可被检测出使用投机解码，并估计其 draft model 上下文窗口分别约为 32K、128K、128K tokens。架构恢复实验覆盖 eager Transformer、FlashAttention2、KV-cache 等实现。时延预测器在 eager 实现上的 NRMSE 为 0.12，在使用 FlashAttention2 与 KV caching 的 prefill 时间预测上 NRMSE 为 0.188。层数恢复可达到接近真实值 ±1 的精度；top-5 准确率分别为 86.15%、97.69%、83.78%，对应 eager、FlashAttention2、FlashAttention2 with KV caching 三类设置。论文还展示了对 Weights & Biases 托管未知模型的参数恢复案例，其中 hidden dimension 预测与目标匹配。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25–35 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对逐 token timing channel 的威胁模型定义；再看投机解码攻击部分，重点是如何用长上下文依赖触发 draft/main model 分歧，以及如何从延迟拐点估计 draft context length。架构恢复部分建议看计算图分析和回归特征设计，不必逐行追实验细节。实验部分优先看 Gemini 系列的投机解码检测结果、NRMSE 表格、层数恢复 top-5 结果。若从推理系统角度阅读，最后应关注防御讨论：延迟扰动、批处理、缓存策略和流式输出节奏都可能影响攻击有效性，但也会带来 QoS 成本。

summary_en.core_problem: LeakyLMs studies an inference-side information leakage problem: an external user, interacting only through a remote streaming API, may infer proprietary model architecture and deployment choices from per-token generation timing.
summary_en.importance: The paper is useful for researchers who care about serving, model release, and closed-model measurement. It shows that deployment choices such as speculative decoding, draft-model context length, KV caching, FlashAttention, depth, hidden size, and attention heads can leave measurable signatures in token latency traces. Latency is therefore not only an efficiency metric; it can become a side channel for recovering model and system details.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work introduces two attacks. The first detects speculative decoding and estimates the draft model context window. Since speculative decoding relies on a smaller draft model whose predictions are verified by the main model, prompts that require information beyond the draft model’s context should reduce acceptance and alter the latency pattern. By varying the distance of the relevant context, the attack identifies whether speculative decoding is in use and where the draft-context limit lies. The second attack recovers architectural parameters. It starts with an analysis of the Transformer computation graph to derive how latency depends on depth, hidden dimension, attention heads, KV cache behavior, and FlashAttention-style kernels. The authors then fit an empirical linear timing model over measured configurations and use it as an oracle for grid search over candidate architectures. Differential timing between consecutive tokens is used to reduce shared noise such as network delay.
summary_en.experiments: The reported deployment attack finds evidence that Gemini Flash 1.5, Flash 2.5, and Flash 2.5 Lite use speculative decoding, with estimated draft context windows of roughly 32K, 128K, and 128K tokens. The architecture-recovery experiments cover eager Transformer implementations, FlashAttention2, and FlashAttention2 with KV caching. The timing predictor reaches an NRMSE of 0.12 for eager implementations and 0.188 for prefill-time prediction with FlashAttention2 plus KV caching. Layer-count recovery is typically within ±1 of the true value, with top-5 accuracies of 86.15%, 97.69%, and 83.78% for eager, FlashAttention2, and FlashAttention2 with KV caching, respectively. The paper also includes a case study on an unknown model hosted on Weights & Biases, where the predicted hidden dimension matches the target.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25–35 minute skim is sufficient. Start with the threat model and the discussion of per-token timing as a side channel. Then read the speculative-decoding attack, especially the prompt construction that forces long-context dependence and the method for detecting the draft-context cutoff. For architecture recovery, focus on the computation-graph analysis and the regression features rather than every experimental setting. In the results, prioritize the Gemini speculative-decoding measurements, the NRMSE tables, and the layer-recovery top-5 results. The defense discussion is also useful for serving researchers, since adding jitter, changing batching behavior, or altering streaming cadence may reduce leakage but can hurt latency and user experience.

recommendation.zh: 做推理优化或模型保密的研究员可看，重点看攻击方法和Gemini实测结果，了解推测解码的时序指纹。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming for inference optimization and model security researchers; focus on attack methods and Gemini measurements to understand speculative decoding timing fingerprints.

paper.title: Searching for Task-Specific Vision Paths: Evolutionary Block Pruning Across Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-language models normally execute the same complete vision encoder for every question, even when OCR, counting, object, attribute, and spatial queries may not require identical computation. We study whether fixed-budget combinations of vision blocks can be skipped without fine-tuning. A shared K-block route skips one searched set of exactly K blocks for every question, while a capability-specific K-block policy selects one same-size route using a known capability label. We introduce a sour

summary.core_problem: 研究 VLM 在不同视觉问答能力上是否可以跳过不同 vision encoder block，从而在不微调的情况下减少推理计算。
summary.importance: 贡献是 VLM 视觉侧推理剪枝的小规模实证：从固定完整视觉编码改为任务或能力相关的 block route，对 serving 成本有一定参考，但实验规模偏小。
summary.technical_approach: 提出两种固定预算 block 跳过策略：shared K-block route 对所有问题跳过同一组 K 个 block；capability-specific K-block policy 根据已知能力标签选择同预算 route。用 source-balanced evolutionary search 搜索 route，并与独立排序、连续删除和随机 route 对比。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct、SmolVLM2-2.2B-Instruct 和 876 个样本的 image-disjoint selection split。搜索出的 route 可跨架构迁移：在 SmolVLM2 上，共享四层跳过 route 比独立构造高 4.91 个百分点；能力专门化更不稳定，在 Qwen 上六层 capability policy 优于 shared route，但摘要未给完整指标。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether VLMs can skip different vision-encoder blocks for different visual-question capabilities without fine-tuning, reducing inference compute.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a small empirical study of inference-time vision-side block pruning for VLMs. It is useful for serving-cost intuition, but the evidence is limited by scale and dataset size.
summary_en.technical_approach: It defines two fixed-budget skipping policies: a shared K-block route that removes the same K blocks for all questions, and a capability-specific K-block policy that selects a same-size route using a known capability label. Routes are found with source-balanced evolutionary search and compared to independent ranking, contiguous removal, and random routes.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct, SmolVLM2-2.2B-Instruct, and an 876-example image-disjoint selection split. The searched shared four-block route transfers to SmolVLM2 and beats independent construction by 4.91 percentage points; capability-specific routing is less stable, with a six-block policy outperforming the shared route on Qwen.

recommendation.zh: 小样本效率论文，结论先当弱信号；如果做 VLM serving，只扫 route transfer 和 capability specialization 结果。
recommendation.en: A small-sample efficiency paper; treat the conclusions as weak signal and only scan route transfer and capability-specialized results.

paper.title: DiFA: Inference-Time Forward-Process Alignment for Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: The prevailing inference framework for diffusion models formulates generation fundamentally as a problem of numerical integration. This perspective casts the model as an exact estimator, neglecting the inherent statistical uncertainty of the denoising process. In this work, we propose Forward-Process Aligned Diffusion prediction (\textbf{DiFA}), a training-free framework that reframes inference-time data prediction refinement as a sequential state estimation problem. Rather than reusing past out

summary.core_problem: 现有扩散模型推理框架将生成视为数值积分问题，忽略去噪过程的统计不确定性，导致生成质量受限。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出一种免训练的推理时预测精炼框架 DiFA，将扩散生成重新建模为序列状态估计问题。
summary.technical_approach: 受卡尔曼滤波启发，把反向轨迹上的迭代数据预测视为相关观测，按结构一致性与噪声水平兼容性聚合历史预测形成前向对齐的时序共识；引入偏差引导机制自适应保留残差细节以对抗过平滑。
summary.experiments: 在图像生成任务上验证 DiFA 可在不重新训练的情况下提升扩散模型生成质量，具体指标与 baseline 未在摘要中给出。

summary_en.core_problem: Current diffusion inference frameworks treat generation as numerical integration and ignore the statistical uncertainty of the denoising process, limiting sample quality.
summary_en.importance: Methodological contribution; proposes DiFA, a training-free inference-time prediction refinement framework that reframes diffusion generation as sequential state estimation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Inspired by Kalman filtering, treats iterative predictions along the reverse trajectory as correlated observations and aggregates them by structural consistency and noise-level compatibility to form a forward-aligned temporal consensus; introduces a deviation guidance mechanism to adaptively preserve residual details and counter over-smoothing.
summary_en.experiments: Empirically validated on image generation tasks, showing quality improvements without retraining; specific metrics and baselines are not detailed in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 扩散推理时优化的小创新，对做多模态生成的人有参考，对 LLM 预训练研究员价值有限，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: A minor diffusion inference-time optimization, relevant to multimodal generation researchers but of limited value to LLM pretraining researchers; abstract is sufficient.

paper.title: DiTango: Cost-Effective Parallel Diffusion Generation with Selective Attention State Reuse
paper.abstract: Recent advances in AI-generated content have driven widespread adoption of Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) for high-resolution, long-duration content generation. While parallelization techniques accelerate diffusion inference, they face significant scalability challenges due to excessive communication overhead in multi-node environments.   We observe that sequence partitions in Context Parallelism (CP) exhibit distinct heterogeneity: spatially proximate partitions contribute more significantly to

summary.core_problem: 解决 Diffusion Transformer 在多节点并行推理中，Context Parallelism 因跨分区注意力通信过重而难以扩展的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献属于生成模型推理系统优化。对做统一多模态预训练或关注 DiT serving 的研究员有参考价值，但与 LLM 基座预训练主线距离较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DiTango，通过选择性 attention state reuse 降低通信成本。核心观察是 CP 中不同序列分区对注意力结果贡献不均，空间上更近的分区更重要；据此将异质贡献映射到分层通信拓扑，只精算高贡献分区，低贡献部分复用历史去噪步的状态。系统包含 anchor-guided state selection planner，用于决定哪些状态保留、复用和通信。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、节点数、分辨率、吞吐提升和质量损失。实验大概率在高分辨率图像或长视频 DiT 上，对比标准 context parallel 或并行推理框架，关注多节点扩展效率与生成质量折中。
summary.authors_note: 上海交通大学、上海 AI Lab、清华大学团队。上海 AI Lab 在大模型与生成模型系统方向持续有产出。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the poor scalability of Diffusion Transformer inference under multi-node context parallelism, where cross-partition attention communication becomes the bottleneck.
summary_en.importance: This is a generation-system efficiency contribution. It is relevant if you care about unified multimodal pretraining or DiT serving, but it is not central to LLM pretraining methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach: DiTango introduces selective attention state reuse to reduce communication. The key observation is that sequence partitions in context parallelism contribute unevenly to attention outputs, with spatially nearby partitions mattering more. The system maps this heterogeneity to hierarchical communication topology, computes high-contribution partitions more faithfully, and reuses historical states for lower-contribution parts. An anchor-guided state selection planner decides what to keep, reuse, and communicate.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, node count, resolution, throughput gains, or quality trade-offs. Experiments likely benchmark high-resolution image or long-video DiTs against standard context-parallel inference setups, focusing on multi-node scaling efficiency versus generation quality.
summary_en.authors_note: From Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai AI Laboratory, and Tsinghua University. Shanghai AI Lab has been active in large-model and generative-model systems work.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但“跨步复用注意力状态”这个想法对 DiT serving 有点意思；只看方法图和效率表，别指望它迁移到文本 LM 训练。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the cross-step attention-state reuse idea is mildly interesting for DiT serving; read the method figure and efficiency tables, not the full paper.

institutions: University of Science and Technology Beijing
Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai AI Laboratory

paper.title: Polestar: Drift-Aware Cache Calibration and Token Commitment for Efficient Inference of Diffusion LLMs
paper.abstract: The inference efficiency of diffusion large language models (dLLMs) is constrained by two challenges: bidirectional attention precludes efficient KV-cache reuse, while increasing decoding parallelism with static confidence thresholds can compromise generation quality. We observe that both challenges arise from a shared phenomenon: as tokens are decoded, their contextual integration through bidirectional attention causes token representations to drift (evolve) across decoding steps. This insight

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 diffusion LLM 推理里的两个耦合问题：一是双向注意力导致标准 AR 式 KV-cache 不能直接复用，每一步都要重算；二是为了减少 denoising 步数而做并行 token 提交时，固定阈值往往在不同样本、不同步数下失灵，容易把尚未稳定的 token 过早提交，带来质量下降。论文的关键判断是，这两个问题不是彼此独立的工程细节，而是都来自同一个机制：在迭代去噪过程中，token 表示会因为双向上下文持续重整而发生 drift，旧 cache 之所以失效、token 之所以不能安全提交，都是因为表示还在变。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义不在于训练方法，而在于它把 dLLM 推理中的“缓存有效性”和“提交时机”统一成了一个可测的表示动力学信号。这个视角比只看置信度、attention 热点或固定 block 边界更接近 dLLM 的真实计算结构。若后续有人做 diffusion / masked / any-order LM 的训练-推理协同设计，这篇工作的价值在于给出了一个较清楚的中间量：表示 drift 可以作为推理控制信号，也可能反过来成为训练时的辅助目标、校准目标或 early-exit 信号。就当前工作本身看，它属于推理优化，但对非 AR 语言建模范式的系统化落地有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分成两部分。第一部分是 Polestar-Cache。作者不再把 cache 是否过期交给粗粒度代理信号，而是在每个 decode step、每一层上直接比较 token 输入隐藏状态的变化，用 drift 来判断哪些位置的 KV 已经陈旧，需要刷新。这样做的出发点是：dLLM 中某个 token 即便本身没有被当前步直接更新，它的表示也可能因为周围 token 的去噪进展而显著变化，因此“块外不变”或“少数热点 token 代表全局”的假设都不稳。Polestar-Cache 于是采用稀疏、间歇式的 KV 更新，只刷新 drift 高的位置，其他位置继续复用旧 cache，从而在不完全重算的前提下控制 stale cache 带来的误差。

第二部分是 Polestar-Commit。作者观察到 token drift 在接近最终收敛前会出现尖峰，随后进入稳定区。这个现象被用来判断 token 是否可以提前 commit。和只看 softmax confidence 不同，drift 反映的是表示是否还在被上下文大幅改写，因此更适合 dLLM 这种双向迭代生成。论文据此设计了基于 drift 的提交策略，用来替代或补充静态 confidence threshold。

第三部分是系统实现。因为 drift 计算、cache 选择和刷新本身也有开销，作者做了 CPU offloading 与 latency hiding，把 Polestar 特有的控制逻辑与主干前向尽量重叠，避免“省下的算力又被调度开销吃掉”。这部分虽然是系统细节，但对方法是否真的带来吞吐收益很关键。

和已有方法相比，Fast-dLLM 主要依赖 block-wise cache reuse 与固定阈值提交，假设较强；Elastic-Cache、d2Cache 等方法使用 attention 或 uncertainty 作为代理信号，但没有直接刻画表示随步数和层数的联合演化。Polestar 的区别在于把 drift 当成统一的一阶控制量，同时服务于 cache refresh 和 token commitment。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖多个 dLLM family，以及数学、代码等任务。论文给出的总体结果是：相对已有基线，准确率最高提升 10.73%，平均提升 3.74%；吞吐最高达到 3.7×，平均约 1.6×；平均 decoding parallelism 可到 3.67 tokens per forward。作者强调的是 accuracy-throughput Pareto 改善，而不是只在单一指标上取胜。

从摘要和正文可见，实验重点不是单纯报一个最终分数，而是验证三个链条：第一，drift 是否真能刻画 cache staleness；第二，drift spike 是否与 token 收敛相关；第三，把两者联合起来后，是否比只做 cache 或只做 commit 更好。消融上值得注意的点通常包括：只开 Polestar-Cache、只开 Polestar-Commit、两者同时开启；不同 drift 度量或阈值设置；是否加入系统级 overlap 优化。论文主张其收益来自算法-系统协同，而不是某个单点 trick。

如果精读正文，建议重点核对几类数字：不同模型家族上的稳定性是否一致；长序列或高难样本上吞吐收益是否更明显；在更激进并行提交下，质量退化是否被显著抑制。这些决定它是“普适控制信号”还是“特定配置下有效”。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1/2，先建立问题图景：dLLM 推理慢，不只是因为步数多，也因为双向注意力让 cache 复用变难。然后直接看 Section 3，确认作者如何定义和测量 representational drift，以及它和 cache 失效、token 收敛之间的经验关系。这部分是整篇文章的支点。

接着看 Section 4.1 和 4.2。4.1 关注“哪些 KV 该刷新”，4.2 关注“哪些 token 可以提交”。如果时间有限，可以把公式细节略过，但要看清楚 drift 信号是在层内、步间、token 级别如何被聚合成控制决策的。最后看 Section 5 的 Pareto 图和消融表，判断收益是否来自统一信号而非额外超参堆叠。

预计 30–45 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读。若你做的是 diffusion / masked LM 推理或训练-推理联合设计，值得进一步深挖 Appendix 里关于 drift 现象普遍性的分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets two coupled bottlenecks in diffusion LLM inference: bidirectional attention prevents straightforward AR-style KV-cache reuse, and aggressive parallel token commitment often hurts quality when driven by static confidence thresholds. The central claim is that these are not separate engineering issues. Both stem from the same underlying phenomenon: token representations keep drifting across denoising steps as context is repeatedly re-integrated. Old cache entries become stale for the same reason that some tokens are not yet safe to commit.
summary_en.importance: Its main value for foundation-model researchers is conceptual rather than purely systems-oriented. It reframes cache validity and commitment timing in dLLMs as a shared representation-dynamics problem. That is a cleaner abstraction than block boundaries, attention heuristics, or confidence alone. For future work on diffusion, masked, or any-order language models, this suggests that representational drift could become a general control signal at the train–inference interface: for calibration, adaptive compute, early exit, or even auxiliary training objectives. The current paper is an inference optimization work, but it is relevant because non-AR LMs need this kind of systems grounding to become practical.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has two main components. First, Polestar-Cache uses token-level representational drift to decide where KV-cache entries have become stale and should be refreshed. Instead of assuming that tokens outside the current block remain valid, or relying on coarse proxies such as attention concentration or uncertainty, it directly tracks hidden-state changes across steps and layers. The motivation is specific to dLLMs: even if a token is not explicitly updated at the current step, its representation may still change substantially because neighboring tokens are being denoised under bidirectional attention. Polestar-Cache therefore performs sparse and sporadic KV refreshes only at high-drift positions, while reusing the rest.

Second, Polestar-Commit uses drift as a convergence signal for token commitment. The paper reports that token drift often exhibits a sharp spike near the onset of convergence toward the final output representation, followed by stabilization. This is used to decide when a token can be committed earlier and more safely. Compared with confidence-only policies, drift is better aligned with whether the representation is still being materially rewritten by context, which matters more in iterative bidirectional generation.

Third, the paper includes system-level optimization. Since measuring drift and scheduling refreshes introduce overhead, the implementation uses CPU offloading and latency hiding to overlap Polestar-specific operations with the main forward pass. This matters because many inference-time ideas look good algorithmically but lose their gains once control overhead is included.

Relative to prior work, Fast-dLLM relies on block-wise cache reuse and static commitment thresholds; Elastic-Cache and d2Cache use attention- or uncertainty-based proxies. Polestar’s distinguishing move is to use drift as a unified first-order signal for both cache refresh and token commitment.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation spans multiple diffusion LLM families and reasoning-heavy domains such as math and coding. The headline numbers reported are up to 10.73% accuracy gain over prior baselines, 3.74% on average, up to 3.7× higher throughput, 1.6× on average, and decoding parallelism reaching 3.67 tokens per forward. The paper emphasizes improvement on the accuracy–throughput Pareto frontier rather than a single metric.

The more important experimental story is the validation chain behind those numbers. The paper aims to show: first, that drift is a useful indicator of cache staleness; second, that drift spikes correlate with token convergence; and third, that using drift for both cache refresh and commitment outperforms applying either idea in isolation. The key ablations are therefore likely to be: Polestar-Cache only, Polestar-Commit only, both together, different drift metrics or thresholds, and with versus without the system overlap optimizations.

When reading the full results, the most useful checks are whether gains hold across model families, whether longer generations benefit more, and whether quality degradation under more aggressive parallel commitment is meaningfully reduced. Those details determine whether drift is a robust control signal or a configuration-specific heuristic.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and the first two figures. They frame the real issue well: dLLM inference is slow not only because denoising takes multiple steps, but because bidirectional attention breaks the usual cache reuse assumptions. Then go directly to the section that defines and measures representational drift. That is the conceptual center of the paper, and it is where you can judge whether the method is grounded in model dynamics or just another heuristic.

After that, read the cache and commitment sections together. One answers where stale KV entries should be refreshed; the other answers when tokens can be safely committed. If time is limited, you can skim some formula details, but pay attention to how drift is aggregated across layers, steps, and tokens into actual control decisions. Finish with the Pareto plots and ablation tables to see whether the gains really come from the unified signal rather than extra tuning.

A useful skim should take around 30–45 minutes. If you work on diffusion or masked LMs, the appendix material on the prevalence of drift is worth a closer look.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在看 dLM serving，这篇比一般小修小补更像抓到了真正的控制变量；先看 drift 定义和 cache/commit 两个模块是否共享同一信号。
recommendation.en: If you care about dLM serving, this is more than a minor speed hack: check whether representation drift really is the right shared control variable for both cache reuse and token commitment.

paper.title: TIGER: Text-Conditioned Visual Gated Routing with Acceptance Alignment for Multimodal Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by letting a lightweight drafter propose multiple tokens that are verified by a larger target model. Although effective for text-only LLMs, speculative decoding yields limited gains in VLMs because drafters often diverge on vision-critical content, while existing multimodal acceleration methods do not directly address irrelevant visual evidence or optimize the verifier-accepted prefix length that governs speedup. We propose TIGER, a Text

summary.core_problem: 多模态（尤其含高分辨率视觉 token）的 speculative decoding 很难获得文本 LLM 那样的加速：小 drafter 在“视觉关键 token”（OCR 字符串、计数/数值、指代与关系、 grounded 描述等）上更容易早早偏离大 verifier，导致 verifier 接受的前缀很短，速度收益被抵消。论文要解决的是：在不改变 verifier 分布（保持 lossless 验证）的前提下，如何让 drafter 在多模态场景生成更长的可接受块（accepted prefix），从而真正提升端到端吞吐。
summary.importance:
对基座预训练的直接影响有限，更偏推理侧系统与训练目标设计；但它给了两个对“训练—推理闭环”有用的启发：
1) 把训练目标从“拟合分布/蒸馏”转到“直接优化推理时的关键运行量”（accepted prefix length），属于典型的 post-train 信号反哺推理效率；这类思路可迁移到长上下文、工具调用、结构化输出等场景。
2) 多模态小模型的失败往往不是容量不足这么简单，而是“给了不该看的视觉证据”导致噪声与分歧；用文本状态条件化的视觉证据路由，提供了一种比固定压缩接口更细粒度的视觉 token 预算分配方式。
整体贡献量级：属于把 speculative decoding 真正落到 VLM 的工程化方法论文，价值在于目标函数与路由接口的组合，而不是提出新的预训练范式。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由两块组成，分别对应“看什么”和“怎么训”。

(1) Text-conditioned Visual Gated Routing（看什么）：
- 设 vision encoder 产生视觉 token bank V（r 个 token）。传统做法要么把全量 V 给 drafter（贵且噪声大），要么用固定压缩/适配器给一个静态接口（对不同解码阶段不够自适应）。
- TIGER 在每个 speculative round j，用 drafter 当前的文本状态（prefix embedding / decoder state）作为条件，对视觉 token 做稀疏选择，得到 V_j^{route} 作为 drafter 的视觉接口。直觉是：下一段要生成的 token 只需要与当前语义相关的一小部分视觉证据（例如当前在读图表某个区域、或 OCR 某行），其余 token 只会增加 drafter 的不确定性与与 verifier 的分歧。
- 这种“按解码阶段动态路由视觉 token”的设计，和固定的视觉压缩（例如固定数量的视觉 query）相比，核心差异是：预算分配随文本状态变化，且目标是减少 drafter/verifier 的分歧而非仅压缩计算。

(2) Acceptance Alignment（怎么训）：
- 论文指出：多模态 speculative decoding 的速度主要由 verifier 接受的前缀长度决定，但常规蒸馏/模仿学习优化的是 token-level 似然或 KL，对 accepted prefix 这个离散运行量并不敏感。
- 训练流程：先用知识蒸馏 warm-start drafter，保证基本行为稳定；再进入 acceptance-aligned 阶段：对同一输入采样多个 draft continuations，运行标准 speculative decoding 的 verifier acceptance test（保持“lossless”验证逻辑），把“被接受的前缀长度”作为奖励信号，做 group-based policy optimization（类似用 verifier 作为可计算的监督/奖励源，而非人类偏好或 learned RM）。
- 为了稳定：加入 KL anchoring 防止策略漂移（drafter 过度追求某些模式导致整体分布偏离，反而降低可接受性或质量）。

关键取舍：
- 不去改 verifier，也不牺牲正确性（仍用标准 acceptance test），把所有可控变量放在 drafter 的可见视觉证据与训练目标上。
- 相比“让 drafter 更大/更强”这种线性堆算力的方案，TIGER 试图用更好的信息接口 + 更贴近推理指标的训练信号来换 accepted prefix。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文片段只能确认实验覆盖“多类多模态基准（OCR-heavy、counting、grounded reasoning 等）”，并且报告了三类指标：
1) verifier-accepted prefix length 变长；
2) target-model decoding work 减少；
3) 端到端 speculative decoding speedup 提升，同时保持任务准确率。

但当前提供的内容未包含具体表格/数字（例如：drafter/verifier 参数规模、视觉 token 路由的稀疏率、平均接受长度提升多少、吞吐提升多少、各基准上的准确率差异与方差）。因此无法在不臆测的情况下给出精确提升幅度。

建议在精读时重点核对：
- speedup 的定义（是否包含路由开销、是否计入 vision encoder、是否按 wall-clock 还是按 verifier step）；
- acceptance length 的统计方式（平均/分位数、按 block γ 的归一化）；
- 与强基线的对比（全视觉 token drafter、固定压缩接口、仅蒸馏不做 acceptance alignment 等）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction 里对“VLM speculative decoding 为何不加速”的诊断：它把问题落在 vision-critical token 与 accepted prefix 上，这个 framing 决定了后续设计。
- Method 重点抓两处：
  1) 路由模块如何用文本状态选择视觉 token（选择机制、稀疏度/预算、是否可微、是否引入额外注意力层）。
  2) acceptance-aligned 训练的具体优化形式：奖励如何定义、group-based 更新怎么做、KL anchoring 的实现细节、采样与验证的计算开销。
- 实验部分优先看：accepted prefix length 与端到端吞吐的对应关系图/表；以及消融（仅路由/仅 alignment/两者叠加）。

如果你的关注点是 pretrain：把它当作“用可计算 verifier 信号做训练目标”的案例，思考能否把类似信号迁移到预训练/中期训练的课程或数据选择上；但不要期待它提供新的 scaling law 或数据配比结论。

summary_en.core_problem: Multimodal speculative decoding often fails to deliver meaningful speedups because a small drafter diverges early on vision-critical tokens (OCR strings, numbers, counting, grounded attributes/relations). Early divergence shortens the verifier-accepted prefix, which is the actual runtime driver of speculative decoding gains. The paper targets a lossless setup (standard verifier acceptance test) and asks how to make the drafter produce longer accepted blocks in VLM decoding.
summary_en.importance:
This is primarily an inference-time acceleration + training-objective paper rather than a pretraining contribution. Still, it offers two reusable ideas for foundation-model researchers:
1) Replace “distill to match logits” with an objective that directly optimizes the runtime quantity that matters (accepted prefix length). This is a concrete example of closing the train–inference loop using a computable verifier signal.
2) In VLMs, drafter/verifier mismatch is often driven by exposing the drafter to irrelevant/noisy visual evidence. Text-state-conditioned routing is a more adaptive alternative to fixed visual compression interfaces.
Overall impact is practical: making speculative decoding more viable for VLM serving without modifying the verifier distribution.
summary_en.technical_approach:
TIGER combines (a) an adaptive visual interface for the drafter and (b) acceptance-aligned drafter training.

(a) Text-conditioned Visual Gated Routing:
- A vision encoder produces a visual token bank V (r tokens). Instead of feeding the full V to the drafter or using a fixed compressed adapter, TIGER selects a sparse subset V_j^{route} at each speculative round j.
- The selection is conditioned on the drafter’s current textual state (prefix embedding/decoder state), aiming to expose only the visual evidence needed for the next speculative block. The goal is not just compute reduction, but reducing drafter/verifier divergence on the upcoming tokens.

(b) Acceptance Alignment training:
- The paper argues that standard distillation optimizes imitation quality, while speculative decoding efficiency is governed by the verifier-accepted prefix length.
- Training pipeline: warm-start the drafter via knowledge distillation; then sample multiple draft continuations, run the standard verifier acceptance test, and use accepted prefix length as a reward signal for group-based policy optimization.
- KL anchoring is used to prevent policy drift and stabilize optimization.

Key design choice: keep the verifier and acceptance test unchanged (lossless), and move all adaptation into the drafter’s visual evidence budget and objective.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text excerpt, the evaluation spans diverse multimodal benchmarks (OCR-heavy, counting/numerical, grounded reasoning) and reports: longer accepted prefixes, reduced verifier decoding work, and higher end-to-end speedup while preserving task accuracy.

However, the excerpt does not include the concrete numbers/tables (model sizes, routed token budget, acceptance-length deltas, wall-clock speedups, accuracy changes). Without those sections, it’s not possible to quote exact gains reliably.

When checking the paper, validate: (i) how speedup is measured (wall-clock vs verifier steps; whether routing/vision encoding is included), (ii) acceptance-length statistics (mean vs tail), and (iii) ablations separating routing vs acceptance alignment.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Read the Introduction for the failure analysis: “vision-critical tokens” + “accepted prefix length” as the bottleneck.
- In Method, focus on (1) how routing selects visual tokens conditioned on text state (budget, sparsity, overhead), and (2) the exact acceptance-aligned optimization (reward definition, group-based update, KL anchoring, sampling/verification cost).
- In Experiments, prioritize the plots/tables linking accepted prefix length to end-to-end throughput, plus ablations (routing only vs alignment only vs both).

If your main interest is pretraining, treat this as a case study of using a verifier-derived, fully automatic signal to optimize a deployment metric, rather than as a new pretraining recipe.

recommendation.zh: 多模态 spec decode 一直缺干净做法，这篇把瓶颈明确落在 accepted prefix 和视觉 token 暴露方式上；先看路由设计和 acceptance reward，别急着信总加速数字。
recommendation.en: Multimodal speculative decoding has lacked a clean formulation; this paper usefully pins the bottleneck on accepted-prefix length and visual-token exposure. Read the routing design and acceptance reward first, but do not over-trust the headline speedups.

paper.title: STEEL: Sparsity-Aware Fused Attention for Energy-Efficient Long-Sequence Inference on AMD's XDNA NPU
paper.abstract: The growing adoption of large language model-based agents within operating system workflows has increased the importance of energy-efficient inference on laptop-class systems-on-chip (SoCs). While cloud offloading remains common, it introduces reliability and privacy concerns that are particularly problematic for agentic workloads. Recent laptop SoCs, therefore, incorporate neural processing engines (NPUs) optimized for energy efficiency; however, effectively mapping attention mechanisms onto NP

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是：如何把长上下文 prefill attention，尤其是 FlashAttention 这一类 IO-aware 算法，真正落到 AMD XDNA 这类显式数据搬运、空间数据流驱动的 NPU 上，并在因果掩码导致的负载不均下仍保持高吞吐和低能耗。问题不在于再发明一种 attention 公式，而在于把已有算法重写成适合 NPU tile 阵列执行的数据流程序。对这类硬件，算子性能往往不是由 FLOPs 决定，而是由片上缓冲、tile 间同步、DMA 调度和流水线失衡决定。作者抓住的核心矛盾是：标准 FlashAttention 的分块计算在 GPU 上天然受益于 SIMT 和高带宽内存，但在 XDNA 上如果直接照搬，会被 causal mask 造成的三角形工作量分布拖垮，前后级 tile 等待严重，能效优势也出不来。
summary.importance: 对基座模型研究本身，它不是训练范式论文，但对长上下文推理和端侧部署有直接启发。价值主要有三层。第一，它说明 attention 优化不能只停留在算法层，必须和目标硬件的数据流模型一起设计；同样叫 FlashAttention，在 GPU、CPU、NPU 上的最优实现完全不是一回事。第二，它把“稀疏性”用在了执行映射而不是模型结构上：这里利用的是 causal mask 带来的结构化空算区，去做流水线放置和负载均衡，这对后续做 block-sparse attention、sliding-window attention、prefix-cache 之类的硬件映射都有参考意义。第三，它给出了一组较完整的 edge SoC 对比：同一台 Ryzen AI 平台上比较 NPU、CPU、GPU 的 attention latency 与 energy，这种系统级证据比单看 kernel benchmark 更有用。局限也很明确：它主要覆盖 prefill，不涉及 decode 阶段的 KV-cache 主导瓶颈；而且结论强依赖 XDNA 风格架构，可迁移的是方法论，不是具体 schedule。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，STEEL做了三件事。

第一件，是把 prefill attention 重写成适合 XDNA AIE 阵列的三阶段数据流流水线。论文沿用 FlashAttention 的在线 softmax 思路，不显式物化完整 attention matrix，而是按 tile 逐块计算 QK^T、维护每行的 running max 与归一化项，再与 V 累积得到输出。不同点在于，作者不是把它当作单 kernel，而是拆成可分布到多个 AIE tile 的 producer-consumer pipeline。按文中描述，这个 pipeline 将矩阵乘、归一化统计更新、以及后续与 V 的累积等步骤分散到不同阶段，并通过显式数据布局和片上缓冲传递中间量，尽量避免回写外存。

第二件，是数据布局与工作切分的联合设计。XDNA 这类 NPU 的关键不是线程块，而是 tile 上本地存储和 tile 间流式通信。作者针对 Q/K/V 的 tile 化、转置/重排、以及中间统计量的存放做了专门布局，使得每一级都能以较规则的块访问推进。这里的重点不是数学新意，而是把 FlashAttention 中“在线归一化必须跨 tile 保持数值正确”这件事，转成硬件上可流水执行的状态传递问题。论文还强调了与 layer-by-layer 实现的区别：后者把 attention 拆成多个独立算子，频繁落地中间结果；STEEL 则把这些步骤融合成一个持续流动的数据通路。

第三件，也是论文最有信息量的点，是 sparsity-aware pipeline placement。因果掩码使得不同 query block 对应的有效 key block 数量不同，靠近序列开头的块工作量小，靠近结尾的块工作量大。如果按均匀方式把 block 分给流水线阶段或 tile，会出现后段拥塞、前段空转和同步等待。作者利用这种由 causal mask 诱导出的三角形稀疏结构，重新安排 block 在 pipeline 中的位置和分配，使各阶段负载更接近均衡。文中给出的结果是，相比 uniform placement，这一策略单独带来 38% latency reduction。这个点值得注意，因为它不是传统意义上的 sparse attention，而是“对已知结构性空区的执行级利用”。

此外，论文还强调可移植性：同一套数据流 formulation 可以迁移到多代 XDNA-like 架构，并在 XDNA 1 上超过此前 DATO 的实现。这里的可移植不是源码无改动，而是算法分解与流水线组织方式具有架构族层面的复用性。
summary.experiments:
实验部分最有用的是三组对比。

第一组，是同平台异构对比。作者在 AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 上，把 XDNA 2 NPU 上的 STEEL 与 12 个 Zen5 CPU 核、以及 RDNA 3.5 GPU 上的 FlashAttention 做比较。结论是平均能耗相对 CPU 降低 9.17×，相对 GPU 降低 1.75×。这说明在长序列 prefill 这一段，NPU 的能效优势是实打实的，不只是理论上更省电。

第二组，是与朴素 NPU 实现对比。相较于 XDNA 2 上按层分解的 attention 实现，STEEL 平均达到 22.8× speedup。这个数字很大，反映的不是小幅 kernel 优化，而是 fused dataflow 与 layer-by-layer 执行模型之间的代差：前者减少了大量中间张量落地和重复搬运。

第三组，是与已有 XDNA 方案对比。在 XDNA 1 上，STEEL 相比此前 DATO 的 FlashAttention 实现平均降低 latency 9.6×。再结合文中强调的 portability，这说明作者的方法不是只对最新硬件吃红利，而是对这一类架构的映射方式确实更合适。

消融里最关键的是 sparsity-aware placement，相比 uniform placement 带来 38% latency reduction。这个消融直接支撑论文主张：真正拖慢 NPU attention 的不只是算力不够，而是 causal mask 造成的负载不平衡和同步开销。

从研究者角度，实验仍有几个缺口。论文摘要和正文片段主要聚焦 prefill，没有看到 decode/KV-cache 场景的系统分析；也没有看到与更广泛长上下文变体，如 paged attention、block-sparse attention 的组合实验。如果关注 serving 全链路，需要把这些空白补上。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：先看 Introduction 和贡献列表，明确它不是在改 attention 数学，而是在改执行数据流。然后重点看方法部分里对 FlashAttention 分解、三阶段 pipeline、以及 causal mask 下负载失衡的分析。最值得看的图表通常会是：1）pipeline/dataflow 示意图；2）不同 placement 策略的时间线或 tile 利用率图；3）NPU/CPU/GPU 的 latency-energy 对比表。阅读时间大约 20 到 30 分钟。

如果只抓一个点，就抓 sparsity-aware pipeline placement。它解释了为什么同样是 fused attention，实现好坏不只取决于算子融合，还取决于是否把因果掩码带来的不规则工作量显式纳入调度。

如果做系统或推理优化，可以进一步深挖两件事：一是在线 softmax 的状态如何在 tile 间传递并保持数值稳定；二是这种数据流 formulation 能否扩展到 decode、MQA/GQA、或 block-sparse/prefix-sharing 场景。
summary.authors_note: AMD 相关团队工作，围绕 Ryzen AI / XDNA NPU 软件栈与 kernel 实现展开。摘要与正文可确认是 AMD 生态和 XDNA 平台导向的系统论文；具体作者背景在给定内容里未完整列出。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a deployment problem rather than a new attention formula: how to map long-context prefill attention, specifically a FlashAttention-style IO-aware algorithm, onto AMD XDNA NPUs whose execution model is based on explicit data movement and spatial dataflow. The hard part is that a direct port of GPU-style FlashAttention does not fit this hardware well. On XDNA-like NPUs, performance is dominated by local memory usage, tile-to-tile synchronization, DMA scheduling, and pipeline balance. Causal masking makes the workload triangular, so a naive uniform mapping leaves some tiles idle while others become bottlenecks. STEEL is designed to turn attention into a hardware-native streaming pipeline that preserves FlashAttention’s online softmax semantics while avoiding those imbalance costs.
summary_en.importance: For foundation-model researchers, this is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is relevant to long-context inference and edge serving. Its main contribution is methodological: attention optimization is hardware-specific all the way down to the execution schedule. A FlashAttention kernel that is excellent on GPUs is not automatically a good design for NPUs. A second useful point is how the paper uses sparsity. It does not introduce sparse attention at the model level; instead, it exploits the structured empty region induced by the causal mask to improve pipeline placement and reduce synchronization overhead. That idea is likely transferable to other structured-attention settings. Third, the paper provides a system-level comparison across NPU, CPU, and GPU on the same Ryzen AI platform, which is more informative than isolated kernel throughput numbers. The limitation is also clear: the scope is mainly prefill, not decode, so it does not address the KV-cache-dominated serving regime.
summary_en.technical_approach:
STEEL has three main components.

First, it reformulates prefill attention as a three-stage dataflow pipeline over XDNA AI Engine tiles. The algorithm keeps the core FlashAttention idea: compute attention block by block, maintain online softmax statistics instead of materializing the full score matrix, and accumulate the output incrementally. The novelty is in how this is decomposed for a spatial NPU. Rather than treating attention as one monolithic kernel, the computation is split into pipeline stages that can run on different tiles with explicit producer-consumer communication through on-chip buffers.

Second, the implementation jointly designs tiling and data layout. On XDNA-like hardware, the critical resource is not just arithmetic throughput but how Q, K, V tiles and intermediate statistics move through local memories and streams. The paper restructures the computation so that the running max and normalization terms required by online softmax can be propagated correctly across tiles without repeatedly spilling large intermediates to external memory. This is the key difference from a layer-by-layer implementation, where attention is broken into separate operators and intermediate tensors are materialized between them.

Third, and most interestingly, STEEL introduces sparsity-aware pipeline placement. Because of causal masking, different query blocks interact with different numbers of key blocks. Early query blocks have less valid work; later ones have more. A uniform placement therefore creates severe load imbalance and synchronization stalls. STEEL explicitly accounts for this triangular workload pattern when assigning work to pipeline stages and tiles. The paper reports that this placement strategy alone reduces latency by 38% relative to uniform placement. This is an execution-level use of structured sparsity, not a modeling change.

The paper also argues for portability across multiple XDNA-like generations. The claim is not that the exact code is universally portable, but that the decomposition and pipeline organization are reusable across this architecture family.
summary_en.experiments:
The most useful results come from three comparisons.

First, on an AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370, STEEL on the XDNA 2 NPU is compared against FlashAttention on 12 Zen5 CPU cores and the RDNA 3.5 GPU. The reported average energy reduction is 9.17x versus CPU and 1.75x versus GPU. That is a meaningful system-level result for long-sequence prefill.

Second, against a layer-by-layer attention implementation on XDNA 2, STEEL achieves an average 22.8x speedup. This large gap indicates that fused dataflow execution matters much more than small kernel-level tuning on this class of hardware.

Third, on XDNA 1, STEEL reduces latency by 9.6x on average relative to the previous DATO FlashAttention implementation. That supports the portability claim and suggests the gain is not limited to one specific chip generation.

The key ablation is the sparsity-aware placement strategy, which gives a 38% latency reduction over uniform placement. This directly validates the paper’s main systems argument: causal-mask-induced imbalance and synchronization overhead are first-order bottlenecks on NPUs.

What is missing from a broader serving perspective is decode-time analysis, KV-cache-heavy workloads, and combinations with other long-context serving techniques such as paged attention or block-sparse variants.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, start with the introduction and the contribution bullets to frame the paper correctly: it is about execution mapping, not a new attention objective. Then focus on the method section that explains the FlashAttention decomposition, the three-stage pipeline, and the source of load imbalance under causal masking. The most informative figures are likely the pipeline/dataflow diagram, any tile-utilization or timeline visualization, and the latency-energy comparison across NPU, CPU, and GPU. Expected reading time is about 20 to 30 minutes.

If you only keep one idea, keep the sparsity-aware pipeline placement. It explains why fused attention on NPUs is not just about operator fusion; it is about scheduling around the triangular work pattern created by the causal mask.

If your interest is systems or inference optimization, the two details worth digging into are how online-softmax state is propagated across tiles while preserving numerical correctness, and whether the same formulation can be extended to decode, MQA/GQA, or structured sparse attention.
summary_en.authors_note: Industry work centered on AMD’s Ryzen AI / XDNA NPU stack and kernel implementation. The provided content clearly places it in the AMD ecosystem, but the full author list and individual backgrounds are not fully visible in the supplied text.

recommendation.zh: 端侧长上下文会受这种 kernel 约束；skim dataflow 和 causal-mask placement，性能数字缺失前别过度外推。
recommendation.en: Edge long-context inference will hit these kernel constraints; skim the dataflow and causal-mask placement, but do not extrapolate without the full numbers.

paper.title: Trees from Marginals: Autoregressive drafting with factorized priors
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding greatly increases the interactivity of autoregressive language models by trading off computation for extra tokens generated in a single forward pass. Factorized draft models are especially efficient because they predict future-token marginals in parallel, but their independence assumption causes acceptance rates to degrade sharply as the speculative budget grows. We analyze this limitation and introduce Weaver, a lightweight autoregressive adapter that constructs proposal tr

summary.core_problem: 解决 factorized draft model 在 speculative decoding 中因未来 token 独立假设过强而导致 acceptance rate 随预算增长快速下降的问题。
summary.importance: 这是推理效率工作，但切中一个真实痛点：并行 draft 很快，却因为忽略条件依赖而在长 speculative budget 下失效。对做 serving、推测解码、以及非 Transformer 架构部署的人有实际参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Weaver：在 factorized drafter 给出的 top-K future-token marginals 基础上，加一个轻量 autoregressive adapter 来构造 proposal tree，从而恢复候选 token 间的条件依赖，但避免完整词表投影的成本。系统侧又为 Gated Delta Net 层推导了 rollback-free 的 tree verification 算法，并在 SGLang 中实现优化 CUDA kernel。方法是模型侧和系统侧联合设计，不只是 kernel trick。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告相对标准 autoregressive decoding 达到 4.37× 加速，并超过高度优化的 DFlash baseline。重点实验应是随 speculative budget 增大时 acceptance rate 的退化对比，以及在 Gated Delta Net 架构上的验证。未给出模型参数与数据规模，说明论文更偏 serving/decoding 系统。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the sharp acceptance-rate drop in speculative decoding with factorized draft models, caused by overly strong independence assumptions over future tokens.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper, but it targets a real bottleneck: parallel drafting is fast yet breaks down at larger speculative budgets because it ignores conditional structure. It is useful for serving, speculative decoding, and deployment of non-standard architectures.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces Weaver, a lightweight autoregressive adapter that builds proposal trees from top-K future-token marginals predicted by a factorized drafter. This restores conditional dependencies among proposed tokens without paying for a full-vocabulary projection. On the systems side, it derives a rollback-free tree-verification algorithm for Gated Delta Net layers and implements optimized CUDA kernels in SGLang.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports a 4.37× speedup over autoregressive decoding and better performance than a highly optimized DFlash baseline. The key experiments likely focus on acceptance-rate degradation as speculative budget grows and on verification efficiency for Gated Delta Net models. No model or data scale is given, consistent with a serving-oriented paper.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 serving，这篇比一般 speculative decoding 小修小补更扎实：问题定义很准，先看 acceptance 随 budget 崩塌的分析，再看 rollback-free verification。
recommendation.en: If serving matters to you, this is more than a minor speculative-decoding tweak: read the analysis of acceptance collapse with larger budgets, then the rollback-free verification piece.

paper.title: Cache Merging as a Convergent Replicated State for Multi-Agent Latent Reasoning
paper.abstract: Multi-agent latent reasoning composes agents' KV-caches into one context for a final agent. Prior work (Agent Primitives) does this by concatenating caches along the sequence axis with RoPE re-encoding, which we call BagMerge. BagMerge is non-commutative, and the best input ordering is unpredictable, shifting with the regime, the latent-step budget, and the model scale. We make this exchange a convergent replicated state. First, CanonicalMerge fixes the layout by content: ordering caches by mean

summary.core_problem: 解决多智能体潜推理中现有KV缓存拼接方法（BagMerge）非交换、输入顺序影响合并结果且不可预测的问题
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次将多智能体缓存合并建模为收敛复制状态，实现了顺序无关的字节级一致缓存合并
summary.technical_approach: 提出CanonicalMerge策略，按Transformer中间层的K向量均值范数对各智能体的KV缓存排序，消除输入顺序影响；进一步将缓存抽象为内容寻址的潜片段集合（满足CvRDT的交换/结合/幂等/吸收性），CanonicalMerge为该集合的确定性渲染函数
summary.experiments: 在Qwen3-1.7B和Qwen3-4B模型上，算法验证N≤5时的排列不变性，实际推理中实现任意输入排列下的字节级相同合并缓存；未提及下游任务性能对比

summary_en.core_problem: Resolve the non-commutativity and unpredictable order sensitivity of existing BagMerge KV-cache concatenation in multi-agent latent reasoning
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation; first models multi-agent cache merging as a convergent replicated state, enabling order-invariant byte-identical cache merging
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes CanonicalMerge, which sorts per-agent KV-caches by mean K-norm at a middle Transformer layer to eliminate order dependence; further abstracts cache state as a set of content-addressed latent fragments (a CvRDT with commutativity, associativity, idempotence, absorption), with CanonicalMerge as its deterministic render
summary_en.experiments: Verifies algorithmic permutation invariance for arity N≤5, and bit-for-bit identical merged caches under arbitrary input permutations on Qwen3-1.7B and 4B models; no downstream task performance comparisons reported

recommendation.zh: 关注KV-cache复用与顺序无关合并的可看排序策略设计，其余偏分布式系统理论，对预训练直接帮助有限，仅浏览核心方法即可
recommendation.en: Useful for researchers exploring KV-cache reuse and order-invariant merging; mostly distributed systems theory otherwise, skim only the core method section.

paper.title: BlockPilot: Instance-Adaptive Policy Learning for Diffusion-based Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates inference by using a lightweight draft model to generate candidate tokens in parallel, and are then verified by the target model, enabling lossless acceleration. Recently, diffusion-based speculative decoding further improves parallelism by generating multiple tokens per forward pass via block-level diffusion, achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance. However, existing methods adopt a fixed inference block size and assume a uniform optimal decoding strategy

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 diffusion-based speculative decoding 里一个此前被当作静态超参数的问题：block size 应不应该对所有样本固定。现有方法通常沿用训练时的固定 block size，在推理时对所有输入一刀切；但全文的实验表明，不同样本的最优 block size 差异明显，而且这个选择会直接影响 acceptance length、target model 验证开销和最终 wall-clock speedup。论文要解决的核心问题不是再造一个更强的 draft model，而是在不改 target / draft / verifier 主体框架的前提下，学习一个样本自适应的 decoding policy，让每个输入在 prefilling 之后选择更合适的并行生成粒度。
summary.importance: 对基座研究员来说，价值主要不在 diffusion draft 本身，而在一个更普遍的结论：推理策略也是可学习对象，不一定只能靠离线手调。这里作者把“固定并行度”改写成“条件化策略选择”，而且证明最优动作分布具有局部性，因而可以用很轻的分类器近似。这个思路对 speculative decoding、early exit、adaptive compute、dynamic depth 甚至 chunked generation 都有启发。量级上，它不是改写范式的工作，但属于把已有高性能推理框架再往前推一步的实用改进，尤其适合已经部署 DFlash 一类 block diffusion speculative decoding 的系统。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 BlockPilot，一个在 prefilling 结束后只调用一次的 block-size policy predictor。作者先做了系统性的 block size sweep，发现样本级最优 block size 并不固定，但大多集中在训练 block size 附近，而不是在整个大动作空间里发散。基于这个观察，作者把问题定义成局部离散动作空间上的分类，而不是在线搜索或强化学习。

状态表示方面，BlockPilot 不读取整段 hidden states，也不引入额外的复杂序列编码器，而是直接使用 target model 在 prefilling 后“最后一个 token 的预测分布”作为当前解码状态表征。作者的理由是，这个分布已经通过自回归注意力聚合了完整上下文，既反映当前不确定性，也隐含后续 continuation 的稳定性，因此能预测可接受的并行长度。动作空间则围绕训练 block size 构造一个局部候选集合，避免大范围搜索带来的标注和部署成本。

从系统集成角度，这个设计很克制：不改 target model，不改 diffusion draft，不改 verification 机制，只是在正式解码前增加一次轻量决策。也就是说，它学习的是“用什么 block size 跑现有框架”，而不是“重新训练一个新的 speculative decoder”。这和很多通过增强 draft quality 来提速的方法不同，BlockPilot 把增益来源放在 policy selection 上。

从全文叙述看，作者还强调了 locality 的方法论意义：如果最优 block size 在全局上高度离散，策略学习会退化成高噪声的难问题；但当最优值集中在训练点附近时，问题就更像 calibration + routing。这个假设是方法成立的关键，也解释了为什么一个轻量 predictor 就能工作。
summary.experiments:
实验重点有三层。第一层是现象验证：作者在多个代表性数据集上对不同 block size 做 sweep，证明固定策略与样本最优策略之间存在稳定 gap，而且默认训练 block size 只对一部分样本最优。第二层是分布分析：最优 block size 呈现明显局部结构，集中在训练配置附近，这为局部分类器提供了依据。第三层是端到端收益：在 Qwen3-4B、temperature=1 的设置下，BlockPilot 达到 5.92 的 acceptance length 和 4.20× speedup。按摘要和引言给出的表述，这个结果是在现有 diffusion-based speculative decoding 框架上进一步提升，而不是替换底层方法。

从应关注的实验维度看，最关键的不是单个 speedup 数字，而是：1）不同数据集/任务上 block-size 最优值的方差有多大；2）policy predictor 的额外开销是否足够小，能否被 speedup 增益覆盖；3）在不同 temperature 下 acceptance 与速度的关系是否稳定；4）局部动作空间如果放宽或收窄，性能如何变化。如果正文里给了 predictor 输入特征、类别数、训练标签构造方式和错误案例，这些部分比主表更值得看，因为它们决定方法是否能迁移到别的 speculative decoding 框架。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先看引言里的问题设定和 Fig.1/2，确认它工作的边界：它不是新的 diffusion LM，也不是新的 verifier，而是给现有 block diffusion speculative decoding 加一个自适应策略层。然后重点看 block size sweep 和最优 block size 分布图，这部分决定整篇论文是否成立。若这些图显示 locality 很强，后面的分类建模就顺理成章；若 locality 弱，方法的普适性就会打折。

接着看方法部分里状态表示和动作空间设计。重点判断两个问题：为什么最后一个 token 的 predictive distribution 足够；为什么只做一次 prefilling 后决策，而不是在线逐步调整。最后看主结果表和消融，尤其是 predictor 开销、不同 block 候选集、不同模型/数据集迁移性。预计 20–30 分钟可以完成有效泛读；若你在做 speculative decoding 或 adaptive inference，建议把实验部分连同附录一起看完。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a neglected control variable in diffusion-based speculative decoding: whether block size should remain fixed for all inputs at inference time. Existing methods typically inherit a single block size from training and apply it uniformly, but the full paper argues that this is suboptimal because the best block size varies across samples and strongly affects acceptance length, verification cost, and end-to-end speedup. The core problem is therefore not to build a better draft model, but to learn an input-adaptive decoding policy that selects a better parallel generation granularity after prefilling, without changing the target model, the diffusion draft model, or the verifier.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining and systems researchers, the main value is the broader lesson that inference policy can itself be learned rather than hand-tuned as a static hyperparameter. The paper reframes fixed parallelism as conditional policy selection, and shows that the optimal action distribution has a local structure, which makes lightweight prediction feasible. That idea is relevant beyond diffusion speculative decoding: it connects to adaptive compute, dynamic depth, early exit, and other routing-style inference decisions. This is not a paradigm-shifting modeling paper, but it is a practical systems improvement that can matter if one already uses block-diffusion speculative decoding frameworks such as DFlash.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, BlockPilot, is a lightweight block-size policy predictor invoked once after prefilling. The authors first run systematic block-size sweeps and show two empirical facts: the sample-wise optimal block size is not constant, and for most samples it lies near the training block size rather than anywhere in a large global action space. This motivates a local discrete classification problem instead of online search or a heavier RL-style controller.

For state representation, BlockPilot does not consume the full hidden-state sequence or add a complex sequence encoder. Instead, it uses the target model’s predictive distribution for the final token after prefilling. The paper argues that this distribution already aggregates full-context information through autoregressive attention, so it captures both local uncertainty and the stability of the upcoming continuation. The action space is then defined as a small neighborhood around the training block size, which keeps labeling and deployment simple.

A notable design choice is how conservative the integration is. The method does not modify the target model, the diffusion draft model, or the verification procedure. It only decides which block size to use before decoding starts. In other words, the gain comes from policy selection on top of an existing speculative decoding stack, not from improving draft quality itself.

The paper also leans heavily on the locality observation. If optimal block sizes were globally scattered, policy learning would be noisy and brittle. Because they cluster around the training configuration, the problem becomes closer to calibration and routing, which explains why a small predictor can work at all.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments have three main parts. First, the paper validates the phenomenon through block-size sweeps on multiple datasets, showing a persistent gap between a fixed default policy and sample-wise optimal choices. Second, it analyzes the distribution of optimal block sizes and finds a clear local concentration around the training configuration. Third, it reports end-to-end gains on top of existing diffusion-based speculative decoding. The headline number given in the paper is an acceptance length of 5.92 and a 4.20× speedup on Qwen3-4B at temperature 1.

The most important things to inspect are not just the headline speedup, but the supporting details: how large the variance of optimal block size is across tasks, whether the predictor overhead is negligible relative to the gain, how robust the policy is under different temperatures, and how sensitive performance is to the width of the local action space. If the full paper includes ablations on predictor inputs, label construction, and failure cases, those are more informative than the main table because they determine whether the approach can transfer to other speculative decoding setups.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and the first figures to pin down the scope: this is not a new diffusion LM or a new verifier, but an adaptive policy layer for existing block-diffusion speculative decoding. Then go directly to the block-size sweep results and the plots of optimal block-size distributions. Those figures are the foundation of the paper. If the locality pattern is strong, the classification formulation is justified; if not, the method becomes much less convincing.

Next, read the method section with two questions in mind: why is the final-token predictive distribution a sufficient state signal, and why is a one-shot decision after prefilling preferable to online adjustment during decoding? Finish with the main results and ablations, especially predictor overhead, candidate action sets, and transfer across models or datasets. A useful skim should take about 20–30 minutes. If you work on speculative decoding or adaptive inference, the appendix is likely worth reading as well.

recommendation.zh: 这类工作不改 pretrain，但会影响你对离散 diffusion 解码瓶颈的判断；只看自适应 block size 的证据和收益曲线，别把它误读成新建模范式。
recommendation.en: It does not change pretraining, but it sharpens where diffusion decoding actually bottlenecks; read the evidence for adaptive block sizing and the speedup curves, not as a new LM paradigm.

paper.title: RaBitQCache: Rotated Binary Quantization for KVCache in Long Context LLM Inference
paper.abstract: Long-context Large Language Model inference is severely bottlenecked by the massive Key-Value (KV) cache, yet existing sparse attention methods often suffer from static fixed-budget (Top-k) retrieval or rely on proxy scores that are computationally expensive and biased. To address these limitations, we propose RaBitQCache, a novel sparse attention framework that utilizes randomized rotated binary quantization and high-throughput binary-INT4 arithmetic to efficiently estimate attention weights. O

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是长上下文推理里的 KV cache 访问瓶颈。问题不只是显存大，而是每一步解码都要在巨大的历史 KV 上做选择和读取。已有 sparse attention / KV offloading 方法通常依赖固定预算的 Top-k 检索，或者依赖近似但偏差较大的 proxy score 来估计注意力重要性。前者不够自适应，后者既不够准，也缺少误差保证，因此很难安全地做 Top-p 这类按真实注意力质量自适应分配预算的检索。作者要解决的核心问题是：能否构造一个足够便宜、足够准、还有理论误差界的注意力代理分数，用它在不访问完整 KV cache 的前提下做动态稀疏检索。
summary.importance: 这篇论文属于 efficient inference，而不是预训练本身，但对大模型系统研究有现实价值。它的重要性主要在两个层面。第一，方法上它把 KV 选择问题明确地写成高维向量相似度估计问题，并借助 Johnson-Lindenstrauss 视角构造了带理论界的 proxy score，这比很多经验型 sparse attention 方法更扎实。第二，系统上它不是只给一个近似公式，而是把二值化、INT4 查询、异步流水和 lazy update 一起做成了可运行方案。对基座研究员来说，直接启发不在建模，而在于：长上下文能力的上限越来越受 memory movement 和 retrieval policy 约束，未来训练和推理可能需要更统一地考虑“哪些历史 token 值得被精确保留”。
summary.technical_approach:
方法名是 RaBitQCache，核心思想是把 Key 的高维浮点向量映射成随机旋转后的二值码，再用一个极轻量的二值-低比特算术近似 query-key 内积，从而估计注意力权重。具体分成几个层次。

第一层是表示压缩。在 prefill 阶段，作者对 Key 向量做随机旋转，然后映射到单位超立方体顶点，也就是得到 binary code。随机旋转的作用是让原始空间中的几何关系在低成本表示里尽量保真，避免直接按坐标符号切分带来的偏置。这个设计明显受 JL lemma 和相关近似近邻检索方法启发。

第二层是 proxy score 构造。在 decoding 阶段，不再直接用全精度 query 与所有 key 做内积，而是把 Query 做 INT4 量化，再与二值化 Key 进行高吞吐计算，得到一个对真实 attention score 的无偏估计。论文强调两点：一，这个估计器是 unbiased；二，它有严格的误差界。前者意味着估计值不会系统性高估或低估某类 token，后者意味着不仅能做相对排序，还能对分数大小本身有一定可信度，这正是支持 Top-p 检索的关键。
