第三层是检索策略。不同于固定 Top-k，RaBitQCache 用估计到的注意力质量做 adaptive Top-p retrieval。因为不同层、不同头、不同任务的注意力稀疏度差异很大，固定 k 往往要么取多了浪费算力，要么取少了伤精度。Top-p 更接近“保留足够多的重要质量”，理论上更适合异质的注意力分布，但前提就是 proxy score 必须能近似真实权重幅值，而不只是给个粗排序。

第四层是系统实现。作者实现了硬件感知的 kernel 和调度，包括异步流水线以及 lazy updates，用来隐藏二值检索和数据搬运的额外开销。这个部分很关键，因为很多 sparse/offloading 方法算法上省 FLOPs，系统上却被 gather/scatter 和 CPU-GPU 传输拖垮。RaBitQCache 试图把“近似检索”真正做成吞吐友好的路径。

和 Quest、DS 这类方法相比，区别主要在三点：检索粒度更细，不是整页粗选；proxy score 更接近真实内积，不是部分维度或启发式统计；支持自适应 Top-p，而不是被迫固定预算。
summary.experiments:
从引言和方法描述看，作者做的是长上下文推理加速实验，并声称显著优于现有 sparse attention / KV offloading 方法。虽然给出的片段没有完整主表数字，但正文明确强调了几个结果方向。第一，在不访问完整 KV cache 的前提下，RaBitQCache 能在保持模型性能基本稳定的同时提升长上下文推理效率。第二，相比现有方法，它的优势来自更准确的 token 重要性估计，因此在相同预算下精度损失更小，或者在相近精度下可进一步减少检索 token 数。第三，系统优化后，额外的代理分数计算和调度开销被较好掩蔽，否则算法收益很难兑现成端到端 latency 改善。

如果通读全文，建议重点抓几类实验。其一，proxy score 与真实 attention score 的相关性或误差分析，这是方法成立的根。其二，Top-k 与 Top-p 的对比，尤其是在不同层、不同头、不同任务上的预算自适应效果。其三，和 Quest、DS、静态位置选择等基线的端到端 latency、吞吐、显存/带宽占用比较。其四，消融随机旋转、二值码长度、INT4 量化精度、lazy update 和异步流水各自贡献。真正有说服力的结果通常不是单一 speedup，而是 accuracy-latency 曲线整体外移。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议 25 到 35 分钟。先看引言里对现有动态 KV 检索两类缺陷的归纳：proxy 不准，以及没有误差界。这两点决定了作者为什么坚持做带理论保证的估计器。然后直接看方法部分中 proxy score 的定义与定理，确认无偏性和误差界到底针对的是 query-key 内积、attention logits，还是归一化后的权重。接着看系统实现图，判断异步流水和 lazy update 是否只是工程补丁，还是和算法设计强耦合。最后看主实验和消融，重点关注 accuracy-latency tradeoff，而不是只看单点加速比。

如果只想快速判断价值，优先读三处：理论部分的主命题、Top-p 检索实验、端到端系统性能表。若要深挖，可以继续追两个问题：一，随机旋转和二值化在不同层的分布漂移下是否稳定；二，这种 proxy 是否能迁移到训练时的 memory compression 或检索增强注意力。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the main bottleneck in long-context decoding: not just the size of the KV cache, but the cost of repeatedly selecting and reading from a very large history. Existing sparse-attention and KV-offloading methods usually rely on either fixed-budget Top-k retrieval or cheap but biased proxy scores for token importance. Fixed Top-k is not adaptive enough, while weak proxies are often inaccurate and lack error guarantees, which makes adaptive Top-p retrieval hard to trust. The core question here is whether one can build a proxy score that is cheap, accurate, and theoretically controlled, so that dynamic sparse retrieval can be done without touching the full KV cache.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to foundation-model systems work. Its main value is twofold. First, it formulates KV selection as a high-dimensional similarity estimation problem and brings in a Johnson-Lindenstrauss-style perspective to construct a proxy with explicit guarantees. That is methodologically stronger than many heuristic sparse-attention designs. Second, it does not stop at the estimator: it also builds a hardware-aware implementation around binary keys, INT4 queries, asynchronous pipelining, and lazy updates. For LLM researchers, the broader lesson is that long-context capability is increasingly constrained by memory movement and retrieval policy, not only by model architecture.
summary_en.technical_approach:
RaBitQCache compresses high-dimensional key vectors into rotated binary codes, then uses very cheap binary-low-bit arithmetic to estimate query-key similarity during decoding. The method has several layers.

First is representation compression. During prefill, each key vector is randomly rotated and then mapped to the vertices of a unit hypercube, producing a binary code. The random rotation is important: it preserves geometric structure better than naive sign binarization and reduces coordinate-aligned bias. This design is clearly inspired by JL-style dimensionality reduction and approximate nearest-neighbor methods.

Second is the proxy-score construction. During decoding, the method does not compute full-precision inner products between the query and all keys. Instead, it quantizes the query to INT4 and computes a lightweight interaction with the binary keys. The resulting score is used as an estimator of the true attention score. The paper emphasizes two properties: the estimator is unbiased, and it comes with a rigorous error bound. Unbiasedness matters because it avoids systematic distortion of token importance. The error bound matters because it enables not just rough ranking but magnitude-aware estimation, which is exactly what adaptive Top-p retrieval needs.

Third is the retrieval policy. Unlike fixed Top-k methods, RaBitQCache uses the estimated attention mass to perform adaptive Top-p retrieval. This is a meaningful design choice because attention sparsity varies widely across layers, heads, and tasks. A fixed k is often either too conservative, wasting compute, or too aggressive, hurting accuracy. Top-p is a better match to heterogeneous attention distributions, but only if the proxy can estimate score magnitudes reasonably well rather than merely preserving order.

Fourth is the systems layer. The paper implements hardware-aware kernels and scheduling, including asynchronous pipelining and lazy updates, to hide the overhead of proxy computation and data movement. This part is important because many sparse or offloading methods save arithmetic on paper but lose the benefit in practice due to gather/scatter overhead and transfer latency.

Relative to methods such as Quest or DS, the differences are clear: finer retrieval granularity, a proxy closer to the true inner product, and support for adaptive Top-p rather than fixed-budget selection.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text excerpt, the paper evaluates long-context inference acceleration and claims clear gains over prior sparse-attention and KV-offloading baselines. The excerpt does not include the full result tables, but the experimental story is already visible. First, RaBitQCache improves long-context inference efficiency without requiring access to the full KV cache and while keeping model quality largely intact. Second, its advantage comes from more accurate token-importance estimation, which means lower quality loss at the same retrieval budget, or lower budget at similar quality. Third, the systems optimizations appear necessary to convert algorithmic savings into end-to-end latency gains.

When reading the full paper, four experimental blocks deserve attention. One is the correlation or error analysis between the proxy score and the true attention score; that is the foundation of the method. Another is the comparison between Top-k and Top-p retrieval, especially across layers, heads, and tasks with different sparsity patterns. A third is the end-to-end comparison against baselines such as Quest, DS, and static-position retrieval in terms of latency, throughput, and memory or bandwidth usage. A fourth is the ablation over random rotation, binary code length, INT4 quantization, lazy updates, and asynchronous scheduling. The most convincing evidence will likely be an improved accuracy-latency frontier rather than a single speedup number.
summary_en.reading_guide:
A 25-35 minute skim should be enough to judge the paper. Start with the introduction's diagnosis of prior dynamic KV retrieval: inaccurate proxies and no error bounds. That framing explains why the paper insists on a theoretically grounded estimator. Then go straight to the method section and read the definition of the proxy score together with the main theorem. Check carefully whether the guarantee applies to the raw query-key inner product, the attention logits, or something after normalization. After that, inspect the systems diagram to see whether asynchronous pipelining and lazy updates are core to the design or just implementation details. Finally, read the main results and ablations with an eye on the accuracy-latency tradeoff, not just isolated speedup numbers.

If time is limited, prioritize three parts: the main theoretical proposition, the Top-p retrieval experiments, and the end-to-end system table. For deeper follow-up, two questions are worth asking: how stable the rotated binary representation is under layer-wise distribution shift, and whether the same proxy machinery could be reused for training-time memory compression or retrieval-augmented attention.

recommendation.zh: KV cache二值量化+自适应Top-p稀疏方案扎实，无偏估计证明与硬件流水线设计，可作为预训练做长上下文兼容设计的直接参考
recommendation.en: Solid KV cache binary quantization + adaptive Top-p sparsity design; the unbiasedness proof and hardware pipeline are directly useful for long-context compatible pretraining.

paper.title: Attend, Transform, or Silence: Operator-Level Visual Skipping for Efficient Multimodal LLM Inference
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) increasingly process long visual-token sequences, increasing the overall inference computation. Existing acceleration methods usually remove visual tokens or skip visual-token updates in entire layers, but these coarse strategies may discard fine-grained evidence or suppress useful operators together with redundant ones. In this paper, we study visual-token computation from an answer-observable perspective and find that late visual-token updates can remai

summary.core_problem: 现有MLLM推理加速方法依赖粗粒度冗余判断：token级剪枝会不可逆丢失细粒度视觉证据，层级跳过将注意力和FFN绑定处理、无法区分单算子冗余；同时仅用隐状态更新幅度判断冗余，会误判大量对答案无实际贡献的“answer-silent”视觉更新为有效计算。
summary.importance: 提出算子级的视觉冗余分析视角，补充了MLLM计算效率研究的分析维度；无需重训练的跳过框架对高分辨率、长视觉序列MLLM的部署有实用价值，其answer-observable诊断方法也可迁移到其他多模态架构的效率分析中。
summary.technical_approach: 1. 设计answer-observable诊断指标，衡量视觉token更新是否传播到答案token的隐状态，识别出深层中大量更新幅度大但不影响最终输出的answer-silent冗余；2. 将Transformer层拆分为注意力和FFN两个独立算子，分别评估二者的答案可观测贡献，发现不同层存在注意力主导、FFN主导或双算子冗余的异质性；3. 实现算子级视觉跳过框架，保留完整视觉token序列，仅跳过每层中被判定为冗余的单个算子（注意力或FFN）的视觉计算，避免不可逆token丢失和固定算子偏好的限制。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen3VL等多个MLLM架构、10个VQA基准上测试，最高可减少33.7%的视觉计算量，平均性能变化仅0.5%；消融实验验证了answer-observable指标相比原始更新幅度指标的有效性，以及算子级粒度相比token级、层级策略的优势。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注第2节的answer-silent现象分析、算子级异质性实验及对应图表，以及第3节跳过框架的核心逻辑；预计阅读时间15-20分钟，无需深究实现细节，核心吸收冗余判断的新维度。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing MLLM inference acceleration methods rely on coarse redundancy granularities: token-level pruning irreversibly discards fine-grained visual evidence, while layer-level skipping couples attention and FFN computation and cannot isolate operator-specific redundancy. Judging redundancy solely by hidden-state update magnitude also misclassifies large but answer-irrelevant visual updates as useful computation.
summary_en.importance: It introduces an operator-level perspective for visual redundancy analysis, expanding the analytical toolkit for MLLM computational efficiency. The training-free skipping framework delivers practical value for deploying high-resolution or long-visual-sequence MLLMs, and the answer-observable diagnostic can be generalized to efficiency analysis of other multimodal architectures.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1. Propose answer-observable diagnostics that measure whether visual token updates propagate to answer token hidden states, identifying widespread "answer-silent" redundancy in late layers where large visual updates do not affect final outputs. 2. Decompose each Transformer layer into separate attention and FFN operators, and evaluate their individual answer-observable contributions, revealing layer-wise heterogeneity: some layers are attention-dominant, some FFN-dominant, and others redundant in both operators. 3. Design an operator-level visual skipping framework that retains the full visual token sequence and only bypasses the redundant operator (attention or FFN) for visual tokens in each layer, avoiding irreversible token loss and fixed operator preference assumptions.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across multiple MLLM architectures (including Qwen3VL) and 10 VQA benchmarks. It achieves up to 33.7% visual computation reduction with only 0.5% average performance change. Ablation studies validate the superiority of answer-observable metrics over raw update magnitude, and the advantage of operator-level granularity over token-level or layer-level strategies.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2's analysis of the answer-silent phenomenon and operator-level heterogeneity experiments (and corresponding figures), plus the core logic of the skipping framework in Section 3. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes; no need to dive deep into implementation details, prioritize absorbing the new redundancy judgment dimension.

recommendation.zh: 算子级视觉token跳过的思路比整层剪枝更精细，重点看§3关于answer-silent冗余的分析与Fig 2的算子影响分布，可迁移到长上下文推理优化。
recommendation.en: Operator-level visual token skipping is finer-grained than layer pruning; focus on §3 analysis of answer-silent redundancy and Fig 2 operator impact distribution, transferable to long-context inference optimization.

paper.title: ERA: Entropy-Guided Visual Token Pruning with Rectified Attention for Efficient MLLMs
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) incur prohibitive inference costs due to long visual token sequences. Training-free visual token reduction provides an efficient solution. However, existing methods distort attention distributions, giving rise to a phenomenon we term Attention Logit Collapse. To address this issue, we propose ERA, an Entropy-guided visual token pruning framework with Rectified Attention for efficient MLLMs. Specifically, ERA comprises three crucial components: Dual-view E

summary.core_problem: 现有免训练MLLM视觉token缩减方法存在两个核心缺陷：一是token重要性评估仅采用单一或简单组合准则，忽略不同注意力头的专属显著性模式；二是剪枝/合并操作会触发“注意力logit坍缩”——视觉token的累计注意力logit被系统性低估，导致注意力分布向系统/指令token偏移，损害生成质量。
summary.importance: 首次明确识别并从理论上解释了注意力logit坍缩现象，填补了现有视觉token缩减方法的认知盲区；其logit校正方案兼容FlashAttention等优化注意力实现，部署友好，可直接集成到vLLM等主流推理框架中。
summary.technical_approach: ERA框架包含三个协同组件：1. 双视角熵剪枝（DEP）：联合建模视觉多样性和头级注意力熵，选择同时覆盖互补视觉模式与特定头关键证据的锚token；2. 偏置感知token回收（BTR）：将被剪枝token聚合到最近的锚token，同时估计每个簇的累计注意力logit偏置，保留被丢弃token的注意力贡献信息；3. 保logit注意力校正（LAR）：将估计的簇级偏置注入注意力logit，校正token缩减导致的分布偏移；该模块通过矩阵增强实现，完全兼容FlashAttention等高效注意力实现。
summary.experiments: 在单图、多图、视频三种场景，覆盖不同视觉token生成范式的代表性MLLM上测试；激进剪枝下仍保持性能稳定，在FLOPs、延迟、prefill速度、显存占用上均有一致提升，且在vLLM实际部署环境中验证了效率增益的可迁移性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注第1节中注意力logit坍缩现象的定义与理论解释，以及第3节LAR组件的实现逻辑（尤其是与现有高效注意力的兼容方案）；预计阅读时间15分钟，核心吸收坍缩现象的发现与校正思路。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing training-free MLLM visual token reduction methods have two critical flaws: first, token importance estimation relies on single or simply combined criteria, ignoring head-specific saliency patterns across attention heads; second, pruning/merging triggers "Attention Logit Collapse", where the accumulated attention logit of visual tokens is systematically underestimated, shifting the attention distribution toward system/instruction tokens and degrading generation quality.
summary_en.importance: It explicitly identifies and theoretically explains the Attention Logit Collapse phenomenon for the first time, filling a cognitive gap in existing visual token reduction research. Its logit rectification scheme is compatible with optimized attention implementations such as FlashAttention, making it deployment-friendly and directly integratable into mainstream inference frameworks like vLLM.
summary_en.technical_approach: The ERA framework consists of three synergistic components: 1. Dual-view Entropy Pruning (DEP): jointly models visual diversity and head-wise attention entropy to select anchor tokens that cover both complementary visual patterns and head-specific critical evidence. 2. Bias-aware Token Recycling (BTR): aggregates pruned tokens to their nearest anchors, while estimating cluster-level accumulated attention logit biases to preserve the attention contribution of discarded tokens. 3. Logit-preserving Attention Rectification (LAR): injects the estimated cluster biases into attention logits to correct distribution shifts caused by token reduction; it is implemented via matrix augmentation and remains fully compatible with efficient attention implementations like FlashAttention.
summary_en.experiments: Tested across three scenarios (single-image, multi-image, video) on representative MLLMs with different visual token generation paradigms. It maintains stable performance even under aggressive token pruning, delivers consistent improvements in FLOPs, latency, prefill speed, and memory usage, and validates the transferability of efficiency gains in a real-world vLLM deployment environment.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the definition and theoretical explanation of the Attention Logit Collapse phenomenon in Section 1, and the implementation logic of the LAR component (especially its compatibility with existing efficient attention) in Section 3. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes; prioritize understanding the collapse discovery and rectification strategy.

recommendation.zh: 做MLLM推理优化的研究员重点看注意力logit坍缩的分析和LAR修正模块，其他方向可跳过。
recommendation.en: MLLM inference optimization researchers should focus on the Attention Logit Collapse analysis and LAR rectification module; others can skip.

paper.title: OTCache: Optimal Transport for Geometry-Aware Caching in Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: We propose OTCache, a training-free framework for accelerating diffusion sampling via caching schedule prediction. Existing graph-based caching methods reduce redundant computation by optimizing shortest-path objectives, but rely on an additive independence assumption, which often breaks down in the low NFE regime. To address this issue, OTCache models caching schedules across inference budgets as a smooth evolution in policy space, inspired by Optimal Transport (OT). The framework consists of t

summary.core_problem: 现有扩散模型基于图的缓存加速方法依赖加性独立假设，在低采样步数(NFE) regime下该假设失效导致加速效果下降。
summary.importance: 推理加速方法创新，提出训练无关的最优传输视角缓存调度预测框架，适用于图像/视频扩散模型的低步数采样场景。
summary.technical_approach: OTCache分三阶段：保守预算下用图方法得到高保真参考调度、极端低预算下用Optuna搜索锚定调度、用最优传输启发的分位数插值在参考与锚定间预测任意目标预算的调度。
summary.experiments: 在FLUX.1 [dev]、Qwen-Image、HunyuanVideo三个图像/视频扩散模型上验证，在相同感知质量下降低采样步数或提升生成质量。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing graph-based caching acceleration methods for diffusion models rely on an additive independence assumption that breaks down in the low NFE (number of function evaluations) regime, degrading acceleration performance.
summary_en.importance: Inference acceleration method innovation; proposes a training-free optimal transport-inspired caching schedule prediction framework applicable to low-step sampling for image/video diffusion models.
summary_en.technical_approach: OTCache operates in three stages: obtain a high-fidelity reference schedule via graph-based caching under a conservative budget, search for an anchor schedule under extreme low-budget via Optuna optimization with end-to-end perceptual objectives, and predict schedules for arbitrary target budgets via quantile interpolation between reference and anchor using continuous warping representations.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on three image/video diffusion models: FLUX.1 [dev], Qwen-Image, and HunyuanVideo; reduces required sampling steps or improves generation quality under matched perceptual quality.

recommendation.zh: 做多模态生成推理优化的可看§3插值设计，纯LLM预训练研究员仅需知道扩散采样缓存有OT视角的新解法，不必读正文。
recommendation.en: Multimodal generation inference optimization researchers may check §3 interpolation design; pure LLM pretraining researchers only need to be aware of this OT-based diffusion caching approach, no full read needed.

paper.title: When Is a Draft Accepted? A Theory of Acceptance in Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates language model inference by using a fast drafter to propose candidate tokens that are then verified by a larger target model. Existing theory largely studies the stochastic, distribution-preserving setting, where the goal is to exactly sample from the target distribution. In contrast, many practical systems use greedy decoding, relaxed acceptance rules, or tree-based candidate sets, where success is governed by local ranking and threshold events rather than exact

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究实际 speculative decoding 中“draft token 什么时候会被接受”的判定问题，重点不在保持精确采样分布，而在 greedy、relaxed greedy 和 tree-based decoding 这些工程常用设置下，如何用 target/draft 分布差异给出可证明的接受条件。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是核心贡献，但对大模型推理系统和小 draft 模型训练有直接参考价值。它把 accepted length 从经验指标转成局部概率几何问题：draft 与 target 的 KL 小到什么程度时，可以保证 draft 不会被拒绝。这有助于判断 drafter 蒸馏、共享层 drafter、Medusa-style 多头预测等方法的优化目标是否真的对接受率有帮助。尤其值得注意的是，它分析的是很多线上系统使用的非分布保持规则，而不是经典 speculative sampling 的无偏采样设置。
summary.technical_approach: 方法的核心是把一类接受规则统一写成 target distribution 的 lower level set。直观地说，拒绝区域由 target 模型认为概率较低的一组 token 构成；只要 draft 分布与 target 分布的 KL 距离低于某个证书阈值，draft 选出的 token 就不可能落入拒绝区域，从而保证接受。工作给出了单 token draft 的统一 KL certificate，并把 strict greedy acceptance、additive relaxation、multiplicative relaxation、top-m relaxed acceptance、entropy-based acceptance 作为推论处理。它还扩展到简单的 greedy tree decoding，分析分支数 m 与局部接受之间的关系，并给出 tree certificate 的通用上界 log(m+1)，对应单 token 情况下的 log(2) ceiling。与已有理论主要研究 stochastic、distribution-preserving speculative sampling 不同，这里关注 deterministic/local ranking 事件，即 argmax、阈值和候选集合覆盖。
summary.experiments: 实证部分使用 Qwen3 系列模型的输出分布统计来检验这些 KL certificate 的形态。核心现象是 relaxed acceptance 和 tree-based criteria 会扩大 certified acceptance 区域，低置信步骤上尤其明显，因为 strict greedy 在 target top-1 不稳定时容易拒绝，而放宽阈值或提供多个候选可以覆盖更多局部不确定性。给出的正文没有展示端到端 latency、throughput 或 accepted length 的具体数字，也没有看到不同 drafter 参数量和训练方式的系统比较；实验更像是验证理论边界与模型输出分布的匹配关系。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看三个部分：第一，single draft token 的统一 certificate，理解 lower level set 如何把不同接受规则归到同一类；第二，tight lower/upper bound 的构造，确认这些 KL 阈值不是松散不等式；第三，tree-based greedy decoding 的 log(m+1) 上界，它解释了为什么树状候选能在低置信位置提高接受机会。做 serving 或 drafter 训练的人可以进一步关注 relaxed acceptance 的几类规则，因为这些规则更接近实际系统。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks when a draft token is accepted in practical speculative decoding, focusing on greedy, relaxed greedy, and tree-based regimes rather than exact distribution-preserving sampling.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an inference-systems paper, not a pretraining paper, but it gives useful signal for training and evaluating draft models. It connects acceptance length to local distributional geometry: how close the drafter must be to the target, in KL divergence, before rejection becomes impossible under a given acceptance rule. That is relevant when deciding whether to train a standalone drafter, a shared-layer drafter, or Medusa-style prediction heads, because lower loss is only useful insofar as it improves the local rank and threshold events used by the verifier.
summary_en.technical_approach: The main idea is to characterize many acceptance rules as rejection regions that are lower level sets of the target distribution. If the draft distribution is sufficiently close to the target distribution, measured by a KL certificate, then the draft’s chosen token cannot fall into the rejection set and acceptance is guaranteed. The framework covers strict greedy acceptance, additive and multiplicative relaxations, top-m relaxed acceptance, and entropy-based acceptance as special cases. The paper also extends the analysis to a simple greedy tree-decoding setting, relates the branching factor m to local acceptance, and derives a universal log(m+1) upper bound on the tree certificate, generalizing the log(2) ceiling in the single-token case. The distinction from earlier theory is important: the analysis targets deterministic ranking and threshold events, not unbiased stochastic speculative sampling.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical section computes output-distribution statistics on Qwen3 models and compares them with the derived certificates. The reported qualitative finding is that relaxed and tree-based acceptance rules enlarge the certified acceptance region, especially at low-confidence decoding steps where strict greedy matching is brittle. The available text does not provide end-to-end latency numbers, throughput gains, accepted-token counts, or a detailed comparison across drafter sizes and training recipes; the experiments are primarily distributional diagnostics for the theory.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read the unified single-token certificate first, since that is where the lower-level-set view becomes clear. Then check the tightness arguments for the lower and upper bounds, because they determine whether the KL thresholds are operationally meaningful. Finally, read the tree-decoding section and the Qwen3 distributional analysis. Practitioners working on serving or drafter distillation should pay special attention to the relaxed acceptance rules, which are closer to deployed systems than exact speculative sampling.

recommendation.zh: 推测解码工业落地变体的首个统一理论，做推理部署的重点读 §3 边际界推导，预训练选draft模型可参考其KL散度结论。
recommendation.en: First unified theory for industrial speculative decoding variants; inference teams focus on §3 margin bound derivations, pretrain teams can reference its KL divergence conclusions for draft model selection.

paper.title: SAFE-DiT: Semantics-Aware Fast-path Execution for High-Resolution Diffusion Transformers
paper.abstract: High-resolution Diffusion Transformer (DiT) inference contains substantial spatial redundancy, but many spatially adaptive implementations encode regional computation as attention masks, which can inadvertently move scaled dot-product attention (SDPA) away from FlashAttention fast paths. We identify this avoidable systems bottleneck as Mask-Induced Dispatch Tax (MIDT) and show that it grows with latent sequence length. We introduce SAFE-DiT, a training-free Semantics-Aware Fast-path Execution fr

summary.core_problem: 解决高分辨率 DiT 推理中的空间冗余与注意力 mask 破坏 FlashAttention fast path 之间的冲突，避免为了空间自适应而付出额外系统开销。
summary.importance: 贡献在于把一个常被忽略的系统问题明确化：attention mask 可能让 SDPA 退化出高效内核路径。对做统一 Transformer/DiT 系统优化的人有参考价值，但它仍是推理侧工作，不是预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SAFE-DiT。核心分两层：一是精确识别并移除只会给 attention logits 带来按行常数偏移、因此不改变语义的 image self-attention mask，同时保留 text padding 等真正承载语义的 mask；二是通过 prompt-conditioned token partition、选择性状态更新和周期性全局上下文刷新来做近似空间调度。作者把纯加速配置称为 SAFE-Core。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模和加速比，但强调这是 training-free 框架，面向高分辨率 DiT 推理；主要比较对象应是带 spatial mask 的自适应实现与保留 FlashAttention fast path 的 SAFE-Core/SAFE-DiT 配置。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the conflict between spatial redundancy reduction and preserving FlashAttention fast paths in high-resolution DiT inference, where attention masks can silently trigger slower SDPA kernels.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is to isolate a systems issue that is easy to miss: attention masks may kick SDPA off efficient kernels. This is useful for researchers working on unified Transformer/DiT systems, though it remains an inference-side paper rather than a pretraining one.
summary_en.technical_approach: SAFE-DiT has two layers. First, it exactly removes only those image self-attention masks that induce a row-wise constant shift in attention logits and therefore do not change semantics, while preserving semantics-bearing masks such as text padding masks. Second, it performs approximate spatial scheduling via prompt-conditioned token partitioning, selective state updates with global context, and periodic context refresh. The pure acceleration configuration is called SAFE-Core.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model size or speedup numbers, but it is a training-free framework for high-resolution DiT inference. The key comparison is likely against prior spatially adaptive masked implementations that lose FlashAttention fast paths.

recommendation.zh: 有一个值得记住的系统点：mask 不只是数学对象，还会改 kernel dispatch；读 abstract 和方法部分就够，重点看它如何区分‘语义无关 mask’与真约束。
recommendation.en: One systems lesson is worth keeping: masks are not just mathematical objects, they change kernel dispatch; abstract plus methods are enough, focusing on how it separates semantically inert masks from real constraints.

paper.title: EntMTP: Accelerating LLM Inference with Entropy Guided Multi Token Prediction
paper.abstract: Multi-token prediction has been shown to increase data density during training, improve downstream text-generation quality, and serves as the defacto approach for self-speculative decoding. Existing foundation and open source models that use MTP heads commit to a static tree-based attention topology throughout the entire generation sequence, meaning the speculation depth, and thus the compute required during verification, stays constant regardless of the context. This is fundamentally misaligned

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 MTP/self-speculative decoding 里的一个很具体但常被忽略的问题：已有 Hydra/Medusa 一类方法在整个生成过程中使用固定 draft tree，而真实语言生成的可接受深度会随位置、任务类型和局部熵显著变化。固定树在低熵段过于保守，在高熵段又会带来多余验证开销，结果是吞吐率被一个“全局静态拓扑”卡住。论文要解决的不是再训练一个更强的 draft head，而是在不改模型权重的前提下，按步选择更合适的 speculation tree，让验证成本和当前上下文难度匹配起来。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义不在预训练，而在 serving 与解码机制：它说明 MTP 的收益上限不只由 head 质量决定，还强依赖运行时调度。这个结论对以后做 MTP 预训练、self-speculation、甚至 adaptive compute 都有启发，因为“接受深度”不是静态模型属性，而是 workload-conditioned 的动态量。贡献量级属于工程上扎实有效：不训练新模型，只加一个调度层，就能在 batch size 1 下稳定超过固定树基线，同时几乎不改变输出分布质量。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分两段。第一段是离线构建 task-specific 的 tree bank。作者沿用 Hydra 类方法的 greedy tree expansion 思路，从小树开始逐步加节点；每次在 frontier 上评估所有单节点扩展，用 self-rollout 估计 mean accept length。这里有一个细节：候选树 T∪{ν} 的打分是在更大的 joint tree 上做 one-step what-if probe，因此估计略偏乐观，作者随后再用 candidate 自己的 proposal/attention mask/KV update 做一次 recalibration。之后不是只选 accept depth 最大的树，而是把整条 acceptance frontier 放到真实端到端 decode loop 里测 wall-clock tok/s，连 prefill 和 verifier 开销一起算，得到 throughput-Pareto frontier，只保留真正不被支配的树。第二段是在线调度。作者把这些树的 attention masks、position offsets、gather indices 预编译进 TopologyBank，因此切换树只需 O(1) 指针替换，不需要重建 kernel。在线策略读取现成特征，如 base model top-1 probability、EAGLE-2 path value、近期接受历史等，然后在每一步选择树。文中给了三种策略：EntMTP-l 是多阈值阶梯规则；EntMTP* 是针对单任务离线选出的静态最优树；EntMTP-τ 是带 hysteresis 的二值开关，用不同 on/off threshold 避免逐步抖动。真正效果最好的是后者，因为它在大树/小树之间切换足够简单，且能抑制高频 oscillation。论文的关键判断是：树大小的最优点由“当前 token 区域的可预测性”决定，而不是由整个 benchmark 的平均统计决定。
summary.experiments: 实验集中在 batch_size=1 的低延迟场景，任务覆盖 GSM8K、HumanEval、ShareGPT 三类分布。结果上，EntMTP-τ 全面优于 Hydra、Medusa 和静态 EntMTP*。GSM8K 上达到 112.0 tok/s，对比 Hydra 的 102.4 tok/s，提升 9.4%，相对纯 AR 是 3.13×。HumanEval 上 124.7 tok/s，相比 Hydra 提升 14.0%，相对 AR 为 3.26×。ShareGPT 上 117.5 tok/s，对比 109.0 tok/s，提升 7.8%，相对 AR 为 3.47×。质量方面，response perplexity 与 Hydra 的差异都在 0.022 以内，说明收益主要来自调度而不是放松验证规则。分析实验里更有意思的是接受信号的任务差异：ShareGPT 上 recent acceptance history 对下一步 accept length 的 EMA 相关系数达到 0.49，而 GSM8K/HumanEval 上最强的熵类特征只有 |r|≤0.22，且弱至少 2 倍。这说明不同任务的最优调度信号并不一致，也解释了为什么单一固定树难以同时适配对话、代码和数学。论文还做了 Pareto frontier 与树重排实验，表明“accept depth 最大”不等于“吞吐最高”，因为大树会抬高 verifier、tree decoding 和 posterior evaluation 的固定成本。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先抓三处。第一是引言和 Fig.3，对应论文最重要的经验事实：acceptance 是 workload-dependent，而且不同任务的可预测特征不同。第二是离线 tree bank 构建部分，重点看 greedy expansion、recalibration 和 throughput-Pareto re-ranking，这里解释了为什么不能只按 accept length 选树。第三是在线 scheduler，尤其是 EntMTP-τ 的 hysteresis 设计和 TopologyBank 的 O(1) 切换实现，这部分最接近实际部署。若时间有限，先看方法总览图、Fig.3、主结果表，再扫 Appendix 里 acceptance correlation 和 end-to-end timing 细节，30-40 分钟足够建立完整判断。真正值得记住的点不是某个阈值，而是“固定 speculation depth 是错误抽象”，以后看任何 MTP 论文都应追问它是否考虑了 step-wise adaptive compute。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific weakness in MTP-based self-speculative decoding: existing Hydra/Medusa-style systems use a fixed draft-tree topology for the entire generation trajectory, while the realizable acceptance depth varies substantially with local context, task distribution, and token-level uncertainty. A static tree is too small in easy, low-entropy regions and too expensive in difficult regions, so throughput is capped by a poor global compromise. The paper does not try to improve the MTP head itself; it asks how to choose the right tree at each decoding step without retraining the model.
summary_en.importance: Its value is mainly in inference systems rather than pretraining, but the lesson is relevant to foundation-model research: the benefit of MTP is not determined only by head quality, but also by runtime scheduling. Acceptance depth is a workload-conditioned dynamic variable, not a fixed model property. That matters for future work on MTP pretraining, self-speculation, and adaptive compute. The contribution is practically meaningful: a training-free scheduler consistently beats fixed-topology baselines at batch size 1, while keeping output quality essentially unchanged.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two stages. Offline, the authors build a task-specific bank of draft trees. Starting from a small tree, they greedily expand frontier nodes and score each one-node augmentation via self-rollout, estimating mean accepted length. A subtle point is that candidate trees are first scored with a larger joint tree in a one-step what-if probe, which makes the estimate mildly optimistic; they therefore recalibrate candidates using each tree’s own proposal, attention mask, and KV-cache update before final ranking. They then evaluate the full acceptance frontier in the actual end-to-end decoding loop, including prefill, tree decoding, posterior evaluation, verification, and KV updates, and keep only throughput-Pareto-optimal trees. Online, these trees are stored in a precompiled TopologyBank containing masks, position offsets, and gather indices, so switching trees is an O(1) pointer swap rather than a kernel rebuild. The scheduler reads readily available signals such as base-model top-1 probability, EAGLE-2 path value, and recent acceptance history, and selects a tree per step. Three policies are studied: a threshold ladder, a static task-optimal rule, and a hysteretic binary policy with separate on/off thresholds. The hysteretic policy works best because it captures the main large-tree/small-tree trade-off while avoiding per-step oscillation. The core idea is simple: the optimal speculation depth should track local predictability, not benchmark-level averages.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments focus on the low-latency batch_size=1 regime and cover GSM8K, HumanEval, and ShareGPT. EntMTP-τ outperforms Hydra, Medusa, and the static EntMTP* rule on all three tasks. On GSM8K it reaches 112.0 tok/s versus 102.4 tok/s for Hydra, a 9.4% gain and 3.13× speedup over autoregressive decoding. On HumanEval it reaches 124.7 tok/s, a 14.0% gain over Hydra and 3.26× over AR. On ShareGPT it reaches 117.5 tok/s versus 109.0 tok/s, a 7.8% gain and 3.47× over AR. Response perplexity stays within 0.022 of Hydra across settings, indicating that the gains come from better scheduling rather than a change in the verification rule. The most informative analysis is the task dependence of acceptance signals: on ShareGPT, recent acceptance history predicts next-step accept length with EMA correlation 0.49, whereas on GSM8K and HumanEval the strongest entropy-based predictors are at least 2× weaker, with |r|≤0.22. The paper also shows that maximizing accepted depth is not the same as maximizing throughput, because larger trees increase verifier and posterior-evaluation cost.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, focus on three parts. First, the introduction and the analysis around Fig. 3, which establish the main empirical fact that acceptance behavior is workload-dependent and that predictive signals differ by task. Second, the offline tree-bank construction, especially greedy expansion, recalibration, and throughput-Pareto reranking; this is where the paper explains why acceptance depth alone is the wrong objective. Third, the online scheduler, especially the hysteresis design of EntMTP-τ and the O(1) switching enabled by the TopologyBank. If time is limited, read the overview figure, Fig. 3, and the main results table, then skim the appendix for acceptance-correlation tables and end-to-end timing details. The durable takeaway is not any specific threshold, but the broader point that fixed speculation depth is the wrong abstraction for MTP decoding.

recommendation.zh: 这是个干净的 inference-side patch，不改训练却能检验 MTP 头是否真的学到可变深度草拟；只看调度准则和主速度表就够，别把它误读成新的 pretrain 方法。
recommendation.en: A clean inference-side patch: it tests whether MTP heads actually support variable-depth drafting; read the scheduler and main speed table, but do not mistake it for a new pretraining method.

paper.title: ResilPhase: Plug-and-Play Phase Mapping and Noise-Resilient Macro-Trajectory Extrapolation for Diffusion Acceleration
paper.abstract: The adoption of powerful diffusion models is hindered by their significant inference latency. Recent ``cache-then-forecast'' schemes alleviate this issue by accelerating DiTs using derivative-based polynomials, but they suffer from severe quality degradation at high acceleration ratios. Our analysis reveals its root cause: the discrete extrapolation performed on representations that are misaligned with the continuous diffusion trajectory and are numerically unstable. Thus, accelerated DiTs suffe

summary.core_problem: 现有cache-then-forecast类DiT扩散加速方法在高加速比下质量严重退化，根因是离散外推表示与连续扩散轨迹不对齐且数值不稳定。
summary.importance: 扩散推理加速领域方法创新，首次将加速问题重构为ODE空间的稳定宏观轨迹外推，解决特征不一致与噪声放大问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出ResilPhase框架：1）将加速推理对齐模型全局漂移（GD），在ODE空间做宏观轨迹外推，消除特征不一致与额外内存开销；2）设计即插即用的相位映射与抗噪声外推机制，抑制误差累积与高阶不稳定。
summary.experiments: 摘要未完整披露实验参数量、数据集与量化结果，仅提及方法针对DiT场景，在高加速比下缓解生成质量退化。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing cache-then-forecast DiT diffusion acceleration methods suffer from severe quality degradation at high acceleration ratios, caused by misalignment between discrete extrapolated representations and continuous diffusion trajectories plus numerical instability.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation in diffusion inference acceleration, first reformulating acceleration as stable macro-trajectory extrapolation in ODE space to eliminate feature inconsistency and noise amplification.
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose ResilPhase framework: 1) Align accelerated inference with the model's Global Drift (GD) and perform macro-trajectory extrapolation in ODE space, removing feature inconsistency and extra memory overhead; 2) Design plug-and-play phase mapping and noise-resilient extrapolation to suppress error accumulation and high-order instability.
summary_en.experiments: Full model size, dataset and quantitative results are not disclosed in the abstract, only that the method targets DiT scenarios and mitigates quality degradation at high acceleration ratios is mentioned.

recommendation.zh: 扩散ODE加速的通用方法，对做Diffusion LM推理优化的研究员有弱参考，仅看方法核心公式即可。
recommendation.en: General diffusion ODE acceleration method, weak reference for Diffusion LM inference optimization researchers, only core method equations are worth checking.

paper.title: Towards a Dynamic and Fixed-budget Memory Bank for Efficient Streaming Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Currently, streaming video understanding is still a daunting task for existing \emph{multimodal large language models} (MLLMs). Its difficulties not only lie in handling the ever-increasing video frames, but also in the unpredictability of future video content and input instructions. In this paper, we study this task from the perspective of constructing a dynamic but fixed-budget memory bank, and propose a novel and training-free approach termed \emph{\textbf{CausalMem}}. CausalMem is dedicated

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是流式视频理解中的固定预算记忆问题：视频帧持续增长，但多模态大模型的上下文和显存预算有限，如何在线保留最有信息量的视觉 token。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理侧系统/算法改进，而且是 training-free 方案。对做长上下文、多模态 KV/记忆压缩的人有一点参考，但它不直接触及基座预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 CausalMem，用一个动态但固定容量的 memory bank 在线更新视频表示。核心做法是估计视觉 token 冗余度，并通过 online semantic basis 建模当前视频流的主语义方向，再决定哪些 token 被保留、替换或压缩。整体不需要额外训练，属于插拔式推理增强模块。
summary.experiments: 方法被接到 LLaVA-OneVision 和 Qwen2.5-VL 上做 streaming video understanding。摘要强调在有限 memory 下提升信息保留和理解效果，但没有给出具体 benchmark、预算设置和提升幅度。从摘要看，更像工程上合理的 memory selection 策略，而不是会改变建模范式的结果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles fixed-budget memory management for streaming video understanding, where video frames keep growing but MLLMs have limited context and memory budgets.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-time systems/algorithm contribution, specifically a training-free memory mechanism. It may be mildly relevant for people working on long-context multimodal inference, but it does not directly inform foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method, CausalMem, maintains a dynamic yet fixed-size memory bank for online video processing. It estimates redundancy among visual tokens and updates memory using an online semantic basis that tracks the principal semantics of the observed stream, deciding what to keep or replace under a fixed budget.
summary_en.experiments: CausalMem is applied to LLaVA-OneVision and Qwen2.5-VL for streaming video understanding. The abstract claims improved information retention and downstream understanding under limited memory, but does not provide concrete benchmarks, budgets, or gains. From the abstract, it looks more like a sensible engineering heuristic than a result that changes modeling assumptions.

recommendation.zh: 典型推理侧 memory 管理，和 pretrain 关系很弱；如果你在做长视频/多模态 serving，只看 memory update 规则，别投入太多时间。
recommendation.en: This is a standard inference-time memory-management paper with weak pretraining relevance; only skim the memory update rule if you care about long-video or multimodal serving.

paper.title: Deeper is Not Always Better: Mitigating the Alignment Tax via Confident Layer Decoding
paper.abstract: Autoregressive generation in large language models (LLMs) conventionally decodes from the final layer, assuming that deeper representations yield more reliable next-token predictions. We revisit this assumption by revealing a recurring Guess-Refine-Perturb dynamic: early layers form coarse guesses, intermediate layers refine reasoning-relevant semantics, and final layers can perturb these refined predictions toward generic or alignment-preferred tokens. We introduce Confident Decoding, a trainin

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是一个很具体、但过去默认不被质疑的设定：自回归 LLM 在生成下一个 token 时，为什么一定要用最后一层的 logits。作者沿着全文的分析给出一个更细的结论：深层表示并不总是单调变好，很多 token 在中后层已经形成了较稳定、对推理更有利的语义判断，但最后几层会把这个判断往更泛化、更保守、或更符合对齐偏好的方向推偏。论文把这种层间演化概括为 Guess–Refine–Perturb：前层先做粗猜，中间层完成语义收敛，末层对一部分 token 发生扰动。核心问题因此不是“能否早退以节省算力”，而是“在不改模型、不重训的前提下，怎样在每个生成步选择更可靠的输出层，减少末层扰动带来的 alignment tax 和 reasoning degradation”。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要有两层。第一层是机制层面：它直接挑战了“越深越适合解码”的默认假设，把后训练带来的风格/安全/偏好偏置，和前向传播末段的 token 分布漂移联系起来。这对理解 pretrain 与 post-train 的接口很重要，因为它提示对齐信号未必只改变最终行为，也可能改变层内语义何时最清晰地出现。第二层是方法层面：作者提出的 Confident Decoding 完全训练无关，不改参数、不截断网络，只改最后把哪一层的 logits 送进采样器。若这一现象稳定存在，它意味着一部分“对齐税”并不一定要靠重新训练或更复杂的 RL 目标来解决，解码阶段就能回收一部分推理能力。对预训练研究员来说，真正有价值的不是这个具体 heuristic 本身，而是它暴露出一个更深的问题：模型内部的最佳语义层与最终输出层并不总一致，尤其在强后训练模型上更明显。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分两部分：现象刻画和解码策略。

现象刻画上，作者不是只看 layer-wise accuracy，而是结合 residual stream 的层间位移、各层对最终 logits 的贡献范数、以及 token 预测轨迹的演化，去识别哪些 token 在中间层已经进入稳定语义轨道，哪些 token 在最后几层发生了明显偏转。全文把这种偏转解释为 late-stage perturbation，并把它和 planning–pragmatics tradeoff 联系起来：模型内部已经形成了偏推理的 token 倾向，但末层更偏向输出通用、安全、礼貌、对齐友好的 continuation。这个 framing 比单纯说“中间层有时更好”更有信息量，因为它把问题限定在 near-final layers 的局部选择，而不是鼓吹浅层替代深层。

具体算法是 Confident Decoding。它不做 early exit，也不改 transformer 前向。每个生成步仍然完整跑到最后一层，但额外从一个近末层窗口中取出若干层 logits，通常是最后几层到倒数十来层的一个小窗口。然后用 token entropy 作为置信度指标，从最后一层向前做 conservative backward search，寻找第一个局部 entropy trough，也就是在末层扰动出现前，分布已经足够尖锐、但还没有被后续层重新拉偏的位置。选中的那一层 logits 直接用于 greedy decoding 或后续采样。

这里的关键设计不是“选最低熵层”，而是“保守地向后回溯到第一个局部低谷”。如果直接全局选最低熵，容易落到过早层，分布虽然尖锐但语义尚未成熟；如果固定选某个中间层，又无法适应不同 token、不同任务、不同上下文的层深差异。作者因此把 layer selection 写成 optimal stopping 问题：在 bounded projection noise 和 late-stage perturbation 占主导的条件下，最优策略是停在扰动前的高置信点，而不是机械地走到最后一层。这个理论部分不是严格刻画真实 transformer 的完整动力学，但足以解释为什么“第一个局部低谷”比“最终层”或“固定早退层”更合理。

和已有方法相比，区别主要有三点。第一，它不是 contrastive decoding 那种用层间差分去抑制某些 token，而是直接替换输出层。第二，它不以省算为目标，因此保留完整前向，避免 early exit 破坏后续层对其他位置的计算。第三，它的选择是 token-level、step-level 动态的，而不是为整个模型预设一个静态 exit layer。全文也强调，这种做法更像是在 near-final layers 中寻找“语义最清楚的读出点”。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 reasoning、数学、长上下文、代码和安全，数据集包括 GPQA-Diamond、HLE、Omni-MATH、LongBench v2、LiveCodeBench v6、Air-Bench-2024，并同时测试 dense 与 MoE 模型。摘要里给出的总体结论是：Confident Decoding 相比标准 greedy decoding 和强对比基线都有稳定提升，额外延迟低于 2%，内存开销可以忽略。全文的重点不只是平均分提升，而是三类更细的证据。

第一类证据是层间动态分析。作者展示了不少 token 级案例：正确答案 token 在中间层已经成为 top prediction，最后几层却被 generic token、格式 token、或更安全的替代词覆盖。配合 entropy 曲线可以看到，很多样本在 near-final layers 先出现一次明显的置信收敛，随后末层又发生分布重排。这个现象在复杂推理、数学和代码任务上更明显。

第二类证据是和静态层选择、对比解码、以及直接 final-layer decoding 的比较。静态选某一层通常只能在部分任务上有效，因为不同任务、不同 token 的最佳读出层不一致；contrastive 方法能抑制一部分坏 continuation，但仍把 final layer 当主锚点，因此对“末层整体偏转”处理不彻底。Confident Decoding 的优势来自逐 token 动态选层，而不是单纯利用中间层信息。

第三类证据是规模效应。作者观察到，模型越大、能力越强，late-layer perturbation 往往越明显，因此动态选层带来的收益也更稳定。这一点很重要，因为它暗示该现象不是小模型训练不足导致的噪声，而可能和强模型的后训练、风格控制、以及更复杂的内部语义压缩有关。

从摘要可确认的硬数字只有额外 latency <2%。其余具体提升幅度、窗口大小、各模型参数规模、以及不同 benchmark 上的绝对分数，需要以正文表格为准。阅读时应重点核对：1）提升是否主要集中在 greedy setting；2）在采样或 self-consistency 下是否仍成立；3）安全 benchmark 上的收益是否来自更好遵循安全偏好，还是仅仅减少无关扰动；4）MoE 与 dense 的最佳窗口是否一致。
summary.reading_guide:
建议先看引言和 Figure 2，对 Guess–Refine–Perturb 的定义先建立直觉。然后直接看方法部分里 entropy-guided conservative backward search 的伪代码或公式，确认它到底是在 near-final window 中如何停下来的。这里要特别注意：它不是 early exit，也不是把中间层 hidden state 拿去额外训练一个 head。

接着看理论部分。重点不是证明是否完全严密，而是看作者如何把 layer selection 形式化成 optimal stopping，以及理论假设覆盖了哪些真实场景、遗漏了哪些情况。若你关心 pretrain/post-train 接口，这一节值得细读，因为它给了一个分析框架：末层偏移可以被视为后期附加噪声或偏置，而不是语义计算本身的继续完善。

实验部分建议按三条线读。第一条线看 layer-wise entropy 和 token trajectory 的可视化，确认现象是否普遍。第二条线看主表，比较 final-layer、静态中间层、contrastive baselines、Confident Decoding 的差异。第三条线看消融：近末层窗口大小、搜索规则、是否必须找局部低谷、不同任务上选中的层分布。若时间有限，优先看现象图、主结果表、以及 layer selection 分布图，30–40 分钟能抓住主要内容；若要深挖，建议再看失败案例，判断这种方法是否会在知识型问答、普通聊天、或强安全约束场景中引入新的偏差。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper questions a default design choice in autoregressive LLMs: why should next-token decoding always read from the final layer? The full paper argues that depth is not uniformly monotonic in usefulness for decoding. For many tokens, early layers make a rough guess, intermediate layers stabilize the reasoning-relevant semantics, and the last few layers can then shift the distribution toward generic, alignment-favored, or pragmatically safer continuations. The authors call this pattern Guess–Refine–Perturb. The actual problem is therefore not early exiting for efficiency, but how to choose, at each generation step, the most reliable near-final layer for emission without changing model weights or truncating the forward pass.
summary_en.importance: Its value for foundation-model research is twofold. First, it is a mechanistic claim against the common assumption that deeper is always better for decoding. It links post-training signals—style control, safety shaping, preference alignment—to late-layer distribution drift. That matters for the pretrain/post-train interface, because it suggests that alignment may not only change final behavior, but also alter where in depth the cleanest task semantics appear. Second, the proposed decoding rule is training-free and parameter-free. If the phenomenon is real and robust, part of the so-called alignment tax may be recoverable at inference time rather than only through new training objectives. The deeper takeaway is not the heuristic alone, but the mismatch it exposes between the layer where semantics are best formed and the layer from which the model is forced to emit tokens.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper has two technical components: diagnosing the layer dynamics and designing a decoding rule.

On diagnosis, the authors do more than compare layer-wise accuracies. They analyze residual-stream shifts, contribution norms to logits, and token prediction trajectories across depth. This is used to identify tokens whose semantics stabilize in intermediate layers and tokens whose predictions are noticeably redirected in the final layers. The paper interprets this as late-stage perturbation and frames it as a planning–pragmatics tradeoff: the model internally forms a reasoning-oriented token preference, but the final layers may redirect it toward generic, safe, polite, or alignment-preferred continuations. That framing is more precise than simply saying intermediate layers can be better, because it localizes the issue to a near-final readout problem rather than a broad claim that shallow layers should replace deep ones.

The proposed method, Confident Decoding, keeps the full forward pass intact. It is not an early-exit method. At each generation step, the model still computes all layers, but the decoder additionally reads logits from a small near-final layer window. Entropy is used as a confidence proxy. Starting from the final layer and moving backward conservatively, the algorithm selects the first local entropy trough—intuitively, the point where the distribution has already become sharp, but before a possible late-layer perturbation has redirected it. The selected layer’s logits are then used for greedy decoding or downstream sampling.

A key design choice is that the method does not simply pick the globally lowest-entropy layer. That would often favor layers that are too early: sharp but semantically immature. Nor does it use a fixed intermediate layer, because the best readout depth varies across tokens, tasks, and contexts. The paper formalizes layer selection as an optimal stopping problem. Under bounded projection noise and dominant late-stage perturbation, the preferred policy is to stop at a high-confidence point before the perturbation, not to mechanically decode from the final layer. The theory is stylized rather than a full model of transformer dynamics, but it gives a coherent rationale for the “first local trough” rule.

Relative to prior work, the differences are clear. It is not contrastive decoding that subtracts or contrasts layers while keeping the final layer as the semantic anchor. It is not an efficiency-oriented early-exit method. And it is dynamic at the token and step level, rather than assigning one static exit layer to the whole model. The method is best understood as searching for the cleanest near-final semantic readout point.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation spans reasoning, math, long-context understanding, coding, and safety, using benchmarks such as GPQA-Diamond, HLE, Omni-MATH, LongBench v2, LiveCodeBench v6, and Air-Bench-2024, across both dense and MoE models. The headline result stated in the paper is consistent improvement over standard greedy decoding and strong contrastive baselines, with negligible memory overhead and less than 2% extra latency. The more important evidence in the full paper comes in three forms.

First, the layer-dynamics analysis shows token-level cases where the correct answer token becomes top-ranked in an intermediate layer, only to be replaced in the final layers by a generic token, a formatting token, or a safer alternative. Entropy curves often show a clear confidence trough in the near-final region followed by a redistribution at the last layers. This is especially visible on difficult reasoning, math, and coding examples.

Second, the method is compared against static layer selection, final-layer decoding, and contrastive decoding baselines. Static exits help only on subsets of tasks because the best readout depth is not fixed. Contrastive methods can suppress some undesirable continuations, but they still treat the final layer as the main anchor and therefore do not fully address a global late-layer redirection. The gains of Confident Decoding come from token-wise dynamic layer choice rather than merely exposing intermediate-layer information.

Third, the paper reports a scale-related trend: larger and stronger models tend to exhibit more pronounced late-layer perturbation, making dynamic layer selection more useful. That is an important observation because it argues against the effect being just small-model noise or undertraining. Instead, it may be tied to stronger post-training, style control, and more aggressive semantic compression in capable models.

From the provided text, the only explicit hard number is the latency overhead below 2%. Exact benchmark deltas, model sizes, and window settings need to be checked in the tables. When reading, it is worth verifying whether the gains are concentrated in greedy decoding, whether they persist under sampling or self-consistency, how safety improvements are measured, and whether dense and MoE models prefer similar near-final windows.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and the main figure that illustrates Guess–Refine–Perturb. The goal is to build intuition for the claim before looking at the algorithm. Then go directly to the method section and inspect the entropy-guided conservative backward search in detail. One important point to confirm is that the method does not truncate the transformer and does not train an auxiliary head on intermediate states.

After that, read the theory section with a narrow objective: understand how the authors cast layer selection as an optimal stopping problem, what assumptions they need, and what those assumptions leave out. If you care about the pretrain/post-train interface, this section is useful because it offers a way to think about late-layer shifts as added bias or perturbation rather than continued semantic refinement.

For experiments, read along three tracks. First, inspect the layer-wise entropy and token-trajectory visualizations to judge whether the phenomenon is broad or anecdotal. Second, read the main result tables comparing final-layer decoding, static intermediate layers, contrastive baselines, and Confident Decoding. Third, check the ablations: near-final window size, search rule, whether the local trough criterion matters, and how selected layers distribute across tasks. If time is limited, the phenomenon figures, main tables, and layer-selection histograms should be enough to capture the paper in 30–40 minutes. If reading more deeply, spend time on failure cases and ask whether the method could introduce regressions on factual QA, casual chat, or strongly safety-constrained prompts.

recommendation.zh: 推翻“最后一层解码最优”的领域默认假设，末层对齐扰动的发现应立刻加入预训练-后训练接口的内部ablation，重点看Fig2的层熵变化曲线。
recommendation.en: Overturns the field's default "final-layer-is-best-for-decoding" prior; the finding of alignment-induced final-layer perturbation should be immediately added to internal pretrain-posttrain interface ablations; focus on Fig 2's layer entropy curves.

paper.title: SpotAttention: Plug-In Block-Sparse Routing for Pretrained Long-Context Transformers
paper.abstract: Long contexts have become standard in pretrained LLMs, yet they remain expensive to run: prefill compute grows quadratically with sequence length, and every decode step re-reads a key-value cache that grows linearly with it. Sparse attention cuts these costs by attending only to a relevant subset of past tokens, but selecting that subset is itself expensive. We present SpotAttention, a lightweight selector that attaches to a frozen pretrained transformer and learns by KL distillation to estimate

summary.core_problem: 现有预训练长上下文LLM的稀疏注意力方案存在选择器计算开销高、无法即插即用适配已训练完成的主模型的问题。
summary.importance: 验证了无需修改预训练主模型结构、仅通过外挂轻量选择器加KL蒸馏即可实现高效稀疏注意力，为长上下文模型的推理优化提供了与预训练解耦的可行路径，也揭示了不同层注意力预算存在不对称性这一训练动态特征。
summary.technical_approach: 1. 设计即插即用的块级稀疏选择器，挂载在已冻结的预训练Transformer每一层全注意力层上，仅通过KL散度蒸馏匹配原模型的头平均注意力分布，无需重新训练主模型；2. 选择器采用块级Q-K评分（按查询块×键块而非逐token计算），可直接通过张量核矩阵乘实现，降低选择开销；3. 提出双top-p规则，直接从选择器输出的校准注意力分布中为每个查询、每层动态分配注意力预算，同时预留sink和近邻块避免被核采样过滤，无需额外剪枝阶段；4. 支持对选择器的K缓存做INT4/FP4量化进一步降低内存开销。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen3（稠密注意力，4B-32B）和Qwen3.5（混合线性/全注意力，4B-9B）共7个backbone上完成选择器训练，其中5个完成完整验证；128K上下文解码场景下，Qwen3-8B的吞吐量是FlashAttention的3.9倍、是Twilight的1.8倍；选择器K缓存量化到INT4/FP4可缩小3.5倍体积且保持BF16级精度；在最长128K上下文下性能与稠密注意力持平；观测到不同层的注意力预算存在显著不对称性，静态top-K规则无法匹配该特征。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第3节方法部分的双top-p规则设计、第4节的长上下文吞吐量与精度对比实验，附录中的选择器结构与训练策略消融实验；预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing sparse attention solutions for pretrained long-context LLMs face two core bottlenecks: high computation overhead of the token selector, and lack of plug-and-play compatibility with fully trained backbone models.
summary_en.importance: Validates that efficient sparse attention can be achieved without modifying pretrained backbone architecture, via a lightweight add-on selector trained with KL distillation. This provides a pretraining-decoupled path for long-context inference optimization, and reveals notable inter-layer attention budget asymmetry as a previously underdiscussed training dynamic.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1. A plug-in block-wise sparse selector is attached to each frozen full-attention layer of a pretrained Transformer, trained only via KL divergence to match the backbone's head-averaged attention distribution, with no retraining of the main model. 2. Block-wise Q-K scoring (per query-block × key-block tile instead of per-token) runs as a single tensor-core matrix multiplication, cutting selector overhead sharply. 3. A dual top-p rule directly allocates per-query, per-layer attention budgets from the selector's calibrated output distribution, with reserved sink and recency blocks to avoid exclusion by nucleus sampling and no separate pruning stage. 4. INT4/FP4 quantization of the selector's K-cache is supported for further memory reduction.
summary_en.experiments: Selector training completed on 7 backbones across two architecture families: Qwen3 (dense attention, 4B–32B) and Qwen3.5 (hybrid linear/full attention, 4B–9B), with full validation on 5 of them. For Qwen3-8B at 128K context decode, throughput reaches 3.9× FlashAttention and 1.8× Twilight. Quantizing the selector's K-cache to INT4/FP4 reduces its size by 3.5× while retaining BF16-level accuracy. Performance matches dense attention at contexts up to 128K; significant inter-layer attention budget asymmetry is observed, which static top-K rules cannot match.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 (dual top-p rule design in the method pipeline), Section 4 (long-context throughput and accuracy comparison experiments), and ablation studies on selector structure and training strategy in the appendix; estimated reading time 15–20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 §方法和长外推实验；若 128K 上真能稳住精度，内部长上下文服务应复现。
recommendation.en: Read the method and length-extrapolation experiments; if 128K accuracy holds, this deserves an internal serving reproduction.

paper.title: Closing the Calibration Gap in Semantic Caching
paper.abstract: Semantic caching cuts LLM inference costs by serving a cached response to semantically similar queries. Standard practice evaluates these systems using PR-AUC, a metric that only measures how well scores rank and ignores whether they are usable at a fixed threshold. We show this mismatch leads to systematically poor deployment choices, as models with the highest PR-AUC are often the worst in operation. We introduce Precision-Cache Hit Ratio (P-CHR) AUC, a cache-aware metric that measures precisi

summary.core_problem: 现有语义缓存系统采用PR-AUC作为评测指标，仅关注排序能力，无法反映固定阈值下的实际部署效果，导致部署选型出现系统性偏差
summary.importance: 指标/方法创新，提出适配语义缓存部署场景的新评测指标，分解了离线与部署效果差距的来源，为缓存系统优化提供了量化依据
summary.technical_approach: 提出P-CHR AUC衡量不同缓存利用率下的精度，CRR衡量离线排序质量的部署留存率；将离线与部署的效果差距分解为可恢复的校准误差与不可恢复的数据集结构误差
summary.experiments: 实验验证校准gap主要由训练目标而非数据规模决定，事后校准仅能部分消除差距；摘要截断，未完整披露具体模型与量化提升幅度

summary_en.core_problem: Existing semantic caching systems use PR-AUC as the evaluation metric, which only measures ranking ability and fails to reflect real deployment performance at fixed thresholds, leading to systematic deployment selection biases
summary_en.importance: Metric/method innovation that proposes deployment-aligned evaluation metrics for semantic caching, decomposes the source of offline-to-deployment performance gaps, and provides quantitative guidance for cache system optimization
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes P-CHR AUC to measure precision across cache utilization levels, and CRR to measure the retention of offline ranking quality in deployment; decomposes the offline-deployment performance gap into recoverable calibration error and irreducible dataset structural error
summary_en.experiments: Experiments verify that the calibration gap is mainly determined by training objectives rather than data scale, and post-hoc calibration only partially closes the gap; abstract is truncated, with no full model details or quantitative improvement disclosed

recommendation.zh: 语义缓存评测指标的修正工作，仅对负责LLM serving的团队有参考价值，预训练研究员无需深入阅读
recommendation.en: Metric correction work for semantic caching evaluation; only relevant for LLM serving teams, no value for pretraining researchers

paper.title: Token-Operations-Oriented Inference Optimization Techniques for Large Models
paper.abstract: Large model inference optimization serves as a key foundation for supporting the scalable, low-cost, and highly stable operation of large model services. Centered on token-oriented inference optimization technology, this paper proposes for the first time a four-layer technical architecture consisting of Multi-model Fusion, Model Optimization, Compute-Model Fusion, and Compute-Network-Model Fusion. It systematically reviews the key technologies and current industry status across these four levels

summary.core_problem: 大模型推理优化技术缺乏统一的分层架构，难以系统指导工业场景下降本提效的落地实践。
summary.importance: 提出面向token操作的四层推理优化技术架构，系统梳理各层关键技术与行业落地现状，给出工业场景下的技术落地路径。
summary.technical_approach: 将现有推理优化技术划分为多模型融合、模型优化、计算-模型融合、计算-网络-模型融合四个层级，做系统性综述与业务场景价值分析。
summary.experiments: 综述性工作，无原创实验，结合真实业务场景分析各类技术的应用价值与落地效果。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM inference optimization lacks a unified layered technical architecture to systematically guide cost reduction and efficiency improvement in industrial deployment scenarios.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a token-oriented four-layer technical architecture for inference optimization, systematically reviewing key technologies and industry adoption status across layers to provide practical deployment guidance.
summary_en.technical_approach: Organizes existing inference optimization techniques into four layers: multi-model fusion, model optimization, compute-model fusion, and compute-network-model fusion, then conducts a systematic review and business scenario value analysis.
summary_en.experiments: This is a survey paper with no original experiments; it analyzes application value of technologies based on real-world business deployment cases.

recommendation.zh: 面向工业服务的推理优化四层分类框架，无原创研究结论，适合Serving工程团队参考，预训练研究员无需读正文。
recommendation.en: Industry-focused four-layer taxonomy of LLM inference optimizations with no novel research findings; useful for serving engineers, skip for pretraining work.

paper.title: SafeSpec: Fast and Safe LLM via Dynamic Reflective Sampling
paper.abstract: Speculative inference accelerates large language model (LLM) decoding but provides no inherent safety guarantees. Existing safety defenses are largely incompatible with speculative inference: they either introduce additional computation or disrupt the draft-verify mechanism, negating acceleration benefits. This reveals a fundamental incompatibility between current safety methods and speculative decoding. We propose SafeSpec, a safety-aware speculative inference framework that integrates risk est

summary.core_problem: 现有推测解码与LLM安全防御机制不兼容，安全方案要么引入额外计算要么破坏草稿-验证机制，完全抵消加速收益。
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次提出安全感知的推测推理框架，解决推测解码加速与内容安全的兼容性问题。
summary.technical_approach: 给目标模型附加轻量潜在安全头，单次前向同时评估语义有效性与安全性；检测到不安全内容时执行回滚，采用安全引导的反射多采样恢复安全续接而非终止生成；将越狱攻击建模为生成轨迹上的分布偏移。
summary.experiments: 摘要未完整披露实验细节，未给出具体模型参数量、基准对比与加速/安全指标的量化结果。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing speculative decoding is fundamentally incompatible with LLM safety defenses, which either add extra compute overhead or break the draft-verify mechanism and negate speedup gains.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation introducing the first safety-aware speculative inference framework to resolve the conflict between decoding acceleration and content safety guarantees.
summary_en.technical_approach: Attaches a lightweight latent safety head to the target model for joint semantic validity and safety evaluation in one forward pass; performs rollback and safety-guided reflective multi-sampling to recover safe continuations instead of terminating generation; models jailbreak attacks as distributional shifts over generative trajectories.
summary_en.experiments: Full experimental details are not fully disclosed in the truncated abstract; no specific model sizes, baselines, or quantitative speedup/safety metrics are provided.

recommendation.zh: 推测解码与安全对齐交叉方向的工程实现参考，仅对做推理侧安全的研究员有用，无预训练直接启示。
recommendation.en: Engineering reference for the intersection of speculative decoding and safety; only useful for inference-side safety work, no direct pretraining insights.

paper.title: Moving Beyond Diversity: Visual Token Pruning as Subspace Reconstruction for Efficient VLMs
paper.abstract: Despite their remarkable performance, Vision Language Models (VLMs) incur substantial computational overhead due to the large number of visual tokens. While diversity maximization has become a dominant strategy for token reduction, existing methods rely on cosine-based normalized similarity that discards magnitude information, failing to faithfully approximate the original feature representation and leading to suboptimal performance, particularly on compositional multi-skill reasoning tasks. In

summary.core_problem: 降低 VLM 推理中大量视觉 token 带来的计算开销，同时尽量保持原始视觉特征表示，尤其是组合式多技能推理能力。
summary.importance: 贡献是 VLM 视觉 token pruning 的效率方法和一个值得记录的现象：仅按 cosine 多样性或图文相关性选 token 可能丢掉重要上下文。它对 serving 和视觉 token 预算有参考价值，但不是预训练方法本身。
summary.technical_approach: SPARE 将 token pruning 重新表述为 column subset selection，以子空间重建误差为目标，而不是只最大化归一化 cosine 多样性。方法迭代选择投影残差较大的 token，以保留原特征空间；同时利用低图文相关性 token 可能保留上下文的信息，提出相应选择策略。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、数据集、压缩率和数值提升。实验主张是在组合式多技能推理任务上，重建驱动的 token 选择比基于 cosine 多样性的 pruning 更稳，并能缓解只看图文相关性的选择偏差。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to reduce the computational cost of VLM inference caused by many visual tokens while preserving the original feature representation, especially for compositional reasoning.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an efficiency method for visual token pruning and an empirical observation that cosine-diversity or image-text relevance alone can discard contextual tokens. It is useful for VLM serving and token-budget design, but it is not a pretraining method.
summary_en.technical_approach: SPARE formulates token pruning as a column subset selection problem that minimizes subspace reconstruction error. It iteratively selects tokens with large projection residuals, preserving magnitude information ignored by normalized cosine similarity. The paper also uses the observation that low image-text relevance tokens may preserve context.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model names, datasets, pruning ratios, or numerical gains. The claimed finding is that reconstruction-driven selection is more reliable than cosine-diversity pruning, particularly on compositional multi-skill reasoning tasks.

recommendation.zh: 值得记住“低相关 token 保上下文”这个坑；不是预训练问题，等做 VLM token 预算再翻实验。
recommendation.en: Keep the low-relevance-token context effect in mind; not a pretraining paper, but worth revisiting for VLM token-budget experiments.

paper.title: ARIADNE: Agnostic Routing for Inference-time Adapter DyNamic sElection
paper.abstract: The increasing deployment of parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) has led to model ecosystems in which a single backbone is paired with many task-specialized adapters. In this setting, inference-time queries often arrive without task labels, requiring the system to automatically select the most appropriate adapter from a growing and heterogeneous adapter pool. Existing routing methods either depend on access to adapter internals, such as weight decompositions or gradient-based statistics, or r

summary.core_problem: PEFT生态中，单骨干模型搭配大量任务专用适配器，推理时无标签输入无法自动选择最优适配器，现有路由方法依赖适配器内部信息或额外训练，扩展性与可移植性差
summary.importance: 工程向方法创新，提出训练无关、适配器无关的推理时动态路由框架，无需修改适配器权重或额外训练即可实现适配器选择
summary.technical_approach: 提出ARIADNE框架：1）用各适配器训练集的嵌入计算质心，表征对应任务的数据分布；2）推理时计算输入嵌入与各质心的距离，选择最近的适配器执行推理
summary.experiments: 在多适配器场景下验证，相比现有路由方法，在无需额外训练的前提下取得相当或更优的适配器选择准确率，未披露具体量化数据

summary_en.core_problem: In PEFT ecosystems, a single backbone is paired with many task-specialized adapters, and unlabeled inference queries cannot automatically select the optimal adapter. Existing routing methods rely on adapter internal information or additional training, with poor scalability and portability
summary_en.importance: Engineering-oriented method innovation: training-free, adapter-agnostic dynamic routing framework for inference-time adapter selection, no adapter weight modification or extra training required
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose ARIADNE framework: 1) compute centroids from embeddings of each adapter's training set to represent the corresponding task's data distribution; 2) measure distance between input embedding and each centroid during inference, select the nearest adapter
summary_en.experiments: Verified in multi-adapter scenarios, achieved comparable or better adapter selection accuracy than existing routing methods without extra training; no specific quantitative data disclosed

recommendation.zh: PEFT多适配器部署的工程方案，做多模型/多适配器推理系统时可参考路由思路，仅看方法部分即可
recommendation.en: Engineering solution for multi-adapter PEFT deployment, reference routing design only when building multi-adapter inference systems, read method section only

paper.title: AoiZora: Topology-Aware Auto-Parallel Optimization for Inference of Diffusion Transformers
paper.abstract: Video diffusion has quickly grown into a key generative serving workload, yet producing each clip demands many denoising iterations over large spatio-temporal latents, which puts low-latency inference out of reach on a single device. A denoising step is therefore typically distributed across multiple accelerators, and TPU sub-slices have become an attractive and practical fabric for doing so. Current auto-parallel systems, however, search almost exclusively over logical device meshes and disrega

summary.core_problem: 降低视频 Diffusion Transformer 在 TPU 子切片上的低延迟推理成本，解决自动并行只看逻辑 mesh、不看物理互连拓扑的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是推理系统和编译器优化：面向视频扩散服务，把逻辑 sharding 与物理设备放置重新连接起来。它不是 LLM 预训练方法，但对大规模生成模型 serving、并行策略搜索和硬件拓扑感知调度有工程参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AoiZora，一个 compiler-mediated topology planner。它先用低成本的性能信号筛掉弱 sharding 候选，再在编译流程中结合逻辑分片和 TPU 物理互连布局，寻找更适合低延迟视频扩散推理的并行和放置方案。
summary.experiments: 摘要描述目标负载为视频 diffusion 的多步 denoising，在大时空 latent 上跨多个加速器运行。论文声称现有 auto-parallel 系统忽略物理拓扑会留下明显性能损失，但摘要未给出具体模型、TPU 配置、延迟降低比例或吞吐提升数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets low-latency inference for video Diffusion Transformers on TPU sub-slices, where existing auto-parallel systems optimize logical meshes while ignoring physical interconnect topology.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a serving-system and compiler optimization: reconnecting logical sharding decisions with physical device placement for video diffusion workloads. It is not an LLM pretraining method, but it is relevant to large generative-model serving, parallel-strategy search, and topology-aware scheduling.
summary_en.technical_approach: AoiZora is a compiler-mediated topology planner. It first prunes weak sharding candidates using inexpensive performance signals, then uses information from the compilation flow to combine logical sharding with physical TPU placement for low-latency diffusion inference.
summary_en.experiments: The target workload is multi-step denoising for video diffusion over large spatio-temporal latents distributed across accelerators. The abstract claims that topology-oblivious auto-parallel systems leave substantial performance on the table, but does not provide model names, TPU configurations, latency numbers, or throughput gains.

recommendation.zh: 如果关心生成模型 serving，看拓扑感知搜索部分即可；没有预训练 insight，但能提醒并行 ablation 别只报逻辑 mesh。
recommendation.en: If you care about generative serving, read the topology-aware search part; no pretraining insight, but a good warning against reporting only logical meshes.

paper.title: AnchorKV: Safety-Aware KV Cache Compression via Soft Penalty with a Refusal Anchor
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) outperform earlier architectures on generative inference and long-context tasks, but their large size introduces significant challenges in memory usage, energy cost, and on-device deployment. Since scaling pre-trained language models improves downstream capability \cite{zhao2023survey}, the key-value (KV) cache becomes a dominant inference bottleneck. Recent KV cache compression methods \cite{jo2025fastkv,li2024snapkv,zhou2024dynamickv} reduce this cost by retaining

summary.core_problem: 现有KV缓存压缩方法在激进驱逐策略下会破坏LLM的安全对齐能力，无法防御越狱攻击，缺乏兼顾推理效率与安全属性的KV压缩方案。
summary.importance: 工程创新类贡献，首次提出安全感知的KV缓存压缩范式，解决KV压缩率与安全对齐性能的冲突问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出AnchorKV方法，离线构造与有害提示对应的拒绝锚点向量，在现有KV压缩的token保留评分中加入软惩罚项，偏向保留与安全拒绝相关的key方向，为现有KV压缩方法的即插即用修改。
summary.experiments: 在多个开源LLM上测试，对比FastKV、SnapKV等基线方法，在保持相近压缩率与良性任务精度的同时，显著提升多种越狱攻击的防御成功率。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing KV cache compression methods break LLM safety alignment under aggressive eviction policies and fail to defend against jailbreak attacks, lacking a KV compression scheme that balances inference efficiency and safety.
summary_en.importance: Engineering innovation contribution; first safety-aware KV cache compression paradigm that resolves the tradeoff between compression ratio and safety alignment performance.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes AnchorKV, a drop-in modification for existing KV compression methods: constructs an offline refusal anchor aligned with harmful prompts, adds a soft penalty to token retention scores to preserve key directions associated with safe refusal.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on multiple open-source LLMs; compared to baselines like FastKV and SnapKV, it maintains similar compression ratio and benign task accuracy while significantly improving defense success rate against various jailbreak attacks.

recommendation.zh: 推理侧KV压缩的安全增强工作，与预训练方法论关联弱，仅需知道该方向存在，无需深入正文。
recommendation.en: Safety enhancement for inference-side KV cache compression; weak relevance to pretraining methodology, only need to be aware of this direction, no deep reading required.

paper.title: ReSET: Accurate Latency-Critical NVFP4 Reasoning via Step-Aware Temperature Scaling
paper.abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) improve complex problem-solving by generating long intermediate reasoning traces, but this substantially increases inference costs. NVFP4 inference offers a promising approach to reduce both computational and memory costs through hardware-supported low-precision execution. However, directly applying NVFP4 to LRMs introduces two practical limitations: reasoning accuracy degrades under quantization, and existing NVFP4 kernels do not fully realize latency benefits in s

summary.core_problem: NVFP4低精度推理在大推理模型(LRM)上导致推理精度下降，且现有NVFP4内核在小批量自回归解码中未充分发挥延迟优势
summary.importance: 方法创新——首次针对推理模型量化后不同步骤的token不确定性差异提出自适应温度缩放策略
summary.technical_approach: ReSET方法：在线估计每个推理步骤的token级熵不确定性，对低熵符号token降低采样温度以抑制错误采样，对高不确定性步骤调整温度分布；分析了NVFP4量化对token不确定性的具体影响
summary.experiments: 摘要被截断，已知发现：NVFP4量化在低熵符号token上增加错误采样，在高不确定性推理步骤中导致token分布过度集中

summary_en.core_problem: NVFP4 low-precision inference degrades reasoning accuracy on large reasoning models, and existing NVFP4 kernels underdeliver latency benefits in small-batch autoregressive decoding
summary_en.importance: Method innovation—first to propose adaptive temperature scaling based on per-step token uncertainty in quantized reasoning models
summary_en.technical_approach: ReSET: online estimates token-level entropy uncertainty at each reasoning step, lowers temperature for low-entropy symbolic tokens to suppress incorrect sampling, adjusts temperature distribution for high-uncertainty steps; includes analysis of NVFP4 quantization's specific impact on token uncertainty
summary_en.experiments: Abstract truncated; finding: NVFP4 quantization increases incorrect sampling at low-entropy symbolic tokens and causes over-concentration in high-uncertainty reasoning steps

recommendation.zh: token级量化误差分析有一定启发性，但温度缩放属于推理侧补丁，对预训练无直接借鉴，看摘要即可
recommendation.en: Token-level quantization error analysis has some relevance, but temperature scaling is an inference-side patch; no direct pretraining takeaways, read abstract only

paper.title: Arbor: Tree Search as a Cognition Layer for Autonomous Agents
paper.abstract: Arbor is a multi-agent framework that introduces structured tree search as a cognition layer for autonomous agents operating in large, stateful action spaces. Prior autonomous optimization systems operate on isolated targets with stateless evaluation. Arbor instead maintains an explicit search tree of scored hypotheses that serves as the shared working memory across agents, evolving with every measurement, treating failures as diagnostic signal that reshapes subsequent exploration, and expanding

summary.core_problem: 自主代理在大型有状态动作空间中缺乏结构化认知层，传统优化系统针对孤立目标、无状态评估，无法跨层次协调决策并从失败中学习。
summary.importance: 提出将显式树搜索作为多代理共享工作记忆的认知层范式，在 LLM 推理全栈优化这一复杂真实场景中进行了验证。
summary.technical_approach: Arbor 维护一个显式搜索树作为跨代理共享工作记忆，每次测量后演化，将失败视为诊断信号重塑后续探索。架构包括 Orchestrator agent（跨推理栈委派给 Domain Specialists）和 Critic agent（通过根本原因分析保障稳定性），搜索树作为 scored hypotheses 的共享记忆。
summary.experiments: 在 LLM 推理全栈优化（应用、框架、编译器、kernel、硬件栈）上验证，对比传统孤立优化方法，展示 Arbor 在协调多领域专家和从失败中学习方面的优势。
summary.authors_note: 机构未从摘要确认，推测可能来自微软研究团队（Emad Barsoum 曾任职 Microsoft）。

summary_en.core_problem: Autonomous agents in large stateful action spaces lack a structured cognition layer; traditional optimization targets isolated goals with stateless evaluation, failing to coordinate across levels or learn from failures.
summary_en.importance: Proposes explicit tree search as shared working memory across agents — a new cognition-layer paradigm for multi-agent systems — validated on the complex real-world task of full-stack LLM inference optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: Arbor maintains an explicit search tree of scored hypotheses as shared working memory across agents, evolving with every measurement, treating failures as diagnostic signals to reshape subsequent exploration. Architecture pairs an Orchestrator agent (delegates to Domain Specialists across the inference stack) with a Critic agent (safeguards stability via root-cause analysis).
summary_en.experiments: Validated on full-stack LLM inference optimization (application, framework, compiler, kernel, hardware), showing advantages over traditional isolated optimization methods in coordinating domain specialists and learning from failures.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutional affiliation not confirmed from abstract; Emad Barsoum has past Microsoft affiliation.

recommendation.zh: 树搜索 + 多代理认知层的范式在 LLM 推理优化场景有启发性，对做 agentic inference / 自动化系统调优的研究有参考。预训练研究员可浏览 §3 搜索树设计了解思路。
recommendation.en: Tree search + multi-agent cognition layer paradigm is conceptually interesting for agentic inference and automated system tuning. Pre-training researchers may browse §3 search tree design for high-level ideas.

paper.title: Teaching Diffusion to Speculate Left-to-Right
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve remarkable performance across a wide range of tasks, but their autoregressive decoding process incurs substantial inference costs due to inherently sequential token generation. Speculative decoding addresses this bottleneck by employing a lightweight draft model to propose multiple future tokens that are subsequently verified in parallel by a larger target model. Recent work has demonstrated that diffusion language models are well suited for this setting, as

summary.core_problem: 扩散语言模型做 speculative decoding 时，训练目标是块内双向生成，但验证器是自回归左到右验收，训练-推理目标不一致会拖累接受率和加速收益。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值不在于再做一个 diffusion LM，而在于指出并修正了 block diffusion drafter 在 speculative decoding 场景下的目标错配。对研究非 AR 文本建模与推理加速接口的人，这个问题很实在。
