paper.title: Hybrid Verified Decoding: Learning to Allocate Verification in Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) generation remains expensive because autoregressive decoding calls the model once for each new token. Speculative decoding reduces this cost by drafting multiple tokens and verifying them with the target model in one step, but its speedup depends on how many drafted tokens are accepted. Parameter-free draft sources can propose long continuations at low cost in structured and agentic workloads, yet a cache match that looks promising at one generation step may have low p

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决 speculative decoding 中一个很实际的问题：缓存式 draft 很便宜，也可能一次提出很长续写，但当前状态下到底能被 target model 接受多少 token 并不稳定；如果接受长度很短，验证成本会被浪费。
summary.importance: 这是一篇推理效率方向的工作，对预训练的间接价值在于 serving 约束。大模型生成成本越来越受解码阶段限制，尤其是结构化输出、代码、工具调用和 agent 轨迹中存在大量重复上下文。论文的贡献不是改 target model，也不是训练更大的 drafter，而是把“是否使用缓存 draft”建模成每一步的收益预测问题。这类方法对训练侧也有启发：如果模型部署主要面对高重复结构 workloads，那么预训练或后训练时对格式、工具轨迹和长上下文重复模式的建模，会影响推理系统可利用的 speculative opportunity。
summary.technical_approach: 方法名为 Hybrid Verified Decoding。它保留标准 speculative decoding 的 draft-then-verify 接口：draft source 提出若干 token，target model 一次验证，并提交被接受的前缀。核心变量是 accepted length，即某个 draft 在当前 prefix 下会被 target model 接受的 token 数。论文使用两类 draft source：一类是参数免费的 cache-based drafter，具体采用类似 SuffixDecoding 的 suffix cache，从 prompt 和已生成历史中查找后缀匹配并复用后续片段；另一类是 model-based drafter，例如 EAGLE 系列这类经过训练的 proposal model。Hybrid Verified Decoding 在验证前先预测当前 cache draft 的 accepted length。如果预测收益高，就把缓存续写送去验证；如果预测收益低，就改用 model-based drafter。训练信号来自 trace replay：先在生成轨迹上回放不同状态下的 cache draft，记录真实 accepted length，再用这些轻量标签训练 runtime payoff predictor。这样 target model 和验证规则都不变，新增模块只负责分配每一步的验证预算。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 3 个 LLM、16 个数据集，并与 greedy decoding、纯 model-based speculative decoding、纯 cache-based decoding、rule-based hybrid 等基线比较。论文还实现了 vLLM serving prototype，用于接近部署条件的验证。提供文本没有给出具体加速比例，但实验分析维度较完整：从输入结构产生多少 cache opportunity，到 cache draft 的真实 accepted length，再到 predictor 的选择行为、执行成本和 prompt template 敏感性。核心结果是，缓存机会多但质量波动大的结构化和 agentic workloads 中，按步预测收益比固定使用缓存或简单规则切换更合理。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。先看 Introduction 对 cache draft 风险的定义，再看 Method 中 accepted length payoff、suffix cache drafter 和 model-based drafter 的切换逻辑。实验部分重点看四类分析：cache opportunity 是否真的存在，accepted length 分布是否长尾，payoff predictor 是否学到有效选择边界，以及不同 prompt template 是否改变缓存收益。对做 serving 或长上下文生成优化的人，vLLM prototype 和 execution cost analysis 比单一 benchmark 分数更值得看。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a practical bottleneck in speculative decoding: cache-based drafts are cheap and can be long, but their accepted length is highly state-dependent. A promising local cache match can still be rejected early by the target model, wasting verification work.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference-efficiency paper, with indirect relevance to foundation-model research through serving constraints. Structured outputs, code generation, tool calls, and agent trajectories often contain repeated context, making cache reuse attractive. The key contribution is not changing the target model or building a larger drafter. It reframes draft-source selection as per-step payoff prediction, where the system estimates whether a cache draft is worth verifying before spending a target-model verification pass.
summary_en.technical_approach: Hybrid Verified Decoding keeps the standard draft-then-verify interface. A draft source proposes a block of tokens; the target model verifies the block and commits the accepted prefix. The payoff variable is accepted length, the number of drafted tokens accepted at the current decoding state. The method combines two draft sources. The first is a parameter-free cache drafter, instantiated with a suffix cache similar to SuffixDecoding, which searches the prompt and generated history for suffix matches and reuses following spans. The second is a model-based drafter, such as the EAGLE family. Before verification, a lightweight predictor estimates the accepted length of the current cache draft. If the predicted payoff is high, the cache draft is verified. Otherwise, the system falls back to the model-based drafter. The predictor is trained by trace replay: generation traces are replayed to obtain accepted-length labels for cache drafts at different states. The target model and verification rule remain unchanged; the learned component only allocates verification across draft sources.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans three LLMs and sixteen datasets, with comparisons against greedy decoding, model-based speculative decoding, cache-based decoding, and rule-based hybrid approaches. The authors also implement a vLLM serving prototype for deployment-oriented validation. The provided text does not include exact speedup numbers, but it describes a broad analysis pipeline: cache opportunity from input structure, actual verification payoff, predictor decisions, execution cost, and prompt-template sensitivity. The main empirical message is that in structured and agentic workloads, cache drafts are useful but uneven; predicting payoff per decoding step is preferable to always using cache drafts or switching with fixed rules.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25–35 minute skim is appropriate. Read the introduction for the failure mode of cache drafting, then the method section for the accepted-length payoff formulation, suffix-cache drafting, and the fallback to a model-based drafter. In the experiments, prioritize the analyses of cache opportunity, accepted-length distribution, predictor behavior, and prompt-template sensitivity. For readers working on serving systems, the vLLM prototype and execution-cost breakdown are more informative than a single aggregate speedup number.

recommendation.zh: 这是 serving 侧的干净改进，不改模型但改决策层；如果你关心 agentic 推理成本，只看 accepted-length predictor 和对 EAGLE3 的对比就够了。
recommendation.en: A clean serving-side improvement: it leaves the model alone and fixes the decision layer; if agentic inference cost matters to you, read the accepted-length predictor and the comparison against EAGLE3.

paper.title: Mitigating Hallucinations in Large Language Models Via Decoder Layer Skipping
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance across diverse natural language tasks, yet their outputs often suffer from hallucinations -- content that is misaligned with factual information. In this work, we conduct a comprehensive layer-wise analysis of the decoding process and reveal that hallucinations tend to originate from deeper decoder layers. To address this issue, we introduce \textbf{DeLask} (\textbf{De}coder \textbf{La}yer \textbf{Sk}ipping), a novel decoding framewor

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作关注的是一个很具体的推理时问题：Transformer 解码过程中，哪些层更容易把表示推向 hallucination，以及能否不重训模型、只靠解码时的层级控制来减轻这种偏移。作者的核心判断是，深层 decoder 在做事实性决策时贡献更大，但也更容易把分布推离较稳的方向；因此 hallucination 并不只是最终 logits 的问题，而可能是在若干后层逐步放大的表示漂移。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的启发中等，主要价值在于提供了一个 layer-wise decoding 视角，而不是提出新的训练范式。它把“哪些层在制造错误”这个问题操作化成可测的 drift 指标，并据此做动态 layer skipping。这个思路对理解训练后模型的层功能分工、以及设计更细粒度的 test-time control 有参考意义。对预训练主线的直接影响有限，因为方法不改数据、不改目标、不改优化器，也没有给出 hallucination 成因在训练阶段的更深解释；更像 inference-time mitigation 和机制分析的结合。
summary.technical_approach: 方法建立在一个近似解释上：把 L 层 Transformer 的前向过程类比为多步梯度下降。基于这个视角，作者对相邻层做 early-exit 投影，把每层 hidden state 直接映射到最终词表头，得到各层的 token 分布；再用相邻层分布差定义“梯度”，并计算相邻两步梯度之间的余弦相似度，称为 driftance。若 driftance 很负，说明后一步更新方向与前一步明显背离，作者将其视为该层正在把解码推向不稳定甚至错误方向的信号。检测到问题层后，DeLask 不做硬性整层删除，而是采用 partial skipping：将当前层输出与前一层表示做聚合，以减弱该层影响但保留跨层连续性。作者强调这比 full skip 更稳，因为完全跳过会破坏残差链上的语义一致性，尤其在 reasoning 场景下容易伤害正常计算路径。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 factual hallucination detection、multiple-choice reasoning 和 open-ended generation 三类任务，共七个 benchmark。论文先做了动机实验：在 LLaMA3-8B 上，从中后层开始逐步跳过 decoder layer，发现某些深层被移除后 TruthfulQA、ARC-C、GSM8K 等任务反而变好，这为“深层更可能引入 hallucination”提供了经验支持。正式实验中，DeLask 相比原始解码和若干推理时基线取得更稳的提升，说明动态检测比固定跳层更有效。消融重点有三类：一是 full skip 对比 partial skip，后者通常更稳，验证了保留层间连续性的必要性；二是不同 driftance 阈值或触发策略，说明过于激进的跳层会伤害正常样本；三是不同层区间的分析，收益主要集中在中后层而非浅层。给出的全文片段没有完整结果表，因此无法可靠复述每个 benchmark 的精确增益，但从叙述看，方法在事实性问答和开放生成上的收益比纯数学推理更自然，因为它针对的是 factual drift，而不是系统性提升推理能力。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议很明确。先看 Introduction 里的 preliminary analysis，确认作者为什么把问题定位到深层 decoder。再看 Method 中 driftance 的定义，弄清它到底测的是 logits 变化方向，而不是 hidden state 本身的几何距离。最后看 partial skip 的实现和消融，因为方法是否成立主要取决于“怎么跳”而不是“要不要跳”。预计 20–30 分钟可以读完主线。值得多想的点有两个：一是 early-exit 投影到最终 lm head 这一做法是否会系统性偏向后层、从而影响 driftance 的解释；二是把层前向解释成梯度下降虽然有启发性，但在实际大模型里只是近似，方法有效不等于这个理论解释完全成立。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a narrow but useful question: during decoding, which transformer layers are most responsible for pushing generation toward hallucination, and can that be mitigated without retraining the model? The authors argue that deeper decoder layers play a larger role in factual decision-making, but that they can also introduce unstable updates that move the token distribution away from a more reliable trajectory. In that view, hallucination is not only a final-logit issue; it is a layerwise drift phenomenon that accumulates late in the stack.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model research is moderate. The contribution is not a new pretraining method, but a concrete layerwise perspective on inference-time failure. The useful part is the operationalization: the paper defines a measurable signal, driftance, to identify suspicious layers online and then applies dynamic layer skipping. That can inform future work on layer specialization, test-time control, and mechanistic analysis of factuality. The direct impact on pretraining is limited, since the method does not change data, objectives, or optimization, and it does not really explain how hallucination is formed during training. It is better read as an inference-time mitigation method with a light mechanistic framing.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method is built on an analogy between an L-layer transformer forward pass and a multi-step gradient descent process. Using this lens, the authors project hidden states from consecutive layers through the final LM head with an early-exit strategy, obtaining per-layer token distributions. The difference between consecutive layer distributions is treated as a gradient-like update. They then compute the cosine similarity between adjacent gradient-like updates and call it driftance. A strongly negative driftance indicates that the later update sharply deviates from the previous direction, which the paper interprets as a sign that the current layer may be steering decoding toward hallucination. Once such a layer is detected, DeLask does not fully remove it. Instead, it applies partial skipping by aggregating the current layer output with the previous layer representation. The rationale is that hard skipping can break cross-layer coherence and damage useful computation, while partial skipping attenuates the harmful contribution without collapsing the residual pathway.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans three task groups—factual hallucination detection, multiple-choice reasoning, and open-ended generation—across seven benchmarks. The motivation experiment is important: on LLaMA3-8B, progressively skipping middle-to-deep layers can improve performance on datasets such as TruthfulQA, ARC-Challenge, and GSM8K, which supports the claim that some deeper layers are harmful at inference time. In the main results, DeLask improves over standard decoding and over several inference-time baselines, suggesting that dynamic detection is better than fixed layer removal. The ablations focus on three issues. First, partial skip versus full skip: partial skip is generally more stable, which supports the design choice to preserve layer continuity. Second, thresholding and triggering strategy: overly aggressive skipping hurts normal cases, so selectivity matters. Third, layer-range analysis: the gains mostly come from intervening in middle and deeper layers rather than shallow ones. The provided excerpt does not include the full result tables, so I cannot quote exact benchmark numbers safely. From the task setup, though, the method appears more naturally aligned with factual QA and open-ended generation than with pure mathematical reasoning, because it targets factual drift rather than general reasoning competence.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the preliminary analysis in the introduction to see why the paper localizes the problem to deeper decoder layers. Then read the driftance definition carefully in the method section; the key is that it measures directional change in layerwise logit updates, not geometric distance in hidden space. Finally, look at the implementation of partial skipping and the ablations, because the practical value of the method depends more on how the skip is applied than on the high-level intuition. Around 20 to 30 minutes should be enough for the main thread. Two questions are worth keeping in mind while reading: whether projecting intermediate layers through the final LM head biases the interpretation toward later layers, and whether the gradient-descent analogy is explanatory or merely a useful heuristic.

recommendation.zh: 将 Transformer 前向计算等效为梯度下降，通过梯度方向反转来定位幻觉层并进行跳跃，思路新颖，可作为推理优化的参考。
recommendation.en: Equating Transformer forward computation to gradient descent and locating hallucination layers via gradient direction reversal for skipping is a novel idea, serving as a reference for inference optimization.

paper.title: UniScale: Adaptive Unified Inference Scaling via Online Joint Optimization of Model Routing and Test-Time Scaling
paper.abstract: In real-world deployments of large language models (LLMs), balancing inference quality and computational cost has become a central challenge. Existing approaches tackle this trade-off along two largely independent dimensions: model routing, which switches among models of different scales to match request complexity, and test-time scaling (TTS), which adjusts inference-time compute within a fixed model for fine-grained control. However, this decoupled design introduces inherent limitations. Model

summary.core_problem: UniScale 解决的是在线推理服务中的质量—成本联合控制问题。已有方法通常把模型路由和 test-time scaling 分开做：路由可以在不同规模模型之间切换，但粒度粗；单模型 TTS 可以细调推理计算量，但受限于该模型的能力上限。论文把二者合成一个统一的推理配置空间，让系统同时决定用哪个模型、以及在该模型上采用怎样的 TTS 策略。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，但对基座模型研究有间接价值。它把“模型规模选择”和“推理时计算分配”放在同一个优化框架里，提供了一个更贴近真实服务的 scaling 视角。对预训练研究员有用的地方在于：能力不只由参数量和训练 token 决定，部署阶段的计算调度也会改变有效能力边界；小模型加较强 TTS 和大模型加轻量 TTS 之间存在可替代关系。这个观察会影响模型族设计、能力分层、router 训练、以及推理预算下的模型评估方式。
summary.technical_approach: 方法的核心是 Unified Inference Scaling。一个 UIS 配置同时包含 base model 和 TTS 参数。TTS 被形式化为三维参数空间：Question Parallelism 表示探索多少个推理子树，Candidate Parallelism 表示每步并行采样候选数，Beam Size 表示保留多少个经验证的节点。这样，系统不再只在模型之间做离散选择，也不只在固定模型上调解码策略，而是在组合空间里选配置。UniScale 将配置选择建模为在线 contextual bandit。它用 Transformer encoder 提取 query 表示，再用 LinUCB 学习在当前 query 和在线反馈下选择配置。为降低在线学习成本，论文加入三项工程机制：Path-Aware Early Exiting 提前终止低潜力推理路径；Dense Verification Feedback 用 TTS 中 verifier 的连续分数补充稀疏的最终正确/错误信号；UIS Cost Model 用 equivalent FLOPs 将计算和显存开销统一到一个成本度量里，避免只按 token 数或延迟近似带来的偏差。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖三个层次：固定模型下的 TTS 选择、不同模型之间的 routing、以及完整 UIS 配置选择。论文报告 UniScale 在这些设置下均优于分离式 baseline，并通过消融验证 early exiting、dense verifier feedback、eFLOPs cost model 对质量—成本曲线的贡献。当前给出的正文片段没有展开具体表格数字、模型池规模、benchmark 名称和绝对提升幅度，因此精读时需要核对 Section 4 和 Section 5 的完整结果，尤其是同等成本下的准确率提升、同等准确率下的 eFLOPs 降低，以及在线分布漂移场景中的恢复速度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。优先看 Section 2.1–2.2，确认 UIS 配置空间和 contextual bandit 的问题定义；再看 Section 3.3–3.4，理解 early exiting、dense feedback、eFLOPs cost model 如何缓解在线推理的延迟和反馈稀疏问题。实验部分建议重点看 Section 4.3 的完整 UIS 结果和 Section 5 的消融。需要带着一个问题读：收益主要来自更大的配置空间，还是来自更好的在线学习与成本建模。若论文没有充分控制配置空间大小和搜索预算，结论会更偏系统调度，而不是推理 scaling 规律。

summary_en.core_problem: UniScale addresses the online quality–cost control problem in LLM serving. Existing systems usually treat model routing and test-time scaling as separate decisions. Routing across model sizes gives broad coverage but only coarse jumps in capability and cost. TTS provides finer control within one model, but it quickly runs into the capacity ceiling of that model. The paper combines both into a single inference-time configuration space.
summary_en.importance: The work is not about pretraining itself, but it is relevant to foundation-model research through the lens of effective scaling. It shows that deployed capability depends not only on model size and training compute, but also on how inference compute is allocated across a model family. A smaller model with stronger TTS and a larger model with lighter TTS can occupy overlapping regions on the quality–cost frontier. This has implications for model-family design, router training, evaluation under fixed inference budgets, and how pretraining teams think about serving-time compute as part of the scaling stack.
summary_en.technical_approach: The main construct is Unified Inference Scaling. A UIS configuration specifies both the base model and the TTS strategy. TTS is parameterized by Question Parallelism, Candidate Parallelism, and Beam Size, which control the number of explored reasoning subtrees, parallel candidates, and retained verified nodes. UniScale casts configuration selection as an online contextual bandit problem. A Transformer encoder produces query representations, and LinUCB learns a policy from online feedback. Three mechanisms make the setup more practical: Path-Aware Early Exiting stops low-potential inference paths early; Dense Verification Feedback uses verifier scores from TTS to provide denser quality signals than final binary correctness; and a UIS cost model uses equivalent FLOPs to put compute and memory overhead into one cost metric.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are organized around fixed-model TTS selection, model routing, and the full unified setting. UniScale is reported to outperform decoupled baselines in all three settings, with ablations isolating the effects of early exiting, dense verifier feedback, and the eFLOPs-based cost model. The provided text does not include the detailed tables, exact benchmark list, model pool, or numerical gains, so the critical results to verify are the accuracy gain at equal cost, cost reduction at equal accuracy, and behavior under online distribution drift.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough for most pretraining readers. Focus on Sections 2.1–2.2 for the UIS formulation and bandit setup, then Sections 3.3–3.4 for the practical mechanisms. In the experiments, prioritize the full UIS setting and the ablations. The key question is whether the gains mainly come from enlarging the action space, from the online learning algorithm, or from better cost accounting. That distinction determines whether the paper is more useful as an inference-scaling idea or as a serving-system recipe.

recommendation.zh: 将 Routing 和 TTS 联合优化的思路很自然，值得关注其在线优化的具体实现和成本-收益的帕累托前沿分析。
recommendation.en: The idea of jointly optimizing Routing and TTS is natural; worth checking the specific implementation of online optimization and the Pareto frontier analysis of cost-benefit.

paper.title: LVSA: Training-Free Sparse Attention for Long Video Diffusion
paper.abstract: Dense self-attention is the compute and quality bottleneck of long-video diffusion inference: cost grows quadratically with the sequence length, and beyond the training horizon the model converges to near-static output, that is, "frozen" repetitive video. State of the art approaches are either too costly, e.g., they require retraining, or fail to satisfy both performance and quality objectives in a scalable manner. To this end, we introduce Long Video Sparse Attention (LVSA), a training-free mod

summary.core_problem: 长视频 diffusion transformer 的 dense self-attention 在帧数增长时带来二次复杂度和显存压力，并且在超过训练 horizon 后容易生成近乎静止或循环的视频。LVSA 解决的是推理阶段如何在不重训模型的条件下，同时降低长视频 attention 成本并缓解 temporal repetition。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值在于推理侧稀疏注意力设计。它不直接改预训练目标，但对长上下文多模态模型有工程和建模启发：稀疏 pattern 不能只看 FLOPs，还要避免固定网格带来的长程伪影。对视频 DiT、长上下文 VLM、以及未来统一生成模型，训练外 attention pattern 是否能稳定外推到更长 horizon，是一个实际问题。
summary.technical_approach: LVSA 是 training-free、model-agnostic 的 block-sparse attention。对每个 query frame，它不再 attend 到所有 T 个时间帧，而是 attend 到局部窗口和全局锚点的并集：局部窗口 W(t) 覆盖当前帧附近的 temporal neighborhood，用来保持短期运动连续性；全局帧集合 G 按周期选取关键时间点，用来提供长程参照。摘要还强调 rotating global anchors 和 expanded adaptive window logic，目的是减少固定稀疏网格的偏置，避免某些时间位置长期缺少全局连接。实现上结合 FlashInfer kernel，把稀疏 frame selection 转成高效 block-sparse attention。它和 RIFLEx、UltraViCo 的差别是：RIFLEx 主要改 temporal RoPE 外推，UltraViCo 依赖 pairwise logit decay；LVSA 直接改推理 attention 的可见集合，并且不需要重新训练。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Wan 2.1 1.3B、Wan 2.1 14B、HunyuanVideo 1.5 等不同视频 DiT。最长测试 horizon 下，LVSA+FlashInfer 在 Wan 2.1 1.3B 上达到 3.17× 加速，在 Wan 2.1 14B 上达到 2.98×，在 HunyuanVideo 1.5 上达到 3.33×。在 Wan 系列 6× horizon 上，LVSA 在自建 VQeval 上明显优于 dense attention，主要因为 VQeval 更能惩罚 frozen 或 loopy video。它还让 HunyuanVideo 1.5 在 2× horizon、257 frames 下完成生成，而 dense attention 因显存不足不可行。与 UltraViCo 和 RIFLEx 相比，报告中最高有 3.27× 的计算优势，同时质量指标更好。NPU 实验中，Wan 2.2 A14B 为 2.71× 加速，Wan 2.1 1.3B 为 3.24× 加速。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 attention pattern 的定义、rotating global anchors 的具体实现、VQeval 如何识别循环和冻结失败，以及不同 backbone 上的速度-质量曲线。对预训练研究员来说，最值得看的不是 kernel 细节，而是稀疏连接模式为什么会影响长程生成质量：局部窗口保运动，全局锚点保长程参照，旋转机制减少固定 pattern 的系统性偏差。

summary_en.core_problem: Dense self-attention in video diffusion transformers scales quadratically with the number of frames and becomes a memory bottleneck for long generation. Beyond the training horizon, it can also produce frozen or repetitive videos. LVSA targets inference-time long-video generation without retraining: reduce attention cost while avoiding long-range temporal artifacts.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly in efficient inference and sparse attention design. It does not change the pretraining objective, but it is informative for long-context multimodal modeling: sparse patterns should be evaluated not only by FLOPs, but also by the temporal biases they introduce. For video DiTs, long-context VLMs, and unified generative models, training-free attention extrapolation is a practical design axis.
summary_en.technical_approach: LVSA is a training-free, model-agnostic block-sparse attention algorithm. For each query frame, attention is restricted to the union of a local temporal window and a set of global anchor frames. The local window preserves short-term motion continuity, while periodically selected global frames provide long-range references. The abstract further highlights rotating global anchors and expanded adaptive window logic, which are intended to reduce fixed-grid bias and avoid systematic temporal artifacts. The method is implemented with a FlashInfer kernel to make the block-sparse pattern efficient. Compared with RIFLEx, which modifies temporal RoPE extrapolation, and UltraViCo, which applies pairwise logit decay, LVSA directly changes the visible frame set during inference and requires no finetuning.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers several video diffusion transformers, including Wan 2.1 1.3B, Wan 2.1 14B, and HunyuanVideo 1.5. At the longest tested horizon, LVSA with FlashInfer reports 3.17× speedup on Wan 2.1 1.3B, 2.98× on Wan 2.1 14B, and 3.33× on HunyuanVideo 1.5. On the Wan models at a 6× horizon, LVSA scores clearly above dense attention on the proposed VQeval benchmark, which is designed to penalize frozen and loopy outputs more directly than standard long-video metrics. It also enables HunyuanVideo 1.5 generation at a 2× horizon of 257 frames, where dense attention runs out of memory. Against UltraViCo and RIFLEx, the paper reports up to 3.27× compute advantage with better quality scores. NPU results show 2.71× speedup on Wan 2.2 A14B and 3.24× on Wan 2.1 1.3B.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim should take 20–30 minutes. Read the definition of the sparse attention pattern, the implementation of rotating global anchors, the VQeval design for detecting looping and freezing, and the speed-quality curves across backbones. For pretraining researchers, the useful lesson is why sparse connectivity affects long-horizon generation quality: local windows preserve motion, global anchors preserve long-range reference, and rotation reduces systematic bias from a fixed pattern.

recommendation.zh: 看 sparse pattern 和 kernel 部分即可；若质量指标干净，它对长上下文生成注意力设计有可复用信号。
recommendation.en: Skim the sparse pattern and kernel sections; if the quality metrics are clean, it provides reusable signal for long-context generative attention design.

institutions: AI Framework and Data Technology Lab, Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd

paper.title: VisionPulse: Dynamic Visual Sparsity for Efficient Multimodal Reasoning
paper.abstract: With the rapid advancement of large multimodal models (LMMs), inference-time overhead has become a key bottleneck for real-world deployment. Existing methods typically prune visual tokens at prefill, assuming the required visual evidence remains static during reasoning. However, we empirically show that visual evidence is strongly step-dependent: only a sparse subset of visual tokens is critical at each decoding step, and the critical set evolves across reasoning. Furthermore, we identify a coup

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文关注多模态推理中的视觉 token 冗余：现有方法通常在 prefill 阶段一次性裁剪视觉 token，但多步推理过程中需要看的视觉区域会随解码状态变化，固定子集并不合适。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，更偏向推理效率和 serving。但它对多模态基座设计有一个有用提示：视觉证据的使用不是静态的，模型在生成不同 reasoning token 时会动态切换视觉关注区域。这会影响视觉 token 预算、图文融合结构、长上下文多模态训练中的注意力分析，以及未来是否需要训练时显式建模动态视觉访问。
summary.technical_approach: VisionPulse 是一个 training-free 的逐步视觉 token 裁剪框架。核心观察是 visual attention mass 与有效视觉激活强相关。方法在每个 decoding step 计算轻量的视觉注意力质量信号，据此确定当前步的视觉 token 保留预算，再保留预算内最关键的视觉 token。它不同于 prefill-only pruning：不是在第一步选定一个固定视觉子集，而是在推理过程中随文本状态更新视觉子集。论文还指出一个耦合瓶颈：冗余视觉上下文不仅增加 attention 成本，还可能把模型引向与问题无关的区域，导致 reasoning trace 变长。
summary.experiments: 论文在七个 benchmark 上验证。结果显示，在 10% 和 5% 的视觉 token 保留率下，VisionPulse 能保持接近 full-token baseline 的性能，同时减少不必要生成长度。报告中的生成长度下降为 12.3% 和 11.2%。相较静态视觉裁剪，动态裁剪在 aggressive retention 下更稳，因为它可以在后续步骤重新选择当前需要的视觉证据，降低早期误删带来的长期影响。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看 motivation 中关于 step-dependent visual evidence 的注意力分析图，以及方法部分的 visual attention mass 和 per-step budgeting。实验部分重点看 10%/5% retention 的准确率、生成长度和与静态 pruning 方法的对比。若关心 serving，实现细节和 KV-cache 下如何执行逐步裁剪值得再看。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies visual token redundancy during multimodal reasoning. Existing methods usually prune visual tokens once at prefill, but the visual evidence needed by an LMM changes across decoding steps. A fixed visual subset can be misaligned with later reasoning states.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its useful signal for foundation-model research is that visual grounding during reasoning is dynamic. Different generated reasoning tokens may require different image regions. This has implications for visual token budgeting, multimodal attention design, training-time attention diagnostics, and future models that may learn explicit dynamic visual access.
summary_en.technical_approach: VisionPulse is a training-free step-wise visual pruning method. It uses a lightweight visual attention mass signal to estimate how much visual evidence is needed at each decoding step. Based on this signal, it assigns a per-step retention budget and keeps the most critical visual tokens under that budget. This differs from prefill-only pruning, where one visual subset is chosen before generation and then kept fixed. The paper also identifies a coupled bottleneck: redundant visual context can increase compute and steer the model toward query-irrelevant regions, resulting in longer reasoning traces.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on seven benchmarks. Under 10% and 5% visual token retention, VisionPulse maintains performance close to the full-token baseline while reducing unnecessary generation length by 12.3% and 11.2%. The dynamic strategy is especially useful under aggressive pruning because it can recover by selecting different visual evidence at later decoding steps, whereas static pruning cannot correct early selection errors.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is sufficient, around 20 to 30 minutes. Focus on the motivation figures showing step-dependent visual attention, then read the method details for visual attention mass and per-step budgeting. In the experiments, check accuracy and generation length under 10% and 5% retention, and compare against static pruning baselines. If serving implementation is the main interest, inspect how the method interacts with KV-cache decoding.

recommendation.zh: 这类工作里少见地抓到了“视觉需求是 step-dependent”这个更像机制的点；先看相关性分析和 trace 长度消融，若干净可直接借到多模态 serving 设计里。
recommendation.en: Unlike many pruning papers, this one targets a mechanism-like claim—that visual demand is step-dependent; read the correlation analysis and trace-length ablations first, and borrow it for multimodal serving if the setup is clean.

paper.title: AsymVLM: Asymmetric Token Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language Model Inference
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) process thousands of visual tokens per image alongside comparatively few text tokens, yet existing compression methods treat both modalities uniformly. We observe that the two modalities have fundamentally different properties: vision tokens are spatially redundant and dominate prefill, while text tokens are causally dependent and accumulate during decoding. Based on this asymmetry, we propose and empirically evaluate AsymVLM, which applies aggressive pruning to vis

summary.core_problem: AsymVLM 解决 VLM 推理中视觉 token 和文本 token 被同质化压缩的问题。视觉 token 数量大、空间冗余强，主要拖慢 prefill；文本 token 有自回归因果依赖，主要在长生成和多轮对话中累积 KV cache。两类 token 的结构和瓶颈不同，不适合用同一种剪枝策略。
summary.importance: 这篇论文属于高效推理方向，对预训练的间接启发在于：VLM 的视觉 token 预算不应只由固定分辨率或固定压缩率决定，而应和样本的信息分布、问题类型、生成阶段绑定。它提醒视觉 tokenizer、视觉 projector 和 native multimodal 训练需要考虑“哪些视觉 token 真正影响语言输出”，而不只是视觉显著性或图文相似度。方法本身偏 inference，不改变预训练目标或训练 recipe，但对多模态模型的 token 经济性分析有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: AsymVLM 把压缩拆成两条路径。对视觉 token，在进入 LLM transformer 之前做一次 query-aware pruning。它训练一个 cross-modal importance scorer，目标不是简单估计图像 patch 的语义显著性，而是最小化剪枝后 VLM 输出与未剪枝输出之间的差异，从而更贴近 token 对最终回答的贡献。随后使用 per-sample adaptive budget，根据每个样本视觉 token 重要性分布的间隔动态决定保留比例，避免固定剪枝率在局部问题上浪费计算、在全局计数问题上删掉关键信息。对文本 token，则不在早期激进删除，而是在生成长度超过固定预算后做轻量级 threshold-based KV eviction，以尽量保护自回归依赖。
summary.experiments: 论文在多个 VLM benchmark 上评估，报告 AsymVLM 在同类方法中取得最高 FLOPs savings，最高可达 54%。在 50% 视觉 token 保留率下，模型仍保持有竞争力的准确率。文本侧实验关注 free-form generation，结果显示面向 VLM 短上下文特性的阈值式 eviction 优于标准 LLM cache 方法。文中还给出关键观察：Phi-3.5-Vision 等配置中，单图常有约 2,500 个视觉 token，而文本输入通常只有 20–30 个 token，因此 prefill 阶段的主要开销来自视觉 token；但在长输出和多轮场景中，文本 KV cache 会逐步成为瓶颈。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20 分钟。优先看 Section 3.1 的经验分析，它解释为什么视觉和文本 token 需要不同策略；再看 Section 3.2 的 learned importance scorer，关注它如何用输出差异而不是语义相似度定义重要性；Section 3.3 的 adaptive budget 是方法中较有用的工程细节；Section 3.4 可快速浏览，理解文本 token eviction 的触发条件即可。实验部分重点看 FLOPs-accuracy tradeoff、50% vision token retention 的结果，以及 free-form generation 下文本 cache 方法的对比。

summary_en.core_problem: AsymVLM targets a mismatch in VLM inference compression: vision and text tokens are often pruned or cached with uniform policies, although they have different structures and bottlenecks. Vision tokens are numerous, spatially redundant, and dominate prefill cost. Text tokens are causally dependent and become a KV-cache issue mainly during long generation or multi-turn interaction.
summary_en.importance: The paper is mainly an inference-efficiency work, but it has useful implications for multimodal pretraining and tokenizer design. It suggests that the useful visual token budget is sample-dependent and task-dependent, not just a fixed function of image resolution. It also shifts the criterion from visual saliency or image-text similarity to contribution to the final language output. That is relevant when designing visual tokenizers, projectors, and native multimodal training recipes, even though the proposed method itself does not modify the pretraining objective.
summary_en.technical_approach: AsymVLM uses different compression strategies for the two modalities. For vision tokens, it performs query-aware pruning before the LLM transformer layers. A learned cross-modal importance scorer ranks visual tokens by how much pruning them changes the VLM output, rather than relying only on semantic saliency or similarity. A per-sample adaptive budget then adjusts the retention ratio according to the importance distribution of each input. This avoids wasting compute on localized questions while preserving more tokens for tasks that require global visual coverage, such as counting scattered objects. For text tokens, the method avoids aggressive early removal because of causal dependencies. It applies lightweight threshold-based KV-cache eviction only after the generated text exceeds a fixed budget.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports experiments across multiple VLM benchmarks. AsymVLM achieves up to 54% FLOPs savings, while maintaining competitive accuracy at 50% vision-token retention. For free-form generation, its text-token eviction strategy outperforms standard LLM cache methods by adapting to the shorter-context and image-conditioned nature of VLM decoding. A central empirical observation is that models such as Phi-3.5-Vision may process around 2,500 vision tokens for an image while the text prompt often has only 20–30 tokens, making vision tokens the main prefill bottleneck. During long outputs or multi-turn dialogue, the bottleneck can shift to accumulated text KV cache.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20-minute skim is enough. Start with Section 3.1, which motivates the modality-asymmetric design through empirical analysis. Then read the learned importance scorer in Section 3.2, especially how token importance is tied to output preservation rather than pure semantic relevance. Section 3.3 is worth reading for the adaptive-budget mechanism. Section 3.4 can be skimmed to understand when text-token eviction is triggered. In the experiments, focus on the FLOPs-accuracy tradeoff, the results at 50% vision-token retention, and the comparison against standard cache methods in free-form generation.

recommendation.zh: 把VLM的prefill视觉冗余和decode文本因果链拆开处理是对的；只看剪视觉token的打分器+预算策略，别被“文本eviction”细节带跑偏。
recommendation.en: The key insight—separating visual prefill redundancy from text causal decoding—is solid; focus on the visual pruning scorer/budgeting, and treat text eviction as a secondary heuristic.

paper.title: Accelerating Constrained Decoding with Token Space Compression
paper.abstract: To guarantee that an LLM's outputs conform to a specified structure, context-free grammar (CFG) decoding engines force the selection of next tokens that produce strings that conform to a given CFG. While current CFG-constrained decoding engines are highly optimized, the inherent costs arising from the massive per-step search space -- i.e. the entire token vocabulary -- result in intractably high overhead for more complex CFGs: precisely the situation where CFG engines are most useful. In this pa

summary.core_problem: 基于上下文无关文法（CFG）的约束解码引擎在处理复杂文法时，由于每一步都需要在整个词表中搜索合法 token，导致推理延迟极高。
summary.importance: 提出了一种离线词表压缩技术，大幅降低了约束解码的在线开销，使复杂 CFG 约束生成在实际应用中变得可行，对提升结构化输出（如代码、JSON）的推理效率有直接价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CFGzip。核心思想是利用 token 在特定文法下的等价性：如果多个 token 在文法规则下具有相同的合法性，则可以将它们归为一个等价类。CFGzip 在离线阶段针对特定的 tokenizer 和 CFG 预计算这些等价类，并在推理时将约束引擎的搜索空间从整个词表缩小到等价类的代表 token。该压缩过程是无损的，保证输出与原引擎完全一致。
summary.experiments: 在复杂 CFG 场景下，CFGzip 使当前 SOTA 语法引擎的开销降低了 20 倍以上，整体约束生成时间（LLM + 引擎）最高加速 7.5 倍。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 Section 3 了解等价类的定义和预计算方法，以及 Section 4 的实验结果，特别是不同复杂度文法下的加速比对比。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。
summary.authors_note: Saarland University

summary_en.core_problem: Context-free grammar (CFG) constrained decoding engines suffer from intractably high latency when handling complex grammars, as they must search the entire token vocabulary at each generation step to ensure validity.
summary_en.importance: Introduces an offline token space compression technique that drastically reduces the online overhead of constrained decoding, making complex CFG-constrained generation practical for real-world applications like code and JSON generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes CFGzip. The key insight is that many tokens are interchangeable with respect to a given grammar. CFGzip pre-computes these equivalence classes offline for a specific tokenizer/CFG pair. During inference, the grammar engine operates only on the representatives of these equivalence classes rather than the full vocabulary. This compression is provably lossless, ensuring byte-identical outputs to the original engine.
summary_en.experiments: CFGzip reduces the overhead of a SoTA grammar engine by over 20x for complex CFGs, resulting in up to a 7.5x speedup in total constrained generation time (LLM + engine).
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the definition and pre-computation of equivalence classes, and Section 4 for the performance gains across different grammar complexities. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Saarland University

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但如果你关心 structured generation serving，这类“离线压缩搜索空间”比再抠 kernel 更有工程回报；先看方法假设是否依赖 tokenizer 形态。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but for structured-generation serving this kind of offline search-space compression is often more valuable than another kernel tweak; first check how tokenizer-dependent the assumptions are.

paper.title: UNIQUE: Universal Top-k Sparse Attention for Training-free Inference and Sparsity-aware Training
paper.abstract: Long-context inference in large language models (LLMs) is bottlenecked by the linear growth of the self-attention key-value (KV) cache. Top-k sparse attention alleviates this by loading only a small fraction of the KV cache, but accurately and cheaply estimating cache importance, for both training-free use and sparsity-aware training, remains challenging. This paper proposes UNIQUE, a universal top-k sparse attention framework that addresses both requirements and stays consistently effective acr

summary.core_problem: 长上下文推理的KV缓存随序列长度线性增长成为解码瓶颈，现有top-k稀疏注意力存在免训练精度不足、可训练方案成本高且仅适配文本模态的问题。
summary.importance: 为长上下文推理优化与稀疏感知训练的统一设计提供参考，提出的免训练页级重要性打分方案可低成本落地到现有LLM与语音LM的推理流程，无需重训即可获得加速，同时支持后续稀疏感知微调进一步缩小训练推理差距。
summary.technical_approach: 提出UNIQUE通用top-k稀疏注意力框架，核心设计有三点：一是采用页级粒度划分KV缓存，对齐硬件访存特性；二是偏移增强的页重要性打分，以每页key的均值为表征向量，叠加key的标准差作为偏移项，补偿均值池化对高信息token的重要性低估，该打分无需训练即可计算；三是可微分sigmoid软掩码，基于top-k决策边界生成可微门控，无需额外参数或辅助损失即可支持稀疏感知训练，让模型主动优化top-k选择以降低训练推理差异。此外还提供了优化的CUDA核，top-k选择速度比PyTorch和FlashInfer快至少2倍。
summary.experiments: 公开的论文片段未提供完整的加速比与性能下降量化数据，已验证场景覆盖长文本理解和长语音识别两类任务，结论显示UNIQUE在免训练场景下性能优于现有免训练稀疏注意力方案，经稀疏感知微调后可进一步缩小与稠密注意力的性能差距。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，重点看第1章对跨模态长上下文KV瓶颈的分析、第3章的页重要性打分与可微分软掩码设计，预计阅读时间15分钟。可待论文完整发布后查看实验部分的量化加速数据。

summary_en.core_problem: The linear growth of KV cache with sequence length has become the core decoding bottleneck for long-context inference. Existing top-k sparse attention methods have limitations: training-free approaches have insufficient accuracy, trainable solutions have high costs and are only validated on text modalities.
summary_en.importance: Provides reference for the unified design of long-context inference optimization and sparsity-aware training. The proposed training-free page-level importance scoring can be deployed to existing LLM and speech LM inference pipelines at low cost, delivering acceleration without retraining, while supporting subsequent sparsity-aware fine-tuning to further close the train-inference gap.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes UNIQUE, a universal top-k sparse attention framework with three core designs. First, page-granularity KV cache partitioning aligned with hardware memory access characteristics. Second, offset-augmented page importance scoring: uses the mean of keys in each page as the representative vector, adds the standard deviation of keys as an offset term to compensate for underestimated importance of high-information tokens diluted by mean pooling. This score can be computed without training. Third, differentiable sigmoid soft mask: generates a differentiable gate based on the top-k decision boundary, enabling sparsity-aware training without extra parameters or auxiliary losses, allowing the model to actively optimize top-k selection to reduce train-inference mismatch. It also includes optimized CUDA kernels, with top-k selection speed at least 2x faster than PyTorch and FlashInfer implementations.
summary_en.experiments: The publicly available paper excerpt does not include full quantitative data of speedup and performance degradation. Validated on two scenarios: long-text understanding and long-form speech recognition. Results show UNIQUE outperforms existing training-free sparse attention methods in zero-training deployment, and further closes the performance gap with dense attention after sparsity-aware fine-tuning.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim read. Focus on Section 1 for the analysis of cross-modal long-context KV bottleneck, and Section 3 for the design of page importance scoring and differentiable soft mask. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes. Check the full experiment section for quantitative speedup data once the paper is completely released.

recommendation.zh: 只看 page scoring 和 soft-mask training；若 kernel 路径真实可落地，值得复现到长上下文 serving ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the page scoring and soft-mask training parts; if the kernel path is practical, reproduce it in long-context serving ablations.

paper.title: ReMoE: Boosting Expert Reuse through Router Fine-Tuning in Memory-Constrained MoE LLM Inference
paper.abstract: Fine-grained Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models sparsely activate only a subset of experts per token, reducing activated computation while maintaining high model capacity. However, in memory-constrained inference scenarios, only a small set of experts can be cached. Experts not in the cache must be fetched from slow external storage (e.g., UFS), leading to frequent evictions and substantial I/O overhead.   We propose ReMoE, a router fine-tuning framework designed to boost token-wise expert reuse. R

summary.core_problem: MoE大模型在内存受限的边缘/端侧推理场景下，显存无法容纳全部专家权重，原生训练的路由为了负载均衡会分散token到不同专家，导致解码过程中频繁从外部存储加载专家，产生极高的I/O开销；现有系统级缓存/预取方案没有解决上游路由行为与缓存局部性不匹配的根本问题。
summary.importance: 属于MoE部署与训练-部署对齐方向，通过轻量路由微调来适配内存约束，无需修改模型架构、推理内核或硬件，可直接集成到现有MoE推理栈中，为端侧大模型的MoE架构落地提供了低成本方案。
summary.technical_approach: 提出ReMoE路由微调框架，包含两个互补的训练目标：1）时间局部性损失，鼓励相邻token的路由专家集合重叠，提升短期重用率；2）Trust-KL损失，将更新后的路由分布软锚定到预训练路由，限制分布漂移避免效果下降。通过调整路由输出的时序稳定性，将碎片化的路由序列转换为更适合缓存的连续序列。
summary.experiments: 在DeepSeek-V2-Lite和Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B上，相邻token的专家重叠率分别提升26.4%和27.2%；离线缓存分析显示唯一请求命中率（uHR）提升、唯一未命中数（#uMiss）下降；实际系统测试中，vLLM GPU-CPU专家卸载场景下吞吐量提升8.4%、每token时延降低4.5%；Jetson Orin NX边缘设备上，ShareGPT、GSM8K、HumanEval数据集的解码时延降低43.6-49.8%，对应1.77-1.99倍的解码加速。
summary.reading_guide: 优先阅读第2节的MoE卸载局部性缺口分析、第3节的两个损失函数设计，泛读第4节的边缘设备实际系统测试结果，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: MoE LLMs cannot fit all expert weights in fast memory under memory-constrained edge/on-device inference scenarios. MoE routers are originally trained with load-balancing objectives that disperse tokens across experts, leading to frequent expert loads from slow external storage during decoding and high I/O overhead. Existing system-level caching/prefetching solutions do not address the root mismatch between upstream routing behavior and cache locality.
summary_en.importance: This work addresses the training-deployment alignment problem for MoE inference. The lightweight router fine-tuning approach requires no changes to model architecture, inference kernels or hardware, and can be directly integrated into existing MoE serving stacks, providing a low-cost solution for MoE deployment on edge devices.
summary_en.technical_approach: The ReMoE framework uses two complementary fine-tuning objectives for the router: 1) Temporal locality loss, which encourages overlap between expert sets selected for adjacent tokens to improve short-horizon reuse; 2) Trust-KL loss, which softly anchors the updated routing distribution to the pretrained router to limit distribution drift and preserve model quality. The method shapes fragmented routing traces into cache-friendly consecutive sequences without inference-time overhead.
summary_en.experiments: On DeepSeek-V2-Lite and Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B, ReMoE improves adjacent-step expert overlap by 26.4% and 27.2% respectively. Offline trace-driven cache analysis shows higher unique hit rate (uHR) and lower number of unique misses (#uMiss) across cache sizes and replacement policies. Real-system evaluations show 8.4% higher throughput and 4.5% lower time per output token (TPOT) under vLLM GPU-CPU expert offloading. On Jetson Orin NX edge devices, ReMoE reduces TPOT by 43.6-49.8% across ShareGPT, GSM8K and HumanEval, corresponding to 1.77-1.99x decoding speedup.
summary_en.reading_guide: Prioritize Section 2 for the locality gap analysis of MoE offloading and Section 3 for the design of the two training objectives. Skim the edge device real-system test results in Section 4. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 通过微调 Router 增加时间局部性来缓解 MoE 推理的 I/O 瓶颈，思路很实用，对端侧 MoE 部署和 Router 设计有启发，值得看其微调 loss 设计。
recommendation.en: Alleviating MoE inference I/O bottlenecks by fine-tuning the Router to increase temporal locality is a practical idea, inspiring for edge MoE deployment and Router design; worth checking its fine-tuning loss design.

paper.title: ThriftAttention: Selective Mixed Precision for Long-Context FP4 Attention
paper.abstract: Efficient attention algorithms are critical to mitigate the quadratic cost of attention in long-context workloads. Prior work utilises block-scaled quantisation techniques on Blackwell GPUs to move attention computation to 4-bit precision to accelerate inference. However, these techniques result in significant quality degradation in long-context settings. We show that the output impact of quantisation error is highly non-uniform and increases with the importance of each query-key interaction, co

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是长上下文推理中 FP4 attention 速度快但质量下降明显的问题。核心观察是，FP4 量化误差对输出的影响并不均匀，真正影响模型行为的误差集中在少量高注意力的 query-key block 上。
summary.importance: 这是一篇偏 efficient inference 的工作，但对预训练研究也有间接意义。长上下文模型的训练与评测越来越依赖高吞吐推理，attention 低比特化如果损伤长程检索和复制能力，会影响数据生成、评测和 post-train 迭代。ThriftAttention 给出一个实用判断：不必把所有 attention 都保留高精度，也不应盲目全部降到 FP4；更合理的是把有限高精度预算分配给对 softmax 输出最敏感的交互块。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是训练无关的选择性混合精度 attention。论文先从 softmax 的一阶扰动分析出发，说明单个 key 的误差贡献近似由三项决定：score 量化误差、attention weight，以及 value 与最终输出的偏差。其中 attention weight 会放大高分 token 的量化误差，因此高注意力块更值得保留 FP16。具体实现中，Q、K、V 使用 Blackwell 支持的 NVFP4 microscaling 格式量化，元素为 E2M1 FP4，scale 为 E4M3 FP8。然后将 Q 和 K/V 分块，对每个 query block 和 key block 计算 token mean 的点积作为重要性分数：S_ij = mean(Q_i) · mean(K_j)。每个 query block 选择 top-k key block 用 FP16 计算，其余 block 用 FP4 计算。两路结果通过 online softmax 合并成一个 attention 输出。与稀疏 attention 不同，它没有丢弃低重要性 block，只是降低其精度，因此避免了 aggressive sparsity 下不可恢复的信息丢失。
summary.experiments: 论文在 LongBench-v1、HELMET、RULER 和 PG-19 上评测，覆盖 Llama、Qwen 和 Ministral 系列模型。关键结果是，在仅 5% FP16 block 预算下，ThriftAttention 平均恢复 FP4 到 FP16 性能差距的 89.1%；预算提升到 10% 和 25% 时，恢复比例分别为 91.8% 和 92.4%。端到端生成中，长上下文场景的推理延迟最高降低约 2 倍。序列长度分析显示，上下文越长，uniform FP4 的退化越明显，选择性混合精度的收益也越大。论文还通过可视化说明 FP16 与 FP4 attention 概率差异集中在少数 query-key block，常见于近对角区域和非初始 attention sink。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。Method 的一阶误差分析是核心，重点看为什么 attention weight 会让误差集中化。实现部分要看 NVFP4 格式、block 划分、top-k block 选择和 online softmax 合并。实验部分建议优先看不同 FP16 block budget 的质量恢复曲线，以及长上下文长度变化下的退化趋势。若关注 serving 与预训练闭环，值得深挖它是否会影响长程复制、needle retrieval、代码仓库理解这类对少数关键 token 极敏感的任务。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the quality loss of FP4 attention in long-context inference. Its central observation is that quantization error is not uniformly harmful: the output-relevant error is concentrated in a small number of high-attention query-key blocks.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference-efficiency paper, but it matters for pretraining workflows that depend on large-scale long-context evaluation, synthetic data generation, and post-training iteration. It argues against both uniform FP4 attention and overly aggressive sparsity. A better trade-off is to spend a small FP16 budget on the interactions most sensitive to softmax perturbations while keeping the rest in FP4.
summary_en.technical_approach: ThriftAttention is a training-free selective mixed-precision attention method. The paper starts with a first-order perturbation analysis of softmax attention. The contribution of a quantized score error is governed by the score error itself, the attention probability, and the deviation of the value vector from the final output. The attention-probability term makes errors on high-score tokens much more consequential. In implementation, Q, K, and V are quantized with the NVFP4 microscaling format on Blackwell GPUs: E2M1 FP4 values with E4M3 FP8 scales. Q and K/V are partitioned into blocks. For each query block and key block, the method computes an importance score using the dot product between their token-wise block means. The top-k key blocks for each query block are computed in FP16, while all remaining blocks are computed in FP4. The two precision paths are merged with online softmax. Unlike sparse attention, low-scoring blocks are not dropped; they are computed at lower precision, which avoids unrecoverable omission error.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers LongBench-v1, HELMET, RULER, and PG-19 across Llama, Qwen, and Ministral model families. With only a 5% FP16 block budget, ThriftAttention recovers 89.1% of the performance gap between uniform FP4 and FP16 attention on average. At 10% and 25% FP16 budgets, the recovery increases to 91.8% and 92.4%. In end-to-end generation, the method reduces long-context inference latency by up to about 2x. Sequence-length analysis shows that the advantage grows with context length, where uniform FP4 attention degrades most. Visualizations show that FP16-vs-FP4 attention probability differences are concentrated in a small number of blocks, often near the diagonal and around non-initial attention sinks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. The key section is the first-order error analysis in the method part, especially the role of the attention-probability term in concentrating output-relevant error. The implementation details on NVFP4 quantization, block scoring, top-k selection, and online softmax merging are also worth reading. In the experiments, focus on the quality recovery versus FP16 block budget and the sequence-length scaling results. For serving pipelines connected to pretraining or post-training, the main question to examine is how the method behaves on tasks that depend on a few critical tokens, such as needle retrieval, long-range copying, and repository-level code understanding.

recommendation.zh: 值得看误差归因而不是 kernel 细节；若 Fig/Table 证明少量 block 主导退化，应进长上下文量化 ablation。
recommendation.en: Read it for the error attribution, not the kernel; if the tables show few blocks dominate degradation, add this to long-context quantization ablations.

paper.title: ArborKV: Structure-Aware KV Cache Management for Scaling Tree-based LLM Reasoning
paper.abstract: Recent progress in LLM reasoning has increasingly shifted from single-pass generation to explicit search over intermediate reasoning states. Tree-of-Thoughts (ToT) organizes inference to tree-structured search with branching and backtracking, but it substantially amplifies the Key--Value (KV) cache: retaining KV states for a frontier of partial trajectories quickly becomes a memory bottleneck that limits throughput and constrains search depth and width under fixed hardware budgets. We address th

summary.core_problem: ArborKV 解决 Tree-of-Thoughts 这类树状推理中的 KV cache 内存瓶颈：为了支持分支扩展和回溯，系统需要保留大量部分轨迹的 KV 状态，峰值显存很快限制搜索宽度、深度和吞吐。
summary.importance: 这篇工作属于推理效率方向，对预训练研究的间接价值在于帮助理解“更强推理能力”在系统层面的真实成本。Tree search、agentic reasoning 和长程 CoT 如果要成为可扩展的训练或评测范式，KV cache 管理不能只按线性序列设计。ArborKV 的关键启发是把 cache 单位从 token 序列改成 thought block，并把保留策略和搜索拓扑绑定。这对未来训练推理一体化系统、long-horizon verifier、以及大规模生成推理数据都有实际意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把树状推理轨迹建模为 rooted tree，每个节点是一个 thought block，即一个局部连贯推理步骤对应的连续 token span。核心观察是：当前自回归扩展只依赖 active leaf 及其祖先链，非活跃分支短期复用概率低，但在回溯时必须可恢复。因此，传统面向平坦序列的 token-level KV 剪枝不适配 ToT。ArborKV 包含两个模块。Multi-Signal Value Estimator 用低开销信号估计 thought block 价值，融合搜索控制器的策略反馈、模型生成置信度、语义不确定性和注意力统计，不额外引入在线 forward。Tree-Aware Eviction Policy 再把这些价值分数映射到树拓扑，根据节点到当前搜索前沿的距离和语义价值分配保留预算。被淘汰的 KV 状态通过 lazy rehydration 在回溯需要时恢复。作者还把该策略形式化为受内存预算约束的优化问题，用于平衡语义重要性和拓扑邻近性。
summary.experiments: 实验在 ToT 风格推理任务上进行，包括 GSM8K、SVAMP 和 Game of 24。作者报告 ArborKV 在接近 full-retention 推理准确率的情况下，最多实现约 4× 峰值 KV cache 降低。结果强调两点：第一，在固定显存下可以支持更大的树搜索配置，避免原本会 OOM 的深度或宽度；第二，相比只做线性序列 token 压缩的方法，树结构感知的保留策略更符合分支和回溯的访问模式。文中还提到 intra-block token-extractive mechanism，用于在 thought block 内进一步做 token 级保留，从而结合 block 级拓扑管理和局部 token 压缩。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。重点看问题形式化部分：thought block 树、active branch、frontier、backtracking 这些定义决定了 ArborKV 与普通 KV pruning 的差异。方法部分优先看 MSVE 的信号来源和 TAE 的预算分配规则，再看 lazy rehydration 的系统代价。实验部分关注 peak KV reduction 与 accuracy retention 的折中曲线，而不只看单点数字。若关心推理系统与训练数据生成的结合，可以重点思考一个问题：树搜索的中间状态是否应该成为调度和存储的一等对象，而不是被压平成普通序列。

summary_en.core_problem: ArborKV addresses the KV-cache memory bottleneck in tree-based reasoning. Tree-of-Thoughts style inference keeps many partial trajectories alive for branching and backtracking, so peak KV memory can become the limiting factor for search width, search depth, and throughput.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper, with indirect but concrete relevance to foundation-model research. Test-time search, long-horizon reasoning, and agentic workflows all become expensive when intermediate states are stored as ordinary linear decoding histories. ArborKV’s useful contribution is to make the reasoning tree itself part of the cache policy. That perspective matters for scalable reasoning evaluation, verifier-guided search, and large-scale generation of reasoning traces.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method represents a reasoning trajectory as a rooted tree of thought blocks, where each node is a contiguous span corresponding to a coherent reasoning step. The key observation is that near-term decoding needs the active leaf and its ancestor chain, while inactive subtrees have low immediate reuse probability but must remain recoverable for later backtracking. ArborKV has two main components. The Multi-Signal Value Estimator scores each thought block using low-overhead signals from the search controller, generation confidence, semantic uncertainty, and attention statistics, without requiring extra online forward passes. The Tree-Aware Eviction policy then combines these utility scores with tree topology, prioritizing blocks that are both semantically useful and close to the active search frontier. Evicted states can be restored through lazy rehydration when the search backtracks. The paper also frames the allocation as a constrained optimization problem under a fixed memory budget.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use ToT-style reasoning benchmarks including GSM8K, SVAMP, and Game of 24. ArborKV is reported to reduce peak KV cache by up to about 4× while maintaining reasoning accuracy close to full KV retention. The results emphasize that structure-aware cache management can enable larger tree-search settings under fixed device budgets, including cases where full retention would run out of memory. The paper also mentions an intra-block token-extractive mechanism, which complements block-level tree-aware eviction with token-level compression inside each thought block.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with the formalization of thought blocks and the tree search state, because that is where the paper departs from standard sequence-level KV pruning. Then read the MSVE scoring signals, the TAE allocation rule, and the lazy rehydration mechanism. In the experiments, focus on the accuracy versus peak-KV trade-off and on settings that would otherwise exceed the memory budget. The main idea to retain is that intermediate reasoning states may need first-class system support rather than being treated as flat token histories.

recommendation.zh: 树状推理的KV优化是测试时缩放的核心工程瓶颈，重点看§3的结构化驱逐策略设计。
recommendation.en: KV optimization for tree-structured reasoning is a core engineering bottleneck for test-time scaling; focus on §3 structured eviction policy design.

paper.title: Meta-Soft: Leveraging Composable Meta-Tokens for Context-Preserving KV Cache Compression
paper.abstract: The KV cache used in large language models has linearly growing time complexity, so LLMs face memory blow-up and reduced decoding efficiency when they process long contexts.Current KV Cache eviction has become an important research direction; however, existing methods based on fixed Soft Tokens (e.g., Judge Q) rely on a static parameter set as the query to evaluate the importance of KV pairs, so they cannot adapt dynamically to different input prompts, and they cannot precisely capture complex a

summary.core_problem: Meta-Soft 解决长上下文推理中的 KV cache 压缩问题。已有方法要么用局部 attention 或静态 soft token 判断哪些历史 KV 重要，难以适配不同 prompt；要么直接丢弃低分 KV，造成不可恢复的信息断裂。
summary.importance: 这篇论文属于推理效率方向，对预训练研究的间接价值在长上下文模型的服务约束。KV cache 压缩不会改变训练目标，但会影响长上下文模型是否能在真实部署中保留足够上下文信息。它提出的“prompt-conditioned probe token”思路也值得关注：重要性评估不只依赖当前解码窗口，而是用针对输入动态合成的查询向量去探测全局上下文。
summary.technical_approach: Meta-Soft 有两个核心组件。第一是动态 soft token 生成。方法构建一个 Meta-Library，包含近似正交的基向量；再用轻量 selector 根据当前 prompt 的全局语义特征合成 soft token，Gumbel-Softmax 用于动态选择或组合这些基。生成的 soft token 被拼接到输入 embedding 后端，通过一次前向 attention 作为 probe query，估计各历史 KV 对当前任务的重要性。第二是 context integration。不同于 Top-K hard eviction，Meta-Soft 不把被淘汰 KV 直接丢掉；它利用 attention flow 计算被淘汰 token 与保留 token 的语义相似度，把被淘汰 token 的信息补偿到最相近的保留 token 中。它也不同于简单平均或聚类式 KV merging，目标是尽量保留核心 token 的清晰语义，同时减少上下文断裂。
summary.experiments: 给定正文主要覆盖动机和方法，未提供完整实验表、模型规模、压缩率、吞吐提升或长上下文任务分数。方法部分说明离线阶段用冻结 LLM 的 ground-truth attention 分布监督 Meta-Library 和 selector，在线阶段按 prompt 合成 soft token 并执行压缩。若阅读完整论文，应重点检查：相同 KV budget 下相对 H2O、StreamingLLM、SnapKV、Lookahead Q-Cache、Judge Q 的准确率；不同压缩率下的性能曲线；Needle-in-a-Haystack 和长文摘要任务是否有稳定收益；context integration 是否比 hard eviction 和 naive merging 更稳。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20 分钟。先看 Introduction 对两类问题的拆分：静态重要性评估不适配 prompt，硬删除带来信息损失。Methodology 中重点看 Meta-Library 的训练信号、selector 如何从 prompt 表征合成 soft token、probe attention 如何转化为 KV importance，以及 attention-flow compensation 的具体公式。实验部分如果可见，优先看压缩率-性能曲线和 ablation：去掉动态 soft token、去掉 context integration、换成固定 soft token，三者能直接说明贡献来源。

summary_en.core_problem: Meta-Soft addresses KV-cache compression for long-context LLM inference. Existing methods either estimate token importance with local attention or static soft tokens, which do not adapt well to different prompts, or they hard-evict low-scoring KV entries and create irreversible context loss.
summary_en.importance: The paper is mainly an inference-efficiency work, with indirect relevance to foundation-model research through the deployment constraints of long-context models. The notable idea is prompt-conditioned probing: instead of using a fixed query or the current decoding window to score the cache, the method synthesizes task-specific soft tokens that query the full context before compression.
summary_en.technical_approach: Meta-Soft has two main components. First, it builds a Meta-Library of basis vectors and uses a lightweight selector to synthesize prompt-specific soft tokens from global prompt features. Gumbel-Softmax is used for dynamic composition. These soft tokens are appended at the embedding level and perform one forward attention pass as probe queries, producing importance scores for historical KV entries. Second, it introduces context integration. Rather than dropping evicted KV entries, it computes attention-flow-based similarity between evicted and retained tokens and transfers information from each evicted token into the most related retained token. This differs from hard eviction, which loses information, and from naive averaging or clustering, which can blur token semantics.
summary_en.experiments: The supplied content describes the motivation and method but does not include full experimental tables, model sizes, compression ratios, throughput numbers, or task scores. It states that the Meta-Library and selector are trained offline using ground-truth attention distributions extracted from a frozen LLM, and then used online for prompt-adaptive compression. The key results to verify in the full paper are performance under the same KV budget against H2O, StreamingLLM, SnapKV, Lookahead Q-Cache, and Judge Q; accuracy as a function of compression ratio; robustness on needle retrieval and long-document summarization; and whether the context-integration module consistently improves over hard eviction and simple merging.
summary_en.reading_guide: A practical skim takes about 20 minutes. Read the introduction for the separation between two failure modes: non-adaptive importance estimation and information loss from hard eviction. In the method section, focus on how the Meta-Library is trained, how the selector conditions on the prompt, how probe attention becomes KV importance, and how attention-flow compensation is implemented. In the experiments, the most important ablations are fixed versus dynamic soft tokens, with versus without context integration, and hard eviction versus semantic compensation.

paper.title: Runtime-Certified Bounded-Error Quantized Attention
paper.abstract: KV cache quantization reduces the memory cost of long-context LLM inference, but introduces approximation error that is typically validated only empirically. Existing systems rely on average-case robustness, with no mechanism to detect or recover from failures at runtime. We present a tiered KV cache architecture that enables runtime-certified attention: INT8 keys and INT4 values are stored in GPU memory, while FP16 originals are retained in system RAM for deterministic fallback. A two-term erro

summary.core_problem: KV cache 量化是长上下文推理的关键优化，但现有方案仅依赖经验验证（ perplexity 平均指标），无法在逐解码步骤粒度上检测或恢复量化误差，存在静默失败风险（即对某些 prompt/attention 模式产生大的 step-wise 偏差）。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在推理可靠性维度。该工作将 KV cache 量化从「固定近似」重新定义为「运行时可验证计算」，提供了一种 principled 的误差界框架，而非纯经验调参。对需要确定性服务质量的生产部署有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 核心创新有三点：(1) 分层存储架构：GPU VRAM 存放 INT8 key + INT4 value 的量化缓存，系统内存（pinned RAM）保留 FP16 原始数据用于确定性 fallback，FP16 数据不丢弃；(2) 两项误差分解：独立界定 key 量化导致的 attention 分布畸变和 value 量化导致的重建误差，两个界都可以在运行时用量化 scale、query 范数、value 范围等已跟踪量计算；(3) 自适应精度选择 + 四级 fallback 梯子：根据 attention mass 分布决定哪些 block 需要 FP16 key，同时用 ranking-consistency 检查检测 INT8 评分噪声何时扭曲 attention 分布，触发 per-head fallback 到 dense attention。
summary.experiments: 论文以 LLaMA 3.1-8B 为目标模型架构（32层，GQA 8 KV heads，head dim 128），在 128K 上下文下 FP16 KV cache 约 17GB。提出的 INT8 key + INT4 value 缓存占 FP16 的约 56%（含元数据）。文中包含形式化误差界推导（第 4 节）和 arithmetic-path gap 分析（第 9.10 节），但未报告完整的端到端性能/精度对比实验数据（从提供的全文来看）。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：重点看第 1 节（问题定义和核心思想概述）和第 3 节（分层存储架构 + fallback 机制），第 4 节的误差分解可根据兴趣选读。预计阅读时间 20-30 分钟。对预训练研究员来说，主要价值在于其 runtime verification 的框架思路，而非具体量化参数。
summary.authors_note: 机构作者信息未在提供的全文中标注。

summary_en.core_problem: KV cache quantization is a critical optimization for long-context inference, but existing schemes rely solely on empirical validation (average perplexity metrics) and cannot detect or recover from quantization errors at the per-decode-step granularity, risking silent failures—large step-wise deviations on certain prompts/attention patterns.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to pretrain research is in the inference reliability dimension. This work reframes KV cache quantization from a 'fixed approximation' to 'runtime-verifiable computation', providing a principled error-bound framework rather than purely empirical tuning. It offers reference value for production deployments requiring deterministic service quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: Three core innovations: (1) Tiered storage architecture: GPU VRAM holds INT8 key + INT4 value quantized cache, while FP16 originals are retained in pinned system RAM for deterministic fallback—FP16 data is never discarded; (2) Two-term error decomposition: independently bounds attention distribution distortion from key quantization and reconstruction error from value compression, both computable at runtime from already-tracked quantities (quantization scales, query norms, value ranges); (3) Adaptive precision selection + four-rung fallback ladder: determines which blocks need FP16 keys based on attention mass distribution, and uses a ranking-consistency check to detect when INT8 scoring noise distorts the attention distribution, triggering per-head fallback to dense attention.
summary_en.experiments: The target architecture is LLaMA 3.1-8B (32 layers, GQA 8 KV heads, head dim 128), with FP16 KV cache ~17GB at 128K context. The proposed INT8 key + INT4 value cache occupies ~56% of FP16 (including metadata). The paper includes formal error bound derivations (Section 4) and arithmetic-path gap analysis (Section 9.10), but complete end-to-end performance/accuracy comparison experiment data is not reported in the provided full text.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim guidance: focus on Section 1 (problem definition and core idea overview) and Section 3 (tiered storage architecture + fallback mechanism). Section 4 error decomposition is optional based on interest. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes. For pretrain researchers, the main value is the runtime verification framework, not the specific quantization parameters.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution and author information not specified in the provided full text.

recommendation.zh: 运行时认证量化的思路有新意，误差分解和回退机制设计对长上下文推理系统有参考价值，关注 §3 的误差界推导。
recommendation.en: Runtime-certified quantization is a novel direction; the error decomposition and fallback mechanism is useful for long-context inference systems. Focus on the bound derivation in §3.

paper.title: Fast and Stable Triangular Inversion for Delta-Rule Linear Transformers
paper.abstract: Linear attention has emerged as a cornerstone for efficient long-context architectures, as evidenced by its integration into state-of-the-art open-source models including Qwen3.5/3.6, Kimi Linear, and RWKV-7. Models that incorporate linear attention layers with the so-called Delta-Rule involve the inversion of triangular matrices as a core sub-routine. This operation often forms a performance bottleneck, and, due to its high-sensitivity to numerical errors, it can significantly deteriorate end-t

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 Delta-Rule Linear Transformer 中一个很具体但影响很大的系统数值问题：chunk-wise 并行计算时，需要反复求解或求逆单位对角下三角矩阵；这个子程序既可能成为运行时瓶颈，也可能因为低精度数值误差破坏模型输出。
summary.importance: 它对基座模型研究的价值在于长上下文架构的可训练、可评测和可部署。DeltaNet、Gated DeltaNet、RWKV-7、Kimi Linear、Qwen3.5/3.6 一类线性注意力或混合线性注意力模型，都依赖类似的 chunk 内三角运算。论文显示，不稳定的求逆实现可以把 Qwen3.6 的 MMLU 从 75.6% 拉到 0.2%，说明 kernel 级数值误差不是纯工程细节，而会直接改变模型能力评估。对做长上下文预训练的人，这类问题会影响 loss spike、长序列稳定性、不同精度 recipe 的可复现性。
summary.technical_approach: 论文系统分析 direct 和 iterative 两类三角求逆算法，目标是同时满足两点：大量使用矩阵乘法以利用 GPU/加速器 matrix cores；在 float32、float16、bfloat16 下保持可控误差。被求逆的矩阵来自 Delta-Rule Linear Transformer 的 chunk 内重写，通常是大小 C×C 的单位对角下三角矩阵，C 常取 16、32、64、128；非对角结构由 key 相关函数 phi 和严格下三角 mask 决定。作者不是简单套用通用 triangular inverse，而是利用这些矩阵的单位对角、严格下三角和 chunk 尺寸较小等结构。一个有意思的点是，单独使用时非常不稳定的 MCH 方法，可以作为 MXR 这类更稳定快速算法的内部子程序，从而在性能和稳定性之间取得更好的平衡。
summary.experiments: 论文给出的关键现象很明确：在现有实现中，三角求逆部分最高可占单层设备运行时间约 40%；不稳定低精度实现会导致端到端准确率崩坏，示例中 Qwen3.6 的 MMLU 从 75.6% 降到 0.2%。作者在 float32、float16、bfloat16 三种精度下测试多种算法的误差和稳定性，并报告 MXR 等方法相对基线最高达到 4.3× 加速，同时保持稳定输出。实验重点不是模型指标提升，而是证明数值实现会在长上下文线性注意力中成为能力保持的前置条件。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–45 分钟。先看 Figure 1，理解问题规模：运行时占比和不稳定实现对 MMLU 的破坏。再看 Table 1，确认不同 Delta-Rule / Gated DeltaNet 变体中的 phi 形式。Table 2 是方法总览，适合快速比较各算法的计算结构和稳定性。若要落地到训练或推理系统，需要细读稳定性分析、低精度实验和 MXR 的实现细节，尤其关注哪些矩阵乘可以安全放到低精度，哪些步骤需要更谨慎的累积或校正。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a narrow but consequential numerical kernel in Delta-Rule Linear Transformers: chunk-wise parallel formulations require repeated inversion or solution of unit-diagonal lower-triangular systems. This operation can dominate runtime and, if implemented with unstable low-precision algorithms, can corrupt model outputs.
summary_en.importance: The relevance to foundation-model research is practical and direct for long-context architectures. DeltaNet, Gated DeltaNet, RWKV-7, Kimi Linear, and Qwen3.5/3.6-style linear attention models rely on related chunk-level triangular operations. The paper shows that an unstable inversion method can reduce Qwen3.6 MMLU accuracy from 75.6% to 0.2%. That makes the kernel a modeling and evaluation issue, not only an implementation detail. For long-context pretraining, such numerical behavior can affect loss spikes, stability under mixed precision, and reproducibility of training recipes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper analyzes both direct and iterative triangular inversion algorithms, with two constraints in mind: the algorithms should be rich in matrix products to use accelerator matrix cores, and they must remain numerically reliable in float32, float16, and bfloat16. The matrices arise from chunked Delta-Rule linear attention and are typically C by C unit-diagonal lower-triangular matrices, with C in {16, 32, 64, 128}. Their strictly lower-triangular structure is determined by key-dependent functions and causal masking. Rather than applying generic triangular inversion blindly, the analysis exploits the unit diagonal, strict triangularity, and small chunk sizes. A notable design point is that an unstable method such as MCH can still be useful as a subroutine inside a faster and stable method such as MXR.
summary_en.experiments: The reported measurements show that triangular inversion can take up to about 40% of a layer’s device runtime in existing implementations. The numerical stability effect is large: an unstable implementation drops Qwen3.6 MMLU accuracy from 75.6% to 0.2%. The paper evaluates multiple algorithms under float32, float16, and bfloat16, measuring both error behavior and runtime. The best reported approach reaches up to 4.3x speedup over the relevant baseline while preserving stable outputs. The main result is not a higher model score, but evidence that stable triangular inversion is a prerequisite for reliable linear-attention models.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes around 30–45 minutes. Start with Figure 1 to see the runtime bottleneck and the end-to-end accuracy failure caused by unstable inversion. Then read Table 1 to understand which phi functions occur in different Delta-Rule variants. Table 2 gives the algorithm landscape and is the fastest way to compare computational structure and stability. For implementation work, read the stability analysis, the mixed-precision experiments, and the MXR details, especially which matrix products can safely use low precision and which steps need more careful accumulation or correction.

recommendation.zh: 线性Transformer长上下文架构核心算子优化，做长上下文或推理效率的研究员可重点看数值稳定性分析部分

Compilation is the most widely adopted optimization technique for LLMs. While it assumes semantic equivalence between the original and compiled graphs, we first uncover its numerical side effects can be maliciously exploited to implant stealthy backdoors in LLMs. We propose a unified optimization-triggered attack framework comprising two complementary strategies. Without any modification to the compiler or hardware, one str

summary.core_problem: LLM编译优化默认保证原模型与编译图语义等价，未考虑其数值副作用可被恶意利用植入隐蔽后门

Existing training-free approaches fall into two categories: extensions of bidirectional models, which are tightly coupled to specific architectures and suffer from quality degradation over long horizons, and autoregressive models, which accumulate drift errors due to exposure bias and tend to produce repetitive motion patterns. To address these issues, we propose a novel

paper.title: OScaR: The Occam's Razor for Extreme KV Cache Quantization in LLMs and Beyond
paper.abstract: The rapid advancement toward long-context reasoning and multi-modal intelligence has made the memory footprint of the Key-Value (KV) cache a dominant memory bottleneck for efficient deployment. While the established per-channel quantization effectively accommodates intrinsic channel-wise outliers in Key tensors, its efficacy diminishes under extreme compression. In this work, we revisit the inherent limitations of the per-channel quantization paradigm from both empirical and theoretical perspect

summary.core_problem: 论文讨论极低比特 KV cache 量化中的一个具体瓶颈：per-channel Key 量化在 INT2 这类强压缩下失效，不只是因为 channel outlier，而是因为不同 token 的 Key/Value 范数差异过大。作者把这个现象定义为 Token Norm Imbalance，简称 TNI。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏推理效率，不是预训练方法论文。对基座研究的启发在于：长上下文和多模态模型的部署瓶颈会反过来约束模型设计，尤其是 KV cache 的统计分布。论文把 KV 量化误差从 channel outlier 重新定位到 token-wise norm imbalance，有助于理解为什么一些训练后量化方法在短上下文或中等比特下有效，但在极低比特、长上下文、多模态输入下不稳。
summary.technical_approach: OScaR 是一个 training-free 的 KV cache 量化框架，目标是在不引入复杂辅助模块的情况下改善极低比特量化。方法有两个核心步骤。第一步是 Canalized Rotation，用 Hadamard transform 先旋转 Key/Value 表示，避免后续 token scaling 把局部大值放大成新的 outlier，作者称为 Scaling-Induced Outlier Artifacts。第二步是 Omni-Token Scaling，对序列维度做归一化，缓解不同 token 范数差异带来的共享量化参数失配。它不是放弃 per-channel 量化，而是在 per-channel 框架前后加入轻量的 token 归一化和旋转，使量化尺度同时适配 channel outlier 和 token norm imbalance。
summary.experiments: 论文声称在 text-only、multi-modal、omni-modal LLM 上评测，并在 INT2 KV cache 量化下保持接近无损的性能。全文片段中没有给出完整表格数字，但作者强调 OScaR 相比依赖额外参数、在线校正或复杂补偿机制的方法，有更低计算开销，并配套实现了 CUDA kernel。关键实验应包括：TNI 与量化误差的相关性分析、per-channel 量化在极低比特下的退化、Canalized Rotation 与 Omni-Token Scaling 的消融，以及不同模态模型上的吞吐和显存对比。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看 TNI 的实证分析和理论推导，再看 OScaR 的两个组件消融。系统实现部分适合做 serving 或长上下文推理的人细读。对预训练研究员来说，重点不是具体 CUDA 优化，而是 KV cache 中 token-wise norm 分布是否可以在训练阶段被正则化或通过架构设计改善。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific failure mode in extreme low-bit KV-cache quantization. Per-channel Key quantization works reasonably well when channel-wise outliers dominate, but degrades under INT2-level compression because tokens can have highly imbalanced norms. The authors name this property Token Norm Imbalance, or TNI.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an inference-efficiency paper, not a pretraining paper. Its relevance to foundation-model research is that long-context and multimodal deployment constraints expose representation statistics that are often ignored during training. The main useful idea is the shift from viewing Key quantization only through channel outliers to analyzing token-wise norm imbalance, which may explain why some post-training quantization methods fail in long-context or multimodal settings.
summary_en.technical_approach: OScaR is a training-free KV-cache quantization method. It keeps the per-channel quantization paradigm but adds two lightweight operations. First, Canalized Rotation applies a Hadamard transform to reduce scaling-induced outlier artifacts before token scaling. Second, Omni-Token Scaling normalizes sequence-level token norms so that shared quantization parameters are less affected by TNI. The design avoids extra learned parameters and heavy online correction mechanisms, aiming for a simpler path to INT2 KV quantization.
summary_en.experiments: The provided text reports evaluations across text-only, multimodal, and omni-modal LLMs, with near-lossless behavior under INT2 KV-cache quantization. Exact tables are not available in the supplied content. The important experimental axes are likely the empirical link between TNI and quantization error, degradation of vanilla per-channel quantization at extreme bit widths, ablations of rotation and token scaling, and comparisons of memory, latency, and throughput with more complex KV-quantization baselines.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Focus on the TNI analysis, the error-amplification argument, and the ablation of Canalized Rotation versus Omni-Token Scaling. The CUDA and kernel sections are most relevant for serving work. For pretraining researchers, the interesting question is whether token-norm imbalance can be shaped during training rather than repaired only at inference time.

recommendation.zh: 只看 TNI 分析和极低比特消融；若结论成立，KV 量化瓶颈不应再只盯 channel outlier。
recommendation.en: Read the TNI analysis and low-bit ablations; if the result holds, KV quantization should not be framed only around channel outliers.

However, as dLLMs continue to scale up with mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures, their deployment on resource-constrained devices remains an open challenge. Existing AR-based methods often incur either prohibitive I/O overhead or significant compute bottlenecks. In this work, we pr

summary_en.core_problem: Deploying MoE Diffusion LLMs on resource-constrained devices faces prohibitive I/O overhead or compute bottlenecks with existing AR-oriented offload methods.
summary_en.importance: System/engineering innovation: inference optimization for the emerging diffusion LLM direction, leveraging diffusion-specific properties (temporal stability of expert activations) for I/O-aware expert offload.
summary_en.technical_approach: TIDE system leverages temporal stability of expert activations within blocks during diffusion inference, introduces an interval-based expert refresh strategy, and formulates inference scheduling as a mathematical programming problem for optimal performance.
