paper.title: UCCI: Calibrated Uncertainty for Cost-Optimal LLM Cascade Routing
paper.abstract: LLM cascades and model routing promise lower inference cost by sending easy queries to a small model and escalating hard ones to a large model, but most deployed routers use uncalibrated confidence scores and require per-workload threshold tuning. We present UCCI, a calibration-first router that maps token-level margin uncertainty to a per-query error probability via isotonic regression and selects the escalation threshold by constrained cost minimization. Under three explicit assumptions, thres

summary.core_problem: 解决现有LLM级联路由使用未校准置信度、需要逐工作负载调整阈值，无法实现成本最优的问题
summary.importance: 方法创新+工程突破，提出校准优先的路由方法，有理论样本复杂度保证，在生产 workload 上验证有效
summary.technical_approach: 提出UCCI，通过保序回归将token级边际不确定性映射为查询级错误概率，再通过约束成本最小化选择升级阈值，理论上保证校准后阈值策略是成本最优的，ECE收敛速度为O(n^{-1/3})
summary.experiments: 在H100上用4B和12B指令微调LLM跑75000条生产NER workload，在微F1=0.91时降低推理成本31%，ECE从0.12降到0.03，优于熵阈值、FrugalGPT类基线

summary_en.core_problem: Address the problem that existing LLM cascade routers use uncalibrated confidence scores, require per-workload threshold tuning, and cannot achieve cost-optimal routing
summary_en.importance: Method innovation + engineering breakthrough, proposes a calibration-first router with theoretical sample complexity guarantee, validated on production workloads
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes UCCI, which maps token-level margin uncertainty to per-query error probability via isotonic regression, then selects escalation threshold via constrained cost minimization, theoretically guarantees cost-optimal threshold policy with O(n^{-1/3}) ECE convergence rate
summary_en.experiments: Tested on 75K production NER queries served by 4B and 12B instruction-tuned LLMs on H100 GPUs, cuts inference cost by 31% at micro-F1=0.91, reduces ECE from 0.12 to 0.03, outperforms entropy thresholding, FrugalGPT-style baselines

recommendation.zh: 推理成本优化的工程性工作，预训练研究员仅需知道该校准路由方案存在即可，无需精读
recommendation.en: This is an engineering work for inference cost optimization, pretraining researchers only need to know the existence of this calibrated routing scheme, no need for intensive reading

paper.title: Draft Less, Retrieve More: Hybrid Tree Construction for Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates large language model inference by leveraging a draft-then-verify paradigm. To maximize the acceptance rate, recent methods construct expansive draft trees, which unfortunately incur severe VRAM bandwidth and computational overheads that bottleneck end-to-end speedups. While dynamic-depth pruning can reduce this latency by removing marginal branches, it also discards potentially valid candidates, preventing the acceptance rate from reaching the upper bound of

summary.core_problem: 推测解码里，扩大 draft tree 能提高 acceptance rate，但会带来显著显存带宽和计算开销；剪枝虽省算力，却损失可接受候选，如何打破这组 trade-off。
summary.importance: 这是典型的高效推理工作，贡献在于把 speculative decoding 的资源分配问题显式化：不是一味做更大树，而是把剪枝省下的预算转给检索补偿。对 serving 和解码系统设计有直接价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Graft，一个 prune-then-retrieve 的混合树构造框架。先对稠密 draft tree 做动态深度剪枝，释放显存带宽与计算预算；再用 retrieval 机制补回被剪掉但高概率会被 verifier 接受的候选，从而在更低成本下接近 dense tree 的 accepted length。核心思想是让 pruning 与 retrieval 形成互补：前者省预算，后者补 coverage。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出具体模型规模和数据集，但实验应围绕 speculative decoding 的端到端速度、acceptance rate、accepted length、VRAM bandwidth 与计算开销展开，对比 dense drafting、dynamic-depth pruning 等基线。论文的关键看点不是绝对速度数字，而是是否在相同资源预算下把 acceptance-length trade-off 向外推。

summary_en.core_problem: In speculative decoding, larger draft trees improve acceptance rate but incur severe VRAM-bandwidth and compute overhead; pruning saves cost but loses valid candidates. The paper asks how to break this trade-off.
summary_en.importance: This is a clean inference-efficiency paper. Its contribution is to frame speculative decoding as a resource-allocation problem: instead of always drafting bigger trees, spend the budget saved by pruning on retrieval-based compensation. That is directly relevant to serving and decoding system design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes Graft, a hybrid prune-then-retrieve framework for tree construction. It first applies dynamic-depth pruning to a dense draft tree, freeing memory bandwidth and compute budget. It then uses retrieval to recover high-value candidates that were lost by pruning, aiming to preserve accepted length while keeping cost low. The key idea is complementarity: pruning saves budget, retrieval restores coverage.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes or datasets, but the evaluation likely focuses on end-to-end speculative decoding speedup, acceptance rate, accepted length, VRAM bandwidth, and compute overhead, against dense drafting and dynamic-depth pruning baselines. The main question is whether the method pushes out the acceptance-versus-cost frontier under matched resource budgets.

recommendation.zh: 这是推测解码里少见把“带宽预算怎么花”讲清楚的工作；读 trade-off 设定和 prune→retrieve 设计就够了，速度数字先别太当真，平台依赖会很重。
recommendation.en: One of the cleaner speculative decoding papers because it makes the bandwidth-allocation trade-off explicit; read the prune→retrieve design, but treat raw speedup numbers cautiously since they are hardware-sensitive.

paper.title: Performance-Driven Policy Optimization for Speculative Decoding with Adaptive Windowing
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by having a lightweight draft model propose speculative windows of candidate tokens for parallel verification by a larger target model. In practice, speculative efficiency is often bottlenecked by hard-to-draft positions, where an early mismatch truncates the accepted prefix and invalidates the rest of the speculative window. Most learning-based drafters are still optimized with token-level supervised objectives, even though speculative utility is i

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 speculative decoding 里一个很具体但长期存在的错配：推理时真正决定加速效果的是“一个 speculative window 最终能被 target 接受多长前缀”，而多数 drafter 训练目标仍是 token-level 的模仿或蒸馏。两者不一致的地方在于，window 中只要前面某个位置先错，后面即使都对，也会在验证时整体失效。因此，单纯提升逐 token 拟合，并不稳定地转化为更长 accepted prefix，也不一定带来更高吞吐。论文把这个问题明确表述为 prefix-sensitive、window-level 的优化问题，并尝试直接对 speculative utility 做训练。
summary.importance: 对基座研究本身，它不是预训练范式论文，而是推理加速里的训练目标重构工作，所以重要性更多在“训练目标如何更贴近最终系统指标”这一层。启发点有两点。第一，很多看似是 inference engineering 的问题，根子在训练目标与部署目标不一致；这里把 drafter 从 imitation 拉到 performance-driven optimization，是很典型的例子。第二，它提供了一个可迁移的思路：当系统收益由序列级、前缀级、或 early-failure 主导时，token-level loss 往往不够，应该显式建模 credit assignment。对做 speculative decoding、辅助模型训练、甚至多阶段生成系统的人，这个角度是有参考价值的。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 PPOW：把 drafter 视为在固定长度 speculative window 上采样动作的 policy，用 window 级 reward 做强化学习更新，而不是只做 token 监督。论文的设计分三层。

第一层是 window-level RL formulation。给定当前前缀，drafter 一次生成长度 K 的候选 window，target 按标准 speculative decoding 做并行验证，得到 accepted prefix 长度 k。训练目标不再是每个 token 的 CE，而是最大化整个 window 的期望回报。这个 formulation 直接对应实际验证机制，优点是 credit assignment 与真实吞吐更一致；代价是 reward 稀疏、方差更大。

第二层是 reward 设计。作者用了两个互补信号。其一是 Cost-Aware Speedup Reward，主奖励围绕 accepted prefix 长度构造，同时把 drafter 相对成本纳入考虑。这样不是盲目追求更长 window，而是追求单位代价下更高加速收益。这个点很关键，因为 speculative decoding 的真实收益取决于 target 节省的步数减去 drafter 额外开销。其二是 Distribution-Based Proximity Reward，作为辅助奖励，在 accepted prefix 很短、主奖励过于离散时，给那些虽然没被完整接受、但分布上仍接近 target 偏好的 window 一部分 credit。论文强调这不是简单回到 token CE，而是保留 window 级训练框架下的“软接近度”信号，用来缓解早期 mismatch 导致的零碎反馈。

第三层是 Adaptive Divergence-Aware Windowing，简称 ADAW。作者观察到并非所有训练 window 都同样有信息量：很多容易位置即使继续优化，对整体 acceptance bottleneck 帮助有限。于是他们用 confidence-weighted 的 draft-target divergence 来挑选更值得训练的窗口，优先关注那些更可能成为 acceptance bottleneck 的位置。这里的直觉是，如果 drafter 在高置信位置仍与 target 明显偏离，那么这个位置更可能在验证时早早截断 accepted prefix。相比均匀采样窗口，这种 prioritization 把训练预算集中到真正限制吞吐的局部。

从与已有方法的区别看，MEDUSA、Hydra、EAGLE、HASS、GRIFFIN 这类工作主要在 drafter 架构、head 设计、特征利用或监督训练上做文章；蒸馏方法则强调分布对齐。PPOW 的不同点不在 drafter 结构，而在优化目标：它把 speculative decoding 当成一个有明确系统回报的序列决策问题。论文实验里以 EAGLE family 的 feature-based drafter 为底座，也说明该方法更像一个可叠加的训练层，而不是替代现有 drafter 架构。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文内容看，实验结论主要有三类。

第一类是端到端 speculative performance。作者报告 PPOW 相比基于监督训练的基线，能够提升 speculative decoding 的实际效率，核心体现为更长的 accepted prefix 和更高吞吐，而不是只改善 token-level 拟合。论文强调这种收益在存在明显 hard-to-draft positions 的场景更明显，因为这些场景里早期 mismatch 对整体窗口利用率伤害最大。

第二类是 reward 与训练策略消融。Cost-Aware Speedup Reward 单独使用时，能够把优化方向拉向真实加速目标；加入 Distribution-Based Proximity Reward 后，在 accepted-prefix 信号稀疏或训练早期不稳定时更稳，说明辅助分布奖励确实缓解了纯 prefix reward 的高方差问题。ADAW 的消融则显示，优先训练高 divergence 窗口优于均匀窗口采样，支持“训练预算应集中在 acceptance bottleneck”这一判断。

第三类是分析性实验。论文在附录里给出 acceptance bottleneck 的动机分析，并用实验说明 token-level imitation improvement 与 speculative speedup 之间并非线性对应。也就是说，某些 token-level 指标更好并不保证 accepted prefix 更长，这正是 PPOW 试图修正的错配。

需要说明的是，当前提供的全文片段没有完整实验表格、参数量、训练 token 数、具体 speedup 数值和各基线的精确增益，因此无法负责任地填入具体数字。如果后续拿到完整正文和附录，建议重点补三类数字：所用 target/drafter 规模、window 长度 K 与训练设置、以及相对 EAGLE/监督基线的 acceptance length 和 wall-clock speedup 提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，不必逐式推导。建议先看 Introduction，把作者强调的“token-level objective 与 window-level utility 错配”吃透；这是整篇最有信息量的判断。然后看 PPOW 方法部分，重点抓三个模块：Cost-Aware Speedup Reward、Distribution-Based Proximity Reward、ADAW。读的时候要一直问两个问题：为什么 accepted prefix 是主优化对象；为什么还需要一个 proximity 辅助奖励。

如果时间有限，优先看方法图、reward 定义、以及 ablation 表。实验部分不用只盯最终 speedup，更值得看的是：1）token-level 指标和真实 speculative gain 是否脱钩；2）ADAW 是否真的把训练集中到瓶颈位置；3）RL 训练是否稳定，是否依赖特定 drafter 架构。

预计阅读时间 20 到 30 分钟。若要深挖，建议再看附录里关于 acceptance bottleneck 的分析，以及 speculative verification 的形式化定义，判断 reward 设计是否与真实系统成本严格一致。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific mismatch in speculative decoding: inference-time utility is determined at the window level, by how long the accepted prefix is after target verification, while most drafters are still trained with token-level imitation or distillation losses. This mismatch matters because one early mismatch truncates the accepted prefix and invalidates the rest of the drafted window. As a result, better next-token accuracy does not reliably translate into longer accepted prefixes or higher throughput. The paper reframes drafter training as a prefix-sensitive, window-level optimization problem.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense; it is an inference-acceleration paper with a training-objective contribution. Its value for foundation-model researchers is in the lesson it makes explicit: when deployment utility is sequence-level and dominated by early failures, token-level supervision can be the wrong target. The work is useful as a case study in objective mismatch between training and system metrics. It also offers a transferable idea for auxiliary models and multi-stage generation systems: if utility depends on prefix survival rather than local token fit, credit assignment should be designed around that structure instead of relying on plain CE.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core method, PPOW, treats the drafter as a policy over fixed-length speculative windows and optimizes it with window-level reinforcement learning rather than pure token supervision. The design has three main pieces.

First, a window-level RL formulation. Given a prefix, the drafter samples a K-token speculative window. The target model then performs standard speculative verification and returns an accepted prefix length k. Training maximizes expected reward over the whole window, not per-token likelihood. This aligns the optimization target with the actual verification mechanism. The benefit is better alignment with realized speedup; the cost is sparser and higher-variance feedback.

Second, reward design. PPOW uses two complementary rewards. The main one is a Cost-Aware Speedup Reward, built around accepted-prefix length while accounting for the relative cost of the drafter. This is important because speculative decoding only helps if target-side savings exceed drafting overhead. The auxiliary one is a Distribution-Based Proximity Reward, which gives partial credit to windows that remain close to the target model's preferences even when the accepted prefix is cut short early. The point is not to fall back to token CE, but to provide a softer signal inside the same window-level framework when the main reward is too sparse.

Third, Adaptive Divergence-Aware Windowing (ADAW). The paper argues that not all windows are equally informative during training. Many easy windows are not the true bottlenecks for acceptance. ADAW prioritizes windows with large confidence-weighted draft-target divergence, under the intuition that high-confidence disagreements are more likely to create early truncation points. Compared with uniform sampling, this focuses training budget on the positions that most constrain realized throughput.

Relative to prior work such as MEDUSA, Hydra, EAGLE, HASS, and GRIFFIN, the novelty is not a new drafter architecture. Those lines mainly improve heads, features, or supervised alignment. PPOW instead changes the optimization target itself, treating speculative decoding as a sequential decision problem with a system-level reward. The experiments use an EAGLE-style feature-based drafter as the base, which suggests the method is intended as a training layer that can sit on top of existing drafter designs.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full text, the experimental findings fall into three buckets.

First, end-to-end speculative performance. PPOW improves realized speculative efficiency over supervised baselines, with gains reflected in longer accepted prefixes and better throughput rather than only better token-level fit. The paper stresses that the benefit is more visible when there are hard-to-draft positions, because those are exactly where early mismatches waste most of a speculative window.

Second, ablations on rewards and training strategy. The Cost-Aware Speedup Reward moves optimization toward actual acceleration. Adding the Distribution-Based Proximity Reward improves stability when accepted-prefix signals are sparse, especially early in training, which supports the claim that pure prefix-based rewards are too brittle on their own. ADAW outperforms uniform window treatment, consistent with the idea that training should focus on acceptance bottlenecks rather than spread effort evenly.

Third, analytical evidence. The appendix motivates the notion of acceptance bottlenecks and the experiments show that improvements in token-level imitation do not map linearly to speculative speedup. That empirical decoupling is the central justification for the method.

One limitation here is that the supplied text does not include the full result tables, model sizes, training-token counts, or exact speedup numbers. So it would be unsafe to invent precise figures. With the complete paper and appendix, the key numbers to extract would be: target and drafter scales, speculative window length K and training setup, and the exact gains over EAGLE or supervised baselines in accepted-prefix length and wall-clock speedup.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper, not one that requires line-by-line derivation. Start with the introduction and make sure the central mismatch is clear: token-level objectives optimize local imitation, while speculative utility is window-level and prefix-sensitive. That is the main idea worth carrying away.

Then read the PPOW method section with attention to three components: the Cost-Aware Speedup Reward, the Distribution-Based Proximity Reward, and ADAW. Two questions are worth keeping in mind while reading: why accepted-prefix length is the right primary target, and why an auxiliary proximity reward is needed instead of relying on the main reward alone.

If time is limited, prioritize the method figure, the reward definitions, and the ablation tables. In the experiments, do not only look at final speedup. The more informative checks are whether token-level metrics decouple from realized speculative gains, whether ADAW really concentrates training on bottleneck windows, and whether the RL training remains stable across drafter settings.

Estimated reading time is 20 to 30 minutes. For a deeper pass, inspect the appendix sections on acceptance-bottleneck analysis and the formal speculative verification setup, especially to judge whether the reward matches real system cost closely enough.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是预训练，但抓住了 speculative decoding 最关键的 objective mismatch；先看 reward 定义和 adaptive windowing，若 setup 干净，值得在内部 drafter 训练里复现。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it targets the core objective mismatch in speculative decoding; read the reward design and adaptive windowing first, and replicate internally if the setup is clean.

paper.title: Enjoy Your Layer Normalization with the Computational Efficiency of RMSNorm
paper.abstract: Layer normalization (LN) is a fundamental component in modern deep learning, but its per-sample centering and scaling introduce non-negligible inference overhead. RMSNorm improves efficiency by removing the centering operation, yet this may discard benefits associated with centering. This paper propose a framework to determine whether an LN in an arbitrary DNN can be replaced by RMSNorm without changing the model function. The key idea is to fold LN's centering operation into upstream general li

summary.core_problem: 研究在不改变模型函数的前提下，哪些 LayerNorm 可以在推理时精确替换为计算更便宜的 RMSNorm。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率和归一化层结构分析。它不是重新训练模型，而是给出 LN 到 RMSNorm 的精确折叠条件，可用于降低现有模型推理开销。
summary.technical_approach: 核心思想是把 LN 的 centering 操作折叠到上游 general linear layer 中，通过 column-centered constraint 和 column-based weight centering 强制上游输出零均值；论文定义 foldable LN，并给出面向任意 DNN 计算图的检测算法。
summary.experiments: 摘要称许多常用架构中的 LN 都是 foldable，可在不改变预测结果的情况下做精确推理期转换，端到端加速约 2% 到 12%；覆盖多个任务族，但给定信息未披露具体模型和任务细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies which LayerNorm modules can be exactly replaced by RMSNorm at inference time without changing the model function.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency and normalization-structure contribution. Rather than retraining models, it gives exact conditions under which LN centering can be folded away to reduce inference overhead.
summary_en.technical_approach: The key move is to fold the centering term of LayerNorm into upstream general linear layers by enforcing zero-mean outputs through a column-centered constraint and column-based weight centering. The paper defines foldable LNs and provides a graph-based detection algorithm for arbitrary DNNs.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that many LNs in common architectures are foldable, enabling exact inference-time conversion with unchanged predictions and 2% to 12% end-to-end speedups. The provided metadata does not list the exact models or tasks.

recommendation.zh: 作为 serving 小优化备查；只看 foldable LN 判据和加速表，别把它当训练范式信号。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a serving-side optimization note; read the foldable-LN criterion and speed table, not as a training-paradigm result.

paper.title: ASAP: Amortized Doubly-Stochastic Attention via Sliced Dual Projection
paper.abstract: Doubly-stochastic attention has emerged as a transport-based alternative to row-softmax attention, with recent Transformer variants using it to reduce attention sinks and rank collapse while improving performance. In this family, the standard approach is Sinkhorn scaling, which trains more efficiently but still repeats matrix scaling in every inference forward pass. Sliced-transport attention removes the online iteration, but its soft sorting approximation materializes dense tensors for each sli

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 doubly-stochastic attention 的一个工程与方法折中问题：Sinkhorn attention 训练相对便宜，也能带来列约束带来的好处，但推理时每次前向都要做多步矩阵缩放；而 sliced-transport 一类非迭代方案推理更轻，却在训练时需要更重的 soft sorting 近似，资源代价高。作者要解决的核心问题，是能否保留 Sinkhorn 训练阶段的低成本与效果，同时在推理阶段把迭代归一化“编译掉”，得到接近 teacher Sinkhorn operator 的非迭代近似。
summary.importance: 它和 LLM 预训练的关系主要在注意力归一化设计与训练/推理接口，而不是传统 serving 小修小补。若 doubly-stochastic attention 确实能缓解 attention sinks、rank collapse 等问题，那么它的落地障碍之一就是 inference overhead。ASAP 的贡献在于提出一种 train-then-compile 路线：训练时仍用成熟的 Sinkhorn，训练后再学习一个轻量映射去近似在线求解的 dual variables。这个思路对预训练研究有两点启发。第一，某些训练时昂贵但结构良好的算子，不一定要在推理时原样保留，可以把“求解器”蒸馏成参数化近似。第二，attention 归一化不必只在 softmax 与硬替代之间二选一，还可以把最优传输里的 dual structure 单独拿出来做编译。贡献量级更像 attention layer 设计上的实用推进，是否会影响大规模 LLM 还要看长序列、因果掩码和大模型训练稳定性上的进一步验证。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是把训练好的 Sinkhorn attention 看成 teacher，然后学习一个近似其 query-side dual 的编译器。具体流程分几步。第一步，正常训练带有限步 Sinkhorn scaling 的 doubly-stochastic attention 层。这里 teacher 的定义不是无限步最优传输，而是固定预算 S 的有限 Sinkhorn 归一化，因此学生要逼近的是实际部署会用到的有限步算子，而不是理想极限。第二步，冻结 teacher，用一个小的无标签 calibration set 跑前向，抽取每次 Sinkhorn 循环最终得到的 query-side normalization vector，也就是 source dual。第三步，在同一组 query/key 激活上，沿若干投影方向做一维排序，计算精确的一维 transport potentials，把这些 sliced geometric features 作为输入特征。第四步，训练一个轻量参数映射，从 sliced dual features 回归 teacher 的 source dual。作者给出多种校准方式，包括 least-squares 和 convex-KL。第五步，推理时不再运行完整 Sinkhorn loop，而是先预测 source dual，再通过 entropic c-transform 解析恢复 key-side dual，从而构造两侧归一化后的 attention operator。文中还区分 one-sided 与 two-sided c-transform 变体。和 ESPFormer 这类 sliced-transport attention 的区别在于，ASAP 不改变训练时的 attention 构造，也不依赖训练期 soft sorting relaxation；它是后处理式编译，目标是贴近一个已训练好的 Sinkhorn teacher。和直接减少 Sinkhorn 迭代步数相比，ASAP 不是简单用更粗糙的归一化替代，而是试图学习 teacher 在给定激活分布下会收敛到什么 dual 变量，因此更像 operator approximation。
summary.experiments: 论文给出的关键对比集中在训练资源与推理速度。作者在 IMDb 的 matched-resource 配置下报告：ESPFormer 所用 SoftSort 训练算子，相比 S=10 的 Sinkhorn teacher，峰值训练显存高 5.7 倍，单样本训练速度慢 14.8 倍。这是提出 ASAP 的直接动机。ASAP 自身的实验覆盖语言和视觉 benchmark，目标是比较三类对象：原始迭代 Sinkhorn teacher、sliced-transport baseline、以及编译后的 ASAP。摘要与正文前段强调的是“显著的 layer speedup”，同时尽量保持接近 teacher 的性能与 doubly-stochastic 结构。由于给到的全文片段没有完整结果表，无法可靠抄出所有任务上的最终精度数字，但从作者描述看，重点不是超过 teacher，而是在不重训主模型的前提下，用小规模 calibration 学到一个推理更快、效果接近的替代层。阅读时应特别关注：1）不同校准目标（LS vs convex-KL）对 operator fidelity 的影响；2）one-sided 与 two-sided c-transform 的精度/速度取舍；3）编译后误差是否随序列长度、层深、模态变化而放大；4）与直接减少 Sinkhorn 步数相比，ASAP 的优势是否稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议先看 Introduction，作者把问题讲得比较清楚：Sinkhorn 训练便宜但推理慢，sliced transport 推理快但训练重。然后看 Background 里 doubly-stochastic attention 与 Sinkhorn 的定义，确认 dual variables 在层里扮演什么角色。接着重点看方法部分，尤其是 calibration pipeline、sliced dual features 的构造、以及 c-transform 如何恢复另一侧 dual。实验部分优先看资源对比表和主结果表，再看 ablation：投影数、校准集大小、回归目标、one-sided/two-sided 选择。预计 35-50 分钟能抓住主线。若你关心 LLM 预训练，可重点思考两个问题：这种编译式近似在 causal mask 下是否仍成立；以及它是否能与长上下文注意力优化结合，而不是只在中短序列分类或视觉任务上成立。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical trilemma in doubly-stochastic attention. Sinkhorn-based attention is relatively cheap to train and brings the benefits of column-balanced normalization, but it still requires iterative matrix scaling at every inference call. Sliced-transport alternatives remove online iteration, yet their training-time soft sorting relaxations are much more expensive. The core question is whether one can keep the cheaper Sinkhorn training setup and then compile away most of the iterative normalization at inference, while staying close to the trained Sinkhorn operator.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining is through attention design and the train-inference interface, not generic serving optimization. If doubly-stochastic attention is indeed useful for reducing attention sinks and rank collapse, then inference cost is one of the main barriers to broader adoption. ASAP contributes a train-then-compile recipe: train with a standard finite-step Sinkhorn layer, then learn a lightweight parametric map that predicts the dual variables the Sinkhorn loop would otherwise solve for online. Two ideas matter here. First, some structured but expensive inference-time solvers may be replaceable by learned surrogates without changing the training recipe. Second, transport-based attention can be decomposed into a teacher operator plus a compiled dual predictor, rather than treated as a monolithic alternative to softmax. The contribution is best read as a practical step in attention-layer design; whether it matters for large causal LMs still depends on evidence at longer context, larger scale, and under autoregressive masking.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method treats a trained Sinkhorn attention layer as a frozen teacher and learns to approximate its query-side dual variables. The pipeline is straightforward. First, train a Transformer with finite-step Sinkhorn normalization in the attention layer. Importantly, the target is not the infinite-step optimal transport solution, but the actual finite-budget operator used in practice. Second, freeze the teacher and run a small unlabeled calibration set through it. From each forward pass, extract the query-side normalization vector produced by the Sinkhorn loop, i.e. the source dual under the finite entropic transport convention. Third, on the same query and key activations, compute exact one-dimensional transport potentials along multiple sorted projection directions. These sliced geometric quantities become features for a lightweight regressor. Fourth, fit a parametric map from the sliced features to the teacher’s source dual, using either least-squares or convex-KL calibration. Fifth, at inference time, predict the source dual directly and recover the key-side dual analytically via an entropic c-transform, yielding a compiled approximation to the original doubly-stochastic operator. The paper also studies one-sided and two-sided c-transform variants. Relative to ESPFormer-style sliced transport, ASAP does not replace the training operator or rely on soft sorting during training; it is a post-training compilation step designed to mimic a trained Sinkhorn teacher. Relative to simply reducing the number of Sinkhorn iterations, it aims to approximate the teacher’s actual fixed-point behavior under the observed activation distribution, which is a more targeted operator approximation.
summary_en.experiments: The most concrete numbers in the visible text concern training cost. Under a matched-resource IMDb setup, the SoftSort-based training operator used in the sliced-transport baseline requires 5.7 times more peak memory and is 14.8 times slower per training example than a Sinkhorn teacher with S = 10 iterations. This cost gap motivates the train-with-Sinkhorn, compile-afterward strategy. The paper evaluates ASAP on both language and vision benchmarks, comparing the original iterative Sinkhorn teacher, sliced-transport baselines, and the compiled ASAP variants. The stated goal is not to beat the teacher, but to obtain significant layer-level speedups while remaining close to the teacher’s performance and preserving the doubly-stochastic structure as much as possible. The provided text does not include the full result tables, so it would be unsafe to invent task-level accuracy numbers. When reading the experiments, the important checks are: how close the compiled layer stays to the teacher under different calibration losses; whether one-sided versus two-sided c-transform changes the speed-accuracy tradeoff; how approximation error scales with sequence length, depth, and modality; and whether ASAP is consistently better than simply using fewer Sinkhorn iterations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction, which frames the trilemma clearly: Sinkhorn is cheaper to train but slower at inference, while sliced transport is faster at inference but expensive to train. Then read the background on doubly-stochastic attention and finite-step Sinkhorn to understand what the dual variables represent. The method section is the main part to focus on, especially the calibration pipeline, the construction of sliced dual features, and the c-transform used to recover the second dual. In the experiments, prioritize the resource comparison table and the main benchmark table, then read the ablations on number of slices, calibration set size, regression objective, and one-sided versus two-sided compilation. Around 35 to 50 minutes should be enough for a solid skim. For pretraining-oriented readers, two follow-up questions are worth keeping in mind: whether the compilation idea survives causal masking, and whether it composes well with long-context attention schemes rather than only moderate-length language or vision settings.

recommendation.zh: 针对双随机注意力（Doubly-stochastic attention）推理慢的痛点，提出了一种 train-then-compile 的摊销方法，对关注 attention 变体和推理优化的架构研究员值得一读。
recommendation.en: Addresses the slow inference of doubly-stochastic attention with a train-then-compile amortized method. Worth reading for architecture researchers focusing on attention variants and inference optimization.

paper.title: Confidence-Aware Alignment Makes Reasoning LLMs More Reliable
paper.abstract: Large reasoning models often reach correct answers through flawed intermediate steps, creating a gap between final accuracy and reasoning reliability. Existing alignment strategies address this with external verifiers or massive sampling, limiting scalability. In this work, we introduce CASPO (Confidence-Aware Step-wise Preference Optimization), a framework that aligns token-level confidence with step-wise logical correctness through iterative Direct Preference Optimization, without training a s

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作针对的是 reasoning LLM 里一个常见但经常被最终答案准确率掩盖的问题：模型可能通过错误的中间推理步骤得到正确答案，也就是 final-answer correctness 和 process reliability 脱节。现有方法要么在轨迹级别做偏好优化，要么依赖外部 verifier、树搜索和大规模采样来筛选推理路径，代价高，而且没有真正解决“模型自己的置信度为什么不能代表逻辑可靠性”这个问题。文章要处理的是：如何把 token/step-level confidence 校准到逻辑正确性上，让模型内部概率分布能更可信地反映推理步骤质量，并进一步在推理时用这个信号做低开销分支裁剪。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接相关性不如纯 pretrain 方法强，但它对 post-train 尤其是 reasoning alignment 有两个有价值的启发。第一，它把“推理可靠性”落到 step-wise calibration，而不是只看整条轨迹偏好，这对 process supervision 和 reward design 都有参考意义。第二，它尝试把训练阶段学到的置信度校准直接转化为 inference-time control signal，这种 train–test interface 的设计值得关注。若这个思路成立，未来可以延伸到更一般的 self-verification、adaptive compute、甚至 pretrain 阶段的 uncertainty-aware objective。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分成训练和推理两部分。训练部分叫 CASPO，核心是 Confidence-Aware Step-wise Preference Optimization。作者的出发点是：当前模型的 token probability 更多反映表面流畅性和模式频率，而不是逻辑有效性，所以需要显式对齐“高置信度”与“正确推理步骤”。具体做法是构造 step-wise preference pairs，对比两类步骤：一类是逻辑上正确但模型当前并不够自信的步骤，另一类是模型高置信但逻辑错误的步骤。然后通过 iterative DPO 反复优化，让模型把概率质量从 confidently wrong 的 step 挪到 logically valid 的 step 上。这样训练出来的分布，不只是更偏好正确步骤，也希望在熵层面更可校准：正确步骤应对应更集中、更低熵的分布。

推理部分叫 Confidence-aware Thought, CaT。它利用训练后更可信的 step-wise confidence，在 reasoning tree 中动态扩展高置信路径、裁剪低置信路径。作者强调其额外开销接近 O(V) 级别，意图是比外部 verifier 或复杂树搜索更轻。这里的关键不是简单用 token prob 做 beam search，而是依赖 CASPO 先把 confidence 变成与逻辑正确性更一致的信号，否则原始概率往往只会偏向流畅但未必正确的步骤。

与已有 step-wise preference 或 process reward 方法相比，CASPO 的区别在于它不训练单独 reward model，而是直接用 DPO 形式做迭代校准；与 self-consistency、tree search、rStar-Math 这类方法相比，它更强调内部不确定性的可用性，而不是靠外部搜索预算换性能。
summary.experiments:
摘要和正文给出的关键结果比较明确。实验覆盖 10 个 benchmark 和多个模型家族。Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 的平均准确率从 44.4% 提升到 50.6%，在加上 CaT 推理后达到 56.1%。在 Qwen3-8B-Base 上，作者声称在 AIME2024 和 AIME2025 上超过了 rStar-Math、Satori 等树搜索基线，而且不依赖 reward model data。

从已提供内容看，实验重点包括：1）训练后 token/step-level confidence 是否更好地对应逻辑正确性；2）CASPO 单独带来的准确率提升；3）CaT 在推理时进一步利用 calibrated confidence 做分支裁剪后的增益；4）与 search-heavy baselines 的效率和效果对比；5）数据和算力效率。正文片段没有给出完整消融细节，但按方法设计，最值得关注的消融应包括：是否必须 iterative DPO、step-wise pair 的构造方式、confidence 指标用 entropy 还是概率、以及 CaT 对不同深度/宽度搜索预算的敏感性。
summary.reading_guide:
如果只泛读，先抓住两个问题：模型原始 confidence 为什么不可靠；CASPO 如何把它变成可用信号。建议先看 Introduction 里对 miscalibration 的论证，再看 Method 中 CASPO 的 pair construction 和 iterative DPO 流程图。这里决定了方法是否只是换皮的 process preference optimization，还是确实在做 calibration。

然后看 CaT 的推理算法。重点不是“会不会剪枝”，而是它用什么累计置信度定义 path quality，如何避免过早剪掉低概率但正确的长推理路径。实验部分优先看 calibration 相关图表、Qwen2.5-7B 和 Qwen3-8B 的主结果表，以及与 rStar-Math / Satori 的对比。预计 30 分钟可以读完主线；若要判断方法是否扎实，建议额外检查 failure cases：高置信错误步骤是否真的显著减少，还是只是把模型变得更保守。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a reliability gap in reasoning LLMs: models can reach the correct final answer through flawed intermediate steps, so final-answer accuracy overstates the quality of the reasoning process. Existing alignment methods mostly operate at the trajectory level or rely on external verifiers, tree search, and heavy sampling. Those approaches are expensive and do not solve the deeper issue that a model’s own token-level confidence is poorly aligned with logical validity. The paper asks how to calibrate internal confidence at the step level so that it becomes a usable signal for both training and inference.
summary_en.importance: This is more of a post-training alignment paper than a pretraining paper, but it has two useful implications for foundation-model research. First, it treats reasoning reliability as a calibration problem at the step level rather than a pure trajectory-preference problem, which is relevant to process supervision and reward design. Second, it explicitly turns a training-time calibration objective into an inference-time control signal. That train-test linkage is interesting for broader directions such as self-verification, adaptive compute, and potentially uncertainty-aware objectives earlier in the training stack.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The framework has two parts. The training component, CASPO (Confidence-Aware Step-wise Preference Optimization), aims to align token- or step-level confidence with logical correctness. The motivation is that raw token probabilities mostly reflect fluency and frequency, not deductive validity. To fix this, the method constructs step-wise preference pairs that contrast logically correct but under-confident steps against confidently wrong steps. These pairs are optimized with iterative DPO, pushing probability mass away from invalid but high-confidence continuations and toward valid reasoning steps. The intended outcome is not only better step selection, but better calibration: correct steps should correspond to lower-entropy, more concentrated predictive distributions.

The inference component, Confidence-aware Thought (CaT), uses this calibrated confidence to guide reasoning-tree exploration. High-confidence branches are expanded, while uncertain branches are pruned, with claimed overhead on the order of O(V). The key point is that this is not just beam search over raw token probabilities. CaT depends on CASPO having made confidence more semantically meaningful; otherwise token probabilities would still favor fluent but logically weak steps.

Relative to prior step-wise preference or process-reward methods, CASPO avoids training a separate reward model and instead performs iterative calibration directly through DPO-style optimization. Relative to search-heavy methods such as self-consistency, rStar-Math, or Satori, it tries to make the model’s own uncertainty usable rather than buying reliability through external search compute.
summary_en.experiments:
The main reported results are fairly clear from the provided text. Experiments cover ten benchmarks and multiple model families. On Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, average accuracy improves from 44.4% to 50.6% with CASPO, and further to 56.1% when combined with CaT at inference. On Qwen3-8B-Base, the method reportedly surpasses tree-search baselines such as rStar-Math and Satori on AIME2024 and AIME2025, without using reward-model data.

The experimental story appears to include: (1) whether token- or step-level confidence becomes better aligned with logical correctness after training; (2) the standalone gains from CASPO; (3) additional gains from CaT using calibrated confidence for branch pruning; (4) comparisons against search-heavy baselines in both quality and efficiency; and (5) data/compute efficiency claims. The provided excerpt does not include the full ablation tables, but the critical ablations to inspect are obvious: the necessity of iterative DPO, how step-wise preference pairs are constructed, whether entropy or probability is the better confidence signal, and how sensitive CaT is to search depth and branching budget.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, focus on two questions: why raw model confidence is unreliable, and how CASPO makes it useful. Start with the introduction’s argument about miscalibration, then read the method section on preference-pair construction and iterative DPO. That is where the paper either becomes a genuine calibration method or collapses into a repackaged process-preference approach.

Next, inspect the CaT inference algorithm. The important issue is not pruning by itself, but how path quality is defined from cumulative confidence and how the method avoids pruning low-probability yet correct long-horizon reasoning paths too early. In the experiments, prioritize the calibration plots, the main tables for Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen3-8B, and the comparisons with rStar-Math and Satori. A 30-minute read should cover the main idea. For a more serious evaluation, check failure cases: does the method truly reduce confidently wrong steps, or does it mainly make the model more conservative?

recommendation.zh: 将置信度校准与DPO结合做推理对齐，无需单独RM是值得注意的方向；§3.2的token置信度与步骤正确性对齐机制值得参考，可在内部RL pipeline中尝试。
recommendation.en: Confidence calibration + DPO for reasoning alignment without a separate RM is a notable direction; §3.2's token-confidence-to-step-correctness alignment mechanism is worth referencing for internal RL pipelines.

paper.title: VibeServe: Can AI Agents Build Bespoke LLM Serving Systems?
paper.abstract: For years, we have built LLM serving systems like any other critical infrastructure: a single general-purpose stack, hand-tuned over many engineer-years, meant to support every model and workload. In this paper, we take the opposite bet: a multi-agent loop that automatically synthesizes bespoke serving systems for different usage scenarios. We propose VibeServe, the first agentic loop that generates entire LLM serving stacks end-to-end. VibeServe uses an outer loop to plan and track the search o

summary.core_problem: 能否用多智能体自动搜索并生成面向特定场景定制的 LLM serving 系统，而不是依赖单一通用 serving 栈。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是系统与 Agent-for-systems：把代码生成、正确性检查和性能评测闭环起来，自动合成 serving stack。对基座研究不是直接方法论，但对推理系统 co-design 有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 VibeServe：外层 agent 负责规划和跟踪系统设计搜索，内层 agent 负责实现候选系统、验证正确性并在目标 benchmark 上测性能。核心不是单点优化，而是自动化探索 serving 设计空间。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在标准部署场景下与 vLLM 竞争，在六类非标准场景中优于现有系统，说明定制化系统在特殊 workload 下能挖到通用栈遗漏的机会；但从摘要看，结果更偏工程 case study，泛化边界仍需看正文。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Washington。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether multi-agent loops can automatically synthesize bespoke LLM serving systems instead of relying on one general-purpose serving stack.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a systems and agent-for-systems contribution: it closes the loop among code generation, correctness checking, and performance evaluation to synthesize serving stacks. It is not directly about pretraining, but it may inform inference-system co-design.
summary_en.technical_approach: VibeServe uses an outer loop to plan and track the search over system designs, and an inner loop to implement candidates, verify correctness, and benchmark them on target workloads. The key idea is automated exploration of the serving design space rather than a single optimization trick.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims competitiveness with vLLM in standard deployment and wins in six non-standard scenarios, suggesting specialization can exploit opportunities missed by generic stacks. Still, the evidence appears more like engineering case studies, and the generalization boundary needs the full paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Washington.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但若你关心训练后部署反哺架构设计，只看系统搜索空间和六个非标准场景即可。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but if deployment constraints feed back into architecture choices, read the search-space design and the six non-standard scenarios.

paper.title: Gated Subspace Inference for Transformer Acceleration
paper.abstract: A method is presented for accelerating inference in transformer language models by exploiting the low effective rank of the token activation manifold at each layer. The method decomposes each activation vector into a subspace component and a residual, computes the linear-layer output on the subspace component via a cached low-rank weight image at reduced memory bandwidth, and applies a per-token gate that determines whether the residual correction is computed or skipped. summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是单 batch、自回归解码阶段的一个老问题：Transformer 推理往往不是算力受限，而是显存带宽受限。每生成一个 token，都要反复从 HBM 读取大矩阵权重，线性层的读带宽成本近似是 O(Ld^2)。已有方法多从权重侧下手，比如量化、静态低秩分解、剪枝；它们要么只能减少每个参数的字节数，要么依赖离线近似，难以根据当前输入动态决定哪些权重读取其实是多余的。论文的核心判断是：在固定层上，真实激活并不会铺满整个 d 维空间，而是集中在一个低维子空间里；因此，对当前输入分布真正有用的，不是完整权重矩阵 W，而是 W 在该子空间上的像 WV_k。问题就变成：能否在线跟踪这个子空间，并在不明显改变输出分布的前提下，只读取与该子空间相关的低秩权重像，从而减少带宽读写。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义不在预训练算法，而在于它把“激活流形低维”这个表征性质，转成了可执行的推理系统设计。这个角度比静态权重压缩更接近模型真实运行时的输入依赖结构。若这个假设在更大模型和更长上下文下持续成立，它提示了一个重要方向：模型的有效推理参数量可能远小于总参数量，而且这个“有效参数量”是随输入变化的。对预训练研究员来说，这有两层启发。第一，训练时是否可以显式塑造更稳定、更低维的层内表示，从而让后续推理更容易做动态低秩化。第二，评估模型容量时，不能只看参数总数，还要看不同输入分布下的有效激活维度。贡献量级上，这篇更像一篇扎实的 inference-side 方法论文，而不是改变训练范式的工作；但它把 activation subspace、动态门控、带宽 roofline 三件事连在了一起，思路是清楚的。
summary.technical_approach:
方法名是 Gated Subspace Inference，基本机制可以拆成三步。第一步，在每一层维护一个在线更新的正交基 V_k^(l)，用于近似该层当前 token 激活所在的 k 维子空间。论文沿用 SSI 中的 DGKS rank-1 更新，在时间维上逐 token 扩展或修正这个基，而不是预先离线估计一个固定 PCA 子空间。这样做的原因是解码过程中的激活分布会随上下文变化，静态子空间容易失配。

第二步，对该层所有线性映射共享同一个子空间基，包括 attention 的 Q/K/V 投影、输出投影，以及 MLP 的 up/down 投影。对任意线性层 y=Wx，先把输入分解成 x=V_kg+r，其中 g=V_k^T x，r 是残差。然后预缓存低秩权重像 M=WV_k。若只走快路径，则输出近似为 y≈Mg，只需读取 M 而不是完整 W，带宽从 d_out×d 降到 d_out×k。相比 SSI 只覆盖 MLP 两个投影，GSI 把 QKV 和 O 也纳入，覆盖了更大比例的线性层带宽开销。

第三步，用一个逐 token 的门控决定是否需要计算残差修正 Wr。门控信号来自残差相对范数 ρ_t=||r_t||/||x_t||。当 ρ_t 足够小，说明当前激活几乎落在子空间内，只用 Mg 就够；当 ρ_t 超过阈值，再回退到慢路径，计算完整 Wx 或至少补上 Wr。论文强调这个 gate 不是为了做启发式稀疏，而是为了把输出分布误差控制在给定容忍范围内。也就是说，它试图在“近似计算”和“分布保持”之间给出一个可调旋钮。

和已有方法相比，差异主要有三点。其一，不做静态权重低秩分解，而是做输入相关的 activation-conditioned 低秩化。其二，不是神经元级或元素级 sparsity，而是连续子空间上的压缩。其三，不是无条件近似，而是加了 residual-aware gate，允许在难 token 上退回精确计算。这个设计比纯低秩近似更稳，也更适合语言模型里 token 难度分布很不均匀的场景。
summary.experiments:
论文在三类模型上做了验证：GPT-2 124M、GPT-J 6B、OPT 6.7B，硬件平台是 AMD MI300X。摘要给出的核心结果是线性层权重读取的有效加速达到 3.0× 到 10.5×，同时 perplexity ratio 低于 1.00，top-k 指标基本保持。这里要注意，作者强调的是 linear-layer weight reads 的加速，不等于端到端 wall-clock 一定同倍率提升；因为 attention、kernel launch、缓存管理和门控本身也有开销。就系统论文的口径看，这个表述是谨慎的。

从全文可读出的关键实验重点有三类。第一类是子空间维度 k 与质量/加速的权衡。k 越小，缓存的 M=WV_k 越省带宽，但残差越大，触发慢路径的 token 越多；因此真实收益取决于“低秩近似收益”和“回退频率”之间的平衡。第二类是 gate 阈值的敏感性。阈值放宽会提高快路径命中率，但误差也会上升；阈值收紧则更接近无损推理，但加速下降。第三类是层覆盖范围的贡献。把方法从 SSI 的 MLP-only 扩展到 full transformer 后，收益明显增加，因为 QKV 和输出投影本身就占了大约一半线性层读流量。

摘要里没有给出更细的逐模型 perplexity、top-k 保真率、不同 k 的 ablation 数字；如果全文表格中有这些值，阅读时应重点核对两件事：一是质量保持是否在长文本和分布外 prompt 上也稳定；二是 10.5× 这类高倍数是否只出现在较小 k、较宽松 gate 或特定层/特定模型上。对这类方法，平均值往往不如尾部行为重要，因为少量高残差 token 就可能触发频繁回退，拉低真实吞吐。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先看 Introduction 里对 roofline 和带宽瓶颈的界定，再看方法部分关于 x=V_kg+r、M=WV_k 和 residual gate 的推导。这几页决定了方法是否成立。随后重点看三类图表：一是各层激活有效秩或 explained variance 的统计，确认低维假设是否足够强；二是 gate 触发率、残差范数分布与 perplexity 之间的关系，判断“近似何时安全”；三是端到端或至少模块级带宽/时延拆解，确认收益主要来自哪里。

预计阅读时间 20 到 30 分钟。若只想抓住要点，看方法总览图、子空间更新算法、以及主结果表即可。若想判断是否值得继续跟进，要深挖两个问题：第一，共享一个 layer-wise basis 给 QKV、O、MLP 是否过于粗糙，不同投影是否其实需要不同子空间；第二，在线更新 basis 的数值稳定性和缓存维护成本，在更大模型、更长上下文、以及 speculative decoding 场景下是否仍然划算。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a fundamental bottleneck in batch-1 autoregressive decoding: transformer inference is often limited by memory bandwidth rather than compute. At each generated token, the model repeatedly reads large weight matrices from HBM, and the linear-layer traffic scales roughly as O(Ld^2). Prior acceleration methods mostly operate on the weight side—quantization, static low-rank factorization, pruning—but they either reduce bytes per parameter without reducing the number of reads, or rely on offline approximations that do not adapt to the current input. The paper’s key observation is that layer activations for the current sequence occupy a low-dimensional subspace of the hidden space. If so, the useful part of a weight matrix W is not the full matrix, but its image on that subspace, WV_k. The practical question becomes whether one can track that subspace online and use it to avoid unnecessary weight reads while keeping the output distribution nearly unchanged.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance is not in pretraining methodology but in turning a representation-level property—low intrinsic dimensionality of activations—into a concrete inference design. That is more interesting than static weight compression because it is conditioned on the actual runtime input distribution. If the assumption continues to hold for larger models and longer contexts, it suggests that the effective parameter count at inference can be much smaller than the nominal parameter count, and that this effective count is input-dependent. For pretraining researchers, this raises two useful questions. First, can training explicitly encourage more stable and lower-dimensional layer representations, making downstream dynamic low-rank inference easier? Second, should model capacity be discussed not only in terms of total parameters, but also in terms of activation subspace dimension under realistic workloads? In contribution type, this is a solid inference-side systems/method paper rather than a training-paradigm shift, but the connection it draws between activation geometry, dynamic gating, and roofline bandwidth limits is technically meaningful.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, Gated Subspace Inference (GSI), has three main components. First, for each layer it maintains an online orthonormal basis V_k^(l) that approximates the k-dimensional subspace occupied by current token activations. The paper inherits the DGKS rank-1 update scheme from SSI, updating the basis along the time dimension during decoding rather than estimating a fixed offline PCA-like subspace. This matters because activation distributions drift with context, so a static basis can mismatch the actual sequence.

Second, the same layer-wise basis is shared across all linear maps in that layer: Q/K/V projections, attention output projection, and MLP up/down projections. For a linear map y = Wx, the input is decomposed as x = V_k g + r, where g = V_k^T x and r is the residual. The method precomputes and caches the low-rank weight image M = W V_k. On the fast path, it uses y ≈ M g, which requires reading M instead of the full W, reducing bandwidth from d_out × d to d_out × k. Compared with SSI, which only covered the two MLP projections, GSI extends the mechanism to the full transformer and therefore attacks a much larger fraction of linear-layer traffic.

Third, a per-token gate decides whether the residual correction is needed. The gate is based on the relative residual norm ρ_t = ||r_t|| / ||x_t||. If ρ_t is small, the activation lies mostly inside the tracked subspace and the fast path is used. If ρ_t exceeds a threshold, the method falls back to the slow path and computes the exact output, or at least the missing residual contribution Wr. The gate is not presented as heuristic sparsity; it is meant to control output-distribution error within a user-chosen tolerance. In other words, the method exposes a tunable trade-off between approximation and fidelity.

Relative to prior work, the differences are clear. It does not use a static low-rank factorization of weights; it performs activation-conditioned low-rank inference. It does not rely on neuron-wise or element-wise sparsity; it compresses along a continuous subspace. And it does not apply approximation unconditionally; it adds a residual-aware gate so difficult tokens can revert to exact computation. That makes the method more robust for language-model decoding, where token difficulty is highly uneven.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation covers three model families—GPT-2 124M, GPT-J 6B, and OPT 6.7B—on AMD MI300X. The headline result in the abstract is an effective 3.0× to 10.5× reduction in linear-layer weight reads, while keeping the perplexity ratio below 1.00 and preserving top-k behavior. The wording matters: the gain is reported for linear-layer weight-read traffic, not necessarily for end-to-end wall-clock throughput at the same multiplier, since attention, kernel overhead, cache maintenance, and gating also contribute to latency.

From the full text structure, the key empirical questions are likely organized around three trade-offs. First, the subspace dimension k versus quality and speed. Smaller k reduces the cached image size M = W V_k and saves more bandwidth, but increases the residual and therefore the fallback rate. The real gain depends on the balance between low-rank savings and slow-path frequency. Second, the gate threshold sensitivity. A looser threshold increases fast-path coverage but also increases approximation error; a tighter threshold approaches lossless inference but reduces acceleration. Third, the benefit of extending from SSI’s MLP-only scope to the full transformer. Since QKV and output projections account for roughly half of linear-layer traffic, including them materially increases the reachable savings.

The abstract does not provide finer-grained numbers such as per-model perplexity, exact top-k preservation, or ablations across k. When reading the tables, two checks matter most: whether quality remains stable on long contexts and harder prompts, and whether the largest speedups, such as 10.5×, occur only under aggressive k or permissive gating settings. For this class of methods, tail behavior matters more than averages, because a small fraction of high-residual tokens can trigger frequent fallback and erase practical throughput gains.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick pass, start with the introduction’s roofline argument and the bandwidth diagnosis. Then read the method section around the decomposition x = V_k g + r, the cached image M = W V_k, and the residual gate. Those pages determine whether the method is conceptually sound. After that, focus on three kinds of figures and tables: layer-wise effective-rank or explained-variance statistics to validate the low-dimensionality assumption; the relationship among residual norm, gate trigger rate, and perplexity to understand when approximation is safe; and latency/bandwidth breakdowns to see where the measured gains actually come from.

A reasonable skim takes 20–30 minutes. If time is limited, read the overview figure, the basis-update algorithm, and the main results table. If deciding whether the idea is worth deeper follow-up, two questions deserve extra attention: whether sharing one layer-wise basis across QKV, O, and MLP is too coarse, and whether the online basis maintenance remains numerically stable and worthwhile for larger models, longer contexts, or speculative decoding pipelines.

recommendation.zh: 无重训推理加速的有效方案，推理框架研发人员可参考门控设计部分。
recommendation.en: Effective training-free inference acceleration scheme, inference framework researchers can refer to the gating design section.

paper.title: SpecKV: Adaptive Speculative Decoding with Compression-Aware Gamma Selection
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by using a small draft model to propose candidate tokens that a larger target model verifies. A critical hyperparameter in this process is the speculation length~$γ$, which determines how many tokens the draft model proposes per step. Nearly all existing systems use a fixed~$γ$ (typically~4), yet empirical evidence suggests that the optimal value varies across task types and, crucially, depends on the compression level applied

summary.core_problem: 现有推测解码系统普遍采用固定的推测长度γ，未考虑任务差异与目标模型压缩水平对最优γ的影响，导致推理效率损失
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出轻量级自适应γ选择机制，首次将模型压缩程度纳入推测长度的决策信号，无需额外开销即可提升推测解码效率
summary.technical_approach: 设计SpecKV自适应控制器，每步从草稿模型中提取接受率、熵、置信度等信号，动态匹配当前压缩水平与任务的最优γ值
summary.experiments: 覆盖4类任务、4种候选γ、3种模型压缩精度（FP16/INT8/NF4），采集5112条step级观测数据，验证动态γ相比固定γ可提升15%-22%的推理吞吐量
summary.authors_note: 肯塔基大学团队，无公开知名大模型研究者

summary_en.core_problem: Existing speculative decoding systems generally use fixed speculation length γ, ignoring the impact of task differences and target model compression levels on optimal γ, leading to inference efficiency loss
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposes a lightweight adaptive γ selection mechanism, incorporates model compression level into the decision signal of speculation length for the first time, improves speculative decoding efficiency without extra overhead
summary_en.technical_approach: Design SpecKV adaptive controller, extract signals including acceptance rate, entropy, confidence from the draft model per step, dynamically match the optimal γ for current compression level and task
summary_en.experiments: Cover 4 task categories, 4 candidate γ values, 3 model compression precisions (FP16/INT8/NF4), collect 5112 step-level observation records, verify that dynamic γ improves inference throughput by 15%-22% compared with fixed γ
summary_en.authors_note: Team from University of Kentucky, no publicly well-known large model researchers

recommendation.zh: 推测解码方向的小增量改进，仅作为背景文献备查，无需阅读全文
recommendation.en: Small incremental improvement in speculative decoding, only for background literature reference, no need to read full text

paper.title: Breaking the Autoregressive Chain: Hyper-Parallel Decoding for Efficient LLM-Based Attribute Value Extraction
paper.abstract: Some text generation tasks, such as Attribute Value Extraction (AVE), require decoding multiple independent sequences from the same document context. While standard autoregressive decoding is slow due to its sequential nature, the independence between output sequences offers an opportunity for parallelism. We present Hyper-Parallel Decoding, a novel decoding algorithm that accelerates offline decoding by leveraging both shared memory and computation across batches. HPD enables out-of-order token

summary.core_problem: 当一个文档上下文需要生成多条相互独立的输出序列时，如何打破自回归串行解码的吞吐瓶颈。
summary.importance: 给出一种“任务结构驱动的并行解码”思路（独立输出 + position 操作实现 out-of-order 生成）；对通用 serving 的适用性取决于任务是否真独立。
summary.technical_approach: Hyper-Parallel Decoding（HPD）利用共享内存/计算跨 batch 复用，并通过 position id 操作实现乱序 token 生成；同时把多个文档堆进同一 prompt 以扩大并行度。
summary.experiments: 在 Attribute Value Extraction 上，声称可在单 prompt 内并行解码最多 96 tokens；推理成本与总时间最高降 13.8×，且不损输出质量（摘要信息）。
summary.authors_note: Amazon；McGill University；Mila。

summary_en.core_problem: How to overcome autoregressive serial decoding when a single context requires generating multiple conditionally independent output sequences.
summary_en.importance: A task-structure-driven parallel decoding idea (independent outputs + position-ID tricks for out-of-order generation); generality depends on whether independence truly holds.
summary_en.technical_approach: Hyper-Parallel Decoding shares memory/compute across batches and enables out-of-order token generation via position-ID manipulation; additionally stacks multiple documents into one prompt to increase parallelism.
summary_en.experiments: On Attribute Value Extraction, claims up to 96 tokens decoded in parallel per prompt and up to 13.8× reduction in inference cost/time without quality loss (per abstract).
summary_en.authors_note: Amazon; McGill University; Mila.

recommendation.zh: 别被“打破自回归”标题带跑偏：它是特定任务的并行化技巧；只看 independence 假设验证和 position-ID 乱序生成实现，评估能否迁移到你的离线批处理场景。
recommendation.en: Don’t overread the “breaking AR” title—it’s a task-specific parallelization trick; skim the independence validation and the position-ID out-of-order implementation for offline batch use.

paper.title: Doing More With Less: Revisiting the Effectiveness of LLM Pruning for Test-Time Scaling
paper.abstract: While current Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit remarkable reasoning capabilities through test-time compute scaling (TTS), their massive parameter counts and high inference costs have motivated the development of pruning methods that can reduce model size without sacrificing performance. However, specific to reasoning LLMs, prior work has shown that structured pruning (methods which removes entire set of layer blocks), significantly degrades TTS reasoning performance. In this work, we revisit

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的是：面向 test-time scaling 的推理型 LLM，剪枝是否一定会伤害长链推理能力。已有结论主要来自结构化剪枝，也就是直接删整层或整块网络，因此观察到随着推理 token 预算增加，模型在数学和复杂推理任务上的收益明显变差。作者重新检查这个结论，问题被收紧为：如果不改网络拓扑，只做非结构化剪枝，把单个权重置零，是否仍然会破坏 TTS 带来的性能增益，以及不同层的稀疏率分配会怎样影响这种关系。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究本身，这不是新的建模目标或训练范式，但它对“参数冗余、推理深度、可用容量”之间的关系给了一个有用的反例。更具体地说，先前一些讨论容易把“剪枝伤害长推理”泛化成普遍规律，这篇工作说明问题更可能出在删掉了关键层级结构，而不是单纯减少参数量。这个区分很重要，因为它影响后续对稀疏预训练、稀疏后训练、以及推理期算力分配的判断：如果 TTS 依赖的是网络中的某些功能路径而非致密参数本身，那么保留结构、只去掉冗余权重，可能仍能保住长链推理收益。贡献量级偏经验性和纠偏性，不是范式级推进，但对做稀疏化、压缩和推理效率的人有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上很直接，重点在实验设计而不是提出新剪枝算法。作者把结构化剪枝和非结构化剪枝放到同一 TTS 评测框架下比较。结构化侧使用 ShortGPT 一类按 block influence 删除整层的方法；非结构化侧主要考察经典 magnitude pruning 和 Wanda。前者按权重绝对值裁剪，后者利用权重与激活统计的组合来决定保留哪些连接。非结构化剪枝保持原有层数、残差路径和注意力/MLP 的宏观结构不变，只在层内形成稀疏掩码。论文还专门研究 layer-wise sparsity allocation，也就是总稀疏率固定时，稀疏度如何在不同层分配。这个点有意义，因为如果 TTS 依赖中后层的迭代推理能力，那么均匀稀疏和按层敏感度分配，结果可能差很多。作者的核心论点不是“所有非结构化剪枝都安全”，而是“结构保持”比“参数总量保持”更关键；在 reasoning LLM 上，删层会破坏深层计算路径，而细粒度删权重在相当范围内不会。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖两个推理模型：s1.1-7B 和 Qwen3-8B；四个基准：MATH500、AIME24、AMC23、GPQA-Diamond。评测重点不是单点精度，而是随着 test-time token budget 增加，性能是否还能继续上升。全文给出的主结论是：结构化剪枝会复现已有工作中的现象，即在短推理或浅层任务上还能维持，但一旦任务需要更长 reasoning trace，TTS 曲线明显变平甚至掉队；而非结构化剪枝在多数设置下能接近未剪枝模型，有些 benchmark 上还会略好。作者还比较了不同稀疏率分配策略，发现并不是任意分配都一样，某些层更敏感，合理分配能减少 TTS 损失。就证据类型看，这篇文章的价值主要来自多基准、一致的 TTS 曲线对比，以及把“剪枝类型”作为关键变量单独拎出来。摘要截断后没有完整数字表，但从正文描述看，结论依赖的是跨模型、跨任务的一致趋势，而不是单个数据点上的偶然提升。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction，确认它要纠正的是哪一个已有结论。然后直接看实验主表和 TTS 曲线图，重点不是绝对分数，而是不同 token budget 下曲线斜率是否保留。接着看 layer-wise sparsity allocation 的消融，这部分最接近机制线索：哪些层被稀疏化后，长链推理更容易受伤。若时间有限，优先看结构化 vs 非结构化的对照图、不同稀疏率下的结果，以及作者对 Wanda 与 magnitude pruning 差异的讨论。预计 20–30 分钟可以抓住主要信息；若你关心稀疏预训练或 sparse scaling，再花时间看附录里的实现细节和稀疏配置。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a narrow but important question: does pruning necessarily break test-time scaling in reasoning LLMs, or was that conclusion specific to structured pruning that removes whole layers/blocks? Prior evidence mostly came from structured pruning, where longer reasoning traces degrade sharply after pruning. This work revisits the claim by isolating unstructured pruning, which preserves the architecture and only zeros individual weights, and studies whether TTS gains survive under sparsity and how layer-wise sparsity allocation changes the outcome.
summary_en.importance: This is not a new pretraining paradigm, but it matters for how people reason about capacity, redundancy, and long-horizon inference. A common takeaway from earlier work was that pruning is fundamentally hostile to deep reasoning under TTS. This paper argues that the failure mode is more specific: removing structural depth is much more damaging than removing fine-grained redundant weights. That distinction is useful for sparse pretraining, post-training sparsification, and inference-time efficiency work. If TTS depends on preserving functional computation paths across layers rather than keeping every dense parameter, then architecture-preserving sparsity may be compatible with long-chain reasoning. The contribution is mainly empirical and corrective rather than foundational, but it is relevant to anyone working on sparsity or reasoning-efficient deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper is centered on experimental comparison rather than a new pruning algorithm. It evaluates structured pruning and unstructured pruning under the same TTS setup. On the structured side, it uses layer/block removal methods such as ShortGPT based on block influence. On the unstructured side, it studies magnitude pruning and Wanda. Magnitude pruning removes weights by absolute value; Wanda uses weight-activation statistics to decide which connections to keep. The key property is that unstructured pruning preserves the original depth, residual pathways, and macro-architecture, while inducing sparsity within layers. A notable part of the study is layer-wise sparsity allocation: under a fixed global sparsity budget, how should sparsity be distributed across layers? This matters because TTS may rely disproportionately on certain layers, especially if later layers are more important for iterative reasoning. The central claim is not that all unstructured pruning is harmless, but that preserving architectural structure is more important than preserving dense parameter count.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on two reasoning models, s1.1-7B and Qwen3-8B, and four benchmarks: MATH500, AIME24, AMC23, and GPQA-Diamond. The main evaluation lens is not just final accuracy, but whether performance continues to improve as the test-time token budget increases. The reported pattern is consistent: structured pruning reproduces the known failure mode, where shallow tasks may remain intact but longer reasoning tasks lose much of the TTS benefit; unstructured pruning, in contrast, usually tracks the dense model closely and sometimes slightly exceeds it on some benchmarks. The paper also compares different layer-wise sparsity allocation strategies and shows that allocation matters: some layers are more sensitive, and better allocation reduces TTS degradation. The value of the evidence comes from consistent TTS-curve comparisons across models and tasks, rather than a single isolated gain. The abstract snippet does not include the full numeric tables, but the full text frames the result as a robust trend across settings.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction to see exactly which prior claim is being challenged. Then jump to the main result tables and TTS scaling curves. The key signal is not the absolute score at one compute budget, but whether the slope of improvement with more tokens is preserved after pruning. After that, read the ablations on layer-wise sparsity allocation; that section is the closest the paper gets to a mechanism story. If time is limited, focus on the structured-vs-unstructured comparison, the results at different sparsity levels, and the discussion of Wanda versus magnitude pruning. Around 20–30 minutes is enough to extract the main message. If you care about sparse pretraining or sparse scaling, spend extra time on the appendix for implementation details and sparsity configurations.

recommendation.zh: 只看剪枝率×TTS budget 的曲线；若 setup 干净，应把“剪枝必伤 reasoning scaling”的 prior 下调一档。
recommendation.en: Look at the sparsity-by-TTS-budget curves; if the setup is clean, it weakens the prior that pruning necessarily hurts reasoning-time scaling.

paper.title: PolyKV: A Shared Asymmetrically-Compressed KV Cache Pool for Multi-Agent LLM Inference
paper.abstract: We present PolyKV, a system in which multiple concurrent inference agents share a single, asymmetrically compressed KV cache pool. Rather than allocating a separate KV cache per agent -- the standard paradigm -- PolyKV writes a compressed cache once and injects it into N independent agent contexts via HuggingFace DynamicCache objects. Compression is asymmetric: Keys are quantized at int8 (q8_0) to preserve softmax stability, while Values are compressed using TurboQuant MSE -- a Fast Walsh-Hadama

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决多 agent 推理中的 KV cache 内存重复问题。多个 agent 读取同一长文档上下文时，常规做法会为每个 agent 分别保存一份 KV cache；PolyKV 改为只预填充一次，保存一个压缩后的共享 KV 池，再注入到多个独立 agent 的 cache 中。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，而是推理效率系统工作。它对基座研究的间接价值在于：长上下文和多 agent 使用会放大 KV cache 成本，压缩策略需要区分 Key 和 Value 的敏感性。论文把 prefix sharing 和 KV quantization 组合在同一系统里，给出了一个清楚的工程设计点：共享前缀不必保存为全精度，Value 可以承受更激进压缩，Key 则需要更保守处理以保护 attention softmax 稳定性。
summary.technical_approach: PolyKV 包含两个抽象。SharedKVPool 对共享文档上下文执行一次 prefill，得到完整 KV state 后进行非对称压缩，并以 agent 数量 O(1) 的方式存储。PooledAgent 在生成时从共享池读取 KV，将解压后的张量逐层放入 HuggingFace DynamicCache，使各 agent 可以独立继续生成。压缩策略是非对称的：Key 使用 q8_0/int8 per-tensor 线性量化，因为 Key 直接参与 attention score 和 softmax；Value 使用 TurboQuant MSE，即先做 Fast Walsh-Hadamard Transform 旋转，再用 3-bit Lloyd-Max 标量量化，码本按近似标准正态分布设计。相对 bf16 的 K/V baseline，K 为 8 bit、V 为 3 bit，理论压缩比约为 32/(8+3)=2.91×。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct 和 Llama-3-8B-Instruct，两种模型尺度；上下文长度从 600 到 7,194 tokens；并发 agent 数最多 15 个。作者报告压缩比稳定约 2.91×。由于共享池只保存一份，整体内存节省随 agent 数增加：3 个 agent 时节省 88.5%，15 个 agent 时节省 97.7%。在 Llama-3-8B 上，perplexity delta 随上下文变长反而减小，2K tokens 为 +1.59%，4K tokens 为 +0.57%。在 SmolLM2-1.7B 的 1,851-token 连贯上下文上，作者观察到压缩 cache 的 perplexity 略好于全精度 baseline，delta 为 -0.26%，并在 3 和 5 个 agent 下复现。语义层面用 roberta-large BERTScore 评估，平均 F1 为 0.957 到 0.970。需要注意，结果主要基于 perplexity 和 BERTScore，尚不能替代更系统的长上下文任务、代码任务或多轮 agent 任务评测。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 15 到 25 分钟。重点看 PolyKV Architecture，尤其是 SharedKVPool 如何和 DynamicCache 对接，以及 Key/Value 为什么采用不同 bit-width。实验部分重点看 memory saving 随 agent 数变化的表格、不同上下文长度下的 perplexity delta，以及 PPL inversion 的设置。若关注训练或模型结构，可以略读；若负责 serving 或长上下文多 agent 系统，这篇更有参考意义。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets KV-cache duplication in multi-agent inference. When several agents consume the same document prefix, the standard implementation stores one full KV cache per agent. PolyKV computes the shared prefix cache once, compresses it, stores it in a shared pool, and injects it into independent agent contexts during generation.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-systems paper, not a pretraining paper. Its relevance to foundation-model work comes from the memory pressure created by long contexts and multi-agent usage. The useful design lesson is that prefix sharing and KV compression should be combined, and that Keys and Values should not be compressed symmetrically. Keys are more sensitive because they affect attention logits and softmax behavior; Values can tolerate stronger lossy compression.
summary_en.technical_approach: PolyKV defines a SharedKVPool and a PooledAgent. SharedKVPool runs one prefill pass over the shared document, obtains the KV tensors, and stores a compressed cache whose memory is O(1) in the number of agents. PooledAgent creates a fresh HuggingFace DynamicCache and fills it layer by layer from the shared pool, allowing each agent to decode independently afterward. Compression is asymmetric: Keys use q8_0/int8 per-tensor linear quantization, while Values use TurboQuant MSE with a Fast Walsh-Hadamard rotation followed by 3-bit Lloyd-Max scalar quantization using centroids tuned for an approximately normal distribution. Against a bf16 K/V baseline, 8-bit K and 3-bit V give an expected compression ratio of 32/(8+3), or about 2.91x.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct and Llama-3-8B-Instruct, context lengths from 600 to 7,194 tokens, and up to 15 concurrent agents. The reported compression ratio is stable at roughly 2.91x. Because the shared prefix cache is stored once, memory savings grow with the number of agents: 88.5% at 3 agents and 97.7% at 15 agents. On Llama-3-8B, perplexity degradation decreases with longer contexts, with +1.59% at 2K tokens and +0.57% at 4K tokens. On SmolLM2-1.7B with a coherent 1,851-token context, the compressed cache slightly outperforms the full-precision baseline in perplexity, with a -0.26% delta, reproduced at both 3 and 5 agents. BERTScore with roberta-large reports mean F1 between 0.957 and 0.970. The evidence is still mostly PPL and semantic-similarity based; stronger task-level evaluations would be needed for deployment-sensitive claims.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 15 to 25 minutes. The architecture section is the main part to read, especially how SharedKVPool interacts with DynamicCache and why K and V receive different compression budgets. In the experiments, focus on memory scaling with agent count, perplexity deltas under different context lengths, and the setup behind the reported PPL inversion. Readers focused on pretraining can read it lightly; serving and long-context infrastructure teams will get more direct use from it.

recommendation.zh: 多agent场景KV缓存优化的实用工程方案，仅看§3压缩策略和实验效果表即可
recommendation.en: Practical engineering scheme for KV cache optimization in multi-agent scenarios, only read §3 compression strategy and experiment result tables
